201f096b.title: Kinaxis Solution Architect, Supply Chain Planning
201f096b.description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Allegro is seeking an experienced Kinaxis Solution Architect to lead supply chain planning and Maestro solution strategy. This role will design, configure, and deploy end-to-end supply chain planning solutions using the Kinaxis Maestro platform. They will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, leading the Allegro Supply Chain team to build scalable models for demand, supply, and S&OP, while integrating with Oracle ERP.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Reporting into the Supply Chain business team, this role will oversee end-to-end Kinaxis solutions including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP, Inventory Management and Capacity Planning. They will design and implement Kinaxis Maestro solutions to drive user adoption while ensuring system reliability and sustainability for the Global Supply Chain Planning organization. Act as the primary point of contact for all Kinaxis Maestro authorship, configuration, data mapping, automation, and performance improvement for all aspects of Planning.
  
  

* Solution Design & Architecture: Translate complex supply chain requirements into technical blueprints, ensuring scalability and peak system performance.
* System Configuration: Configure key Kinaxis modules, including worksheets, dashboards, alerts, and scenario-planning models.
* Data Integration: Architect seamless data flows, APIs, and ETL pipelines to sync data between Kinaxis and enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
* Sustainability: Configure and optimize supply chain planning workflows. Troubleshoot and resolve functional and technical issues. Develop, enhance, and maintain Kinaxis resources, ensuring seamless integration into the existing supply chain planning ecosystem
* Leadership: Lead business workshops, guide functional teams through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and provide architectural governance.

**What You Will Need**
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Kinaxis configuration, solution design, integration, and business process optimization.
  
  

* 5+ years of deep, hands-on knowledge of Kinaxis RapidResponse and the Maestro AI platform. Experience as a Solution Architect in supply chain planning projects.
* 5+ years of experience with integrations and data modeling, preferably with ERP system like SAP or Oracle and other business tools like SalesForce.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end planning processes (Demand/Supply planning, Inventory optimization, Capacity Planning and S&OP). Prior semiconductor experience a plus.
* Proficiency in data modeling, APIs, ETL processes, and ERP synchronization.
* Ability to distill complex technical concepts into actionable strategies for executive stakeholders. Ability to work across a global organization, balancing multiple time zones.
* Kinaxis Author-level certification is a plus.

**Why Allegro?**
Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
  
  
We foster a culture of
**Real Innovation**
, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
Your work will create a
**Real Impact**
by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.
  
  
You’ll experience
**Real Connection**
, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.

a734fad2.title: Solution Architect
a734fad2.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
  
  
  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
  
  
  
  
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.

FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.

**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**

* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.
* Solution Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop custom Freshworks product solutions in line with business goals and industry standards. Create architecture diagrams for proposed designs and deliver presentations.
* Technical Implementation: Configure, customize, and deploy Freshworks products, encompassing workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting.
* AI and Automation Solutioning: Identify opportunities for prospects and customers to leverage AI, automation, and agentic capabilities to achieve measurable business outcomes. Advise customers on the data readiness, governance, security, accuracy, adoption, and operational ownership required to successfully deploy and manage AI-enabled solutions.
* Process Optimization: Identify areas for enhancement, proposing efficient solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Training and Support: Provide training to customers’ support agents, administrators, and relevant teams, ensuring the proficient use of Freshworks products during deployments.
* Issue Resolution: Liaise with the Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges and implementation issues related to Freshworks products.
* Integrations Design: Create and integrate Freshworks products with other systems and third-party applications to streamline 3rd-party integrations and facilitate data flow.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and architectural documentation, covering system configurations, integrations, and customizations.
* Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, Freshworks product updates, and best practices to continually enhance the capabilities of the customer support ecosystem.

**What success in this role looks like:**

Success in this role means opportunities are accurately scoped, proposed solutions are technically feasible and supportable, delivery teams receive clear and actionable designs, architecture decisions are made quickly, risks are surfaced early, and customers have confidence in you and that the solution will meet their intended business outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of professional experience in ITSM, ESM, ITOM, ITAM
* Strong technical background with custom script development and presales experience
* Ability to read complex situations with several competing constraints and identify solutions that benefit both the customers and Freshworks
* Excellent listening and presentation skills
* 5+ years working directly with Functional and organizational leaders internally and externally
* Proficient in handling ambiguity and objections
* Skilled in negotiation and objection handling
* Experience with guiding customers in organization change management (OCM) to improve technology adoption is highly desirable.
* Experience navigating difficult technical decisions and communicating tradeoffs to executives, architects, administrators, and delivery teams.

**Required skills:**

* 7+ years of Professional Services experience in software industry in SaaS platforms
* Previous roles in Solution Architect or Domain Architect within ITIL oriented / ITSM systems are advantageous
* A problem-solving innovator with a knack for thinking outside the box
* Proficient at creating architecture diagrams, process maps, data-flow diagrams, and clear design documentation.
* Extensive expertise in Enterprise landscapes across various domains, including ERP systems, Accounting Systems, HRMS, IDAM, and more
* Demonstrated experience in designing customer experience process flows
* Strong understanding of the Cloud Stack and SaaS products
* Proficiency in developing custom apps and REST API-based integrations
* Preferred, though not mandatory, background in Javascript and NodeJS

**Preferred skills:**

* ITIL Certification
* Knowledge of Project Management principals

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

48d43544.title: Solutions Architect
48d43544.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) Solutions Architect**
to lead the solution design, implementation and integration of our OTM platform supporting 4PL and end-to-end supply chain management operations.

The role requires strong expertise in Oracle OTM, transportation management processes and enterprise system integrations, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable and efficient technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Solution Architecture:**
  Design and implement scalable Oracle OTM solutions covering transportation planning, execution, freight management and shipment visibility.
* **OTM Functional Expertise:**
  Provide architectural guidance across order management, shipment planning, rate management, carrier tendering, freight audit and settlement.
* **Systems Integration:**
  Design and oversee integrations between OTM, customer ERP systems, WMS, TMS, middleware platforms and external logistics service providers.
* **Implementation & Delivery:**
  Lead solution design, configuration reviews, integration testing, UAT, deployment and go-live activities in coordination with implementation partners.
* **4PL & Control Tower Enablement:**
  Support multimodal transportation orchestration, milestone tracking, exception management and customer-facing visibility solutions.
* **Application Governance:**
  Establish architecture standards, data security, configuration governance and performance monitoring.
* **Business Collaboration:**
  Work closely with business, operations and IT teams to translate customer requirements into feasible solutions and support new customer implementations.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Identify opportunities for automation, process standardization and optimization of OTM capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

* 8–12 years of experience in enterprise applications or supply chain technology, including at least 5 years of hands-on Oracle OTM experience.
* Experience in end-to-end Oracle OTM implementations, preferably on OTM Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of OTM modules, including Order Management, Shipment Planning, Rate Management, Execution and Freight Settlement.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, XML, JSON, EDI and middleware integrations, preferably Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Good understanding of domestic and international transportation, freight forwarding and 4PL operations.
* Experience working with system integrators, technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong solution design, analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or Supply Chain Management.
* Exposure to multimodal logistics, 4PL platforms and Control Tower solutions.
* Experience with multi-customer or multi-entity OTM implementations.

Key Expectations

* The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing
  **Oracle OTM as a scalable and reliable transportation orchestration platform**
  , enabling seamless integrations, efficient customer onboarding, standardized workflows and improved operational visibility across Rhenus's 4PL business.

521a19f5.title: Solutions Acceleration Architect, Google Cloud
521a19f5.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in cloud computing, with a focus on machine learning architecture, software development, and model deployment in a customer-facing or consulting role.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming/scripting languages such as Python.
* Experience developing and deploying data solutions.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into actionable AI roadmaps, defining the technical architecture for fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and custom model development.
* Experience in architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.
* Proven track record of managing stakeholder expectations and building consensus around complex AI initiatives, including navigating discussions on AI ethics, model bias, and return on investment (ROI).
* Understanding of the AI/ML landscape, including familiarity with model evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and the integration of third-party foundation models.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
The APAC Google Forge Team partners with customers to bring their goals to life. We collaborate closely to understand their challenges and ideas, then design and build practical working solutions using data, analytics, AI, and software engineering. Our goal is to demonstrate how these technologies can work together to achieve impactful business results.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the design and development of cutting-edge prototypes, demonstrating the transformative power of data, analytics, AI, and software engineering to solve complex business challenges for our customers. You will play a key role in mentoring team members and contributing to the strategic direction of our solution-building efforts.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical relationship with partners, empowering them to drive a successful pilot or proof-of-concept, support partners in driving customer acceptance of the technical proposal, leading to an agreement, and work with partners during the migration phase to ensure they have all the tools necessary to deliver a successful deployment.
* Build trusted advisory relationships and make recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution for customers to optimize Google Cloud effectiveness.
* Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data-centric and AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for AI-driven solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

47fd6eec.title: Technical Solution Architect - ThingWorx / SCPA
47fd6eec.description:
**Req ID:**
388377
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Technical Solution Architect - ThingWorx / SCPA to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description – Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA**
**Job Title:**
Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA
  
  
**Platform:**
ThingWorx 10.x
  
  
**Product Focus:**
Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) / SmartConnect
  
  
**Engagement Type:**
Solution Architecture, Design & Delivery
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ Years overall, including 5+ years of ThingWorx experience
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Technical Solution Architect – ThingWorx / SCPA**
to lead the architecture and solution design of the next-generation
**SmartConnect connected-product platform**
using
**ThingWorx 10.x and Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA)**
.
  
  
The architect will translate approved business requirements, user needs, and acceptance criteria into a
**secure, scalable, resilient, supportable, and maintainable technical solution**
. The role will provide technical direction across remote service access, endpoint automation, identity and access governance, enterprise integrations, master-data synchronization, and multiple user populations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in
**ThingWorx architecture and development**
, combined with strong knowledge of
**SCPA building blocks, IoT solution architecture, security, identity management, enterprise integration, and remote-access solutions**
.
  
  
A key objective of this role is to maximize the use of
**standard SCPA configuration and reusable building blocks**
, minimize unnecessary customization, and establish governed, upgrade-safe extension patterns where custom development is required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for SmartConnect using ThingWorx 10.x and SCPA.
* Define application, data, integration, security, deployment, infrastructure, and operational architecture.
* Translate business requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into traceable technical requirements, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Evaluate requirements against SCPA capabilities and determine the appropriate configure, integrate, extend, or custom-build approach.
* Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, solution documentation, technical standards, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Establish implementation guardrails and reusable architectural patterns for development teams.

ThingWorx & SCPA Architecture
  
  

* Design the overall ThingWorx Thing model and asset hierarchy.
* Define and govern:

+ Thing Templates
+ Thing Shapes
+ Data Shapes
+ Services
+ Events
+ Subscriptions
+ Persistence strategies
+ Mashups and application components

* Assess and leverage SCPA standard capabilities, reusable building blocks, extension points, and custom components.
* Ensure custom extensions are maintainable, testable, reusable, and designed to minimize future upgrade impact.

Remote Access & Endpoint Management
  
  

* Architect secure attended and unattended remote-access solutions for gateways and downstream endpoints.
* Define architecture for session routing, customer/user consent, endpoint availability, failure handling, auditability, clipboard access, and file transfer.
* Design secure gateway-to-endpoint communication and access patterns.
* Ensure remote-access capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity and least-privilege requirements.

Automation & Remote Package Execution
  
  

* Design automated file-watch ingestion and processing capabilities.
* Define targeted remote-package execution architecture, including:

+ Endpoint targeting
+ Integrity/checksum validation
+ Retry and failure-management policies
+ Execution status
+ Per-endpoint results
+ Audit records
+ Monitoring and observability

* Establish scalable automation patterns for managing distributed endpoints and connected assets.

Security, Identity & Access Governance
  
  

* Define Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege security architecture.
* Design static and dynamic visibility groups and segmented access models.
* Architect Just-In-Time (JIT) privileged-access approval workflows, including customer-owned approval processes.
* Define identity and authorization models supporting:

+ Customers
+ Internal employees
+ External contractors
+ Business partners

* Design identity federation and authentication patterns using enterprise identity platforms.
* Ensure security controls, authorization decisions, privileged access, and user activity are appropriately auditable.

Enterprise Integration & Master Data
  
  

* Define integration architecture between ThingWorx/SmartConnect and Unity (Salesforce) for endpoint master data.
* Establish system-of-record ownership and read-only data-field principles.
* Design synchronization, reconciliation, error handling, retry, and recovery mechanisms.
* Provide visibility into synchronization status and last-successful-sync information.
* Establish standards for REST APIs, events, data contracts, and integration patterns across enterprise systems.
* Support integrations with IAM/IdP platforms, Salesforce, CMDB, SAP, logging, monitoring, and other enterprise applications.

Non-Functional Architecture
  
  
Define and govern non-functional requirements covering:
  
  

* Availability and high availability
* Performance
* Scalability
* Resiliency and recovery
* Security and privacy
* Observability and monitoring
* Auditability
* Maintainability
* Supportability
* Deployment and release management

Ensure architectural decisions support production operations, troubleshooting, future enhancements, and platform upgrades.
  
  
Architecture Governance & Delivery Support
  
  

* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, threat-modeling discussions, and design-assurance activities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
* Review implementation designs and code to ensure compliance with approved architectural patterns.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to ThingWorx consultants, developers, integration engineers, and infrastructure teams.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, QA, Service Operations, Infrastructure, and enterprise integration teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.

Migration & Coexistence
  
  

* Define the migration strategy from the existing SmartConnect implementation to the next-generation platform.
* Develop migration and coexistence architecture to minimize business and operational disruption.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt during modernization.
* Define deployment, transition, rollback, and release strategies.

SmartConnect Capability Alignment
  
  
Capability AreaUser NeedsArchitect Responsibility
**Remote Access**
UN-1 to UN-4Define secure session management, gateway routing, consent, endpoint availability, transfer, failure handling, and audit architecture.
**Automation & Systematic Data**
UN-5 to UN-6Define ingestion, checksum validation, retry, endpoint targeting, execution, results, and observability patterns.
**Access Governance**
UN-7 to UN-9Architect visibility groups, RBAC, least privilege, and customer-owned JIT approval workflows.
**Unity Master-Data Synchronization**
UN-10Define system-of-record integration, reconciliation, ownership, synchronization, and failure-handling architecture.
**Multiple User Populations**
UN-11Define identity federation, population classification, policy enforcement, authorization, and auditable access patterns.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience designing enterprise software, industrial IoT, connected-product, remote-service, or similar technology solutions.
* 5+ years of hands-on ThingWorx architecture or senior development experience, including ThingWorx 9.x and/or 10.x.
* 3 to 5 years of strong experience with ThingWorx Composer, modeling, Mashups, services, events, subscriptions, security, persistence, deployment, and integrations.
* 3+ years of demonstrated experience with Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) or comparable ThingWorx solution/building-block architecture.
* 3 to 5 years of strong understanding of ThingWorx Thing Templates, Thing Shapes, Data Shapes, asset hierarchies, services, and persistence models.
* Experience designing secure remote-access, endpoint-management, connected-device, or fleet-automation solutions.
* Strong knowledge of RBAC, identity federation, segmented/multi-tenant visibility, approval workflows, audit logging, and least-privilege security principles.
* Experience designing enterprise REST/API and event-driven integrations.
* Experience integrating platforms such as Salesforce, IAM/IdP, CMDB, SAP, monitoring, and logging systems.
* Ability to translate functional requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into technical architecture and implementation guidance.
* Strong experience with architecture governance, design reviews, technical risk management, and documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with technical, security, operational, business, and executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ThingWorx Developer, Model Specialist, Deploy Specialist, or equivalent certification.
* Hands-on experience with SCPA extension points, custom building blocks, reusable components, and upgrade-safe architecture.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of SAML, OAuth/OIDC, Microsoft Entra ID, identity federation, and privileged-access management.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and ThingWorx persistence architecture.
* Experience designing high-availability ThingWorx environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and automated deployment.
* Experience working within regulated healthcare, medical-device, life-sciences, cybersecurity, or quality-controlled product environments.

Expected Deliverables
  
  
The Technical Solution Architect will be responsible for producing and maintaining:
  
  

* Solution Architecture Document
* Context, container, component, and integration diagrams
* SCPA fit-gap assessment
* Configure / Integrate / Extend / Custom-build recommendations
* ThingWorx Thing and asset model
* Data and persistence architecture
* Security and RBAC model
* Identity and federation architecture
* Visibility-group design
* Remote-access architecture
* JIT privileged-access workflow design
* Endpoint automation architecture
* Unity/Salesforce integration design
* API, event, and data contracts
* Non-functional requirements
* Operational and observability architecture
* Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
* Threat-model inputs
* Technical risk and mitigation plans
* Migration and coexistence architecture
* Deployment and release architecture
* Technical standards and implementation guardrails
* Architecture and design-review outcomes

Measures of Success
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:
  
  

* Deliver an architecture that provides clear traceability to approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Maximize the use of SCPA standard configuration and reusable building blocks wherever practical.
* Minimize unnecessary customization and technical debt.
* Ensure custom development is justified, governed, testable, maintainable, reusable, and upgrade-safe.
* Build security, auditability, least privilege, resiliency, scalability, and operational supportability into the architecture from the outset.
* Provide development and delivery teams with clear architectural decisions, interfaces, standards, and non-functional expectations.
* Enable successful migration to the next-generation SmartConnect platform with minimal disruption to existing users and operations.

Key Skills
  
  
**ThingWorx 10.x | Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA) | ThingWorx Architecture | Industrial IoT | Connected Products | Thing Modeling | Thing Templates | Thing Shapes | Data Shapes | Mashups | REST APIs | Remote Access | Endpoint Management | RBAC | JIT Access | Identity Federation | SAML | OIDC | Microsoft Entra ID | Salesforce Integration | PostgreSQL | Azure | Security Architecture | API & Integration Architecture | High Availability | Observability | CI/CD | Solution Architecture**
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. 58c6c1b8.title: Solution Architect – AI, Automation & Finance Transformation
58c6c1b8.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
In the
**Finance and Corporate Strategy**
team we ensure that the business’s capital strategies are operationally supported and strategically focused. This is how we work to secure the greatest return on investment for the global company. By gathering and analysing financial data we can influence decisions within the business, drive initiatives, and help ensure alignment with our wider objectives. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of enterprise AI, automation and analytics solutions across the Finance Transformation portfolio. This is a design-and-decide role with real accountability: the architect sets the target-state architecture, chooses the platforms and patterns, secures approvals from enterprise technology, security and data governance, and then stays close enough to delivery to guarantee that what ships matches what was designed.
  
  
The role sits between business intent and technical execution. It translates finance and operations problems — forecasting, reporting, reconciliation, transfer pricing, deal support, backlog analytics — into solution designs that are scalable, secure, governable and supportable, and it holds the line on architecture standards when delivery pressure argues otherwise.
  
  
It is an advanced role, but not a detached one. The architect is expected to write code when a pattern needs proving, run the proof of concept personally, and lead engineers and vendor teams through the build rather than handing over a deck and stepping away.
  
  
**Architecture Ownership**

* Own the target-state architecture for AI, GenAI, agentic AI and automation solutions across the Finance Transformation portfolio, and maintain the roadmap that moves the estate towards it.
* Produce solution architecture artefacts to enterprise standard: context and component diagrams, integration and data-flow designs, sequence flows, non-functional requirements, and documented architecture decision records with the options considered and the rationale for the choice.
* Make and defend build-versus-buy, platform-selection and pattern decisions, stating explicitly the trade-offs in cost, delivery time, supportability and risk.
* Define reusable reference architectures, solution patterns and shared components so that each new use case starts from an established baseline rather than a blank page.
* Own non-functional design across performance, scalability, availability, cost, observability and supportability, and set the acceptance thresholds each solution must meet before production.
* Run design reviews and technical governance forums, and take solutions through enterprise architecture review, security review and data governance approval.
* Maintain a current view of the solution landscape — what exists, what it depends on, what is being retired — and prevent duplicate or divergent builds across teams.

**AI and Agentic Solution Design**

* Architect LLM and agentic solutions end to end: orchestration and agent topology, tool and function calling, retrieval and grounding strategy, memory and state, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behaviour when the model is wrong.
* Design retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise content, including chunking and embedding strategy, index design, source-of-truth selection, freshness and permission-trimmed retrieval.
* Define the evaluation and assurance approach for AI solutions: golden datasets, accuracy and groundedness measures, regression testing on prompt or model change, and the criteria that decide whether a solution is fit to go live.
* Design guardrails and responsible-AI controls covering prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination containment, PII handling, auditability of AI-assisted decisions, and the boundary between what the agent decides and what a person approves.
* Set the model strategy — model selection, routing, versioning, cost and token management, and the approach to upgrades — and revisit it as the platform landscape moves.
* Determine where machine learning, deterministic automation, or a conventional application is the right answer, and say so plainly when generative AI is not the appropriate tool for the problem.
* Design the data architecture underpinning AI and analytics use cases: source systems, ingestion patterns, curated layers, semantic models, lineage and refresh cadence.
* Architect solutions on Microsoft Azure, Greenlake and Databricks, selecting the appropriate compute, storage, orchestration and serving components for each workload.
* Design integration architecture across enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Anaplan, ServiceNow and Power BI, covering API, event and batch patterns, error handling, idempotency and reconciliation between systems.
* Define identity, access and secrets architecture using Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, managed identities and role-based access control, and ensure least-privilege design is applied rather than assumed.
* Set the deployment architecture across environments, including CI/CD approach, promotion path, environment parity, configuration management and rollback strategy.
* Design for control and audit readiness where solutions touch financial data, including SOX-aligned controls, evidence capture, segregation of duties and traceability from output back to source.

**Delivery Leadership**

* Lead engineers, data teams and vendor partners through implementation, reviewing designs and code against the agreed architecture and correcting drift early.
* Build proofs of concept personally to de-risk unproven patterns, and convert what is learned into a documented pattern the team can reuse.
* Break large initiatives into deliverable increments with clear technical dependencies, sequencing and defensible estimates.
* Identify architectural risk, technical debt and single points of failure early, quantify the impact, and put a remediation path in front of decision-makers before it becomes an incident.
* Support production stabilisation after release, lead root-cause analysis on significant technical failures, and feed the findings back into the architecture.
* Raise the technical capability of the team through design mentoring, code and design review, internal enablement sessions and written guidance.

**Stakeholder and Governance Engagement**

* Work directly with Finance, Operations and Transformation leadership to understand the business problem behind the request, and challenge the requirement where the stated ask will not deliver the intended outcome.
* Present architecture, options, cost implications and risk positions to senior business and technology stakeholders, adjusting depth to the audience without diluting the substance.
* Partner with enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, DataOps and compliance teams to secure approvals and keep solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Manage vendor and partner technical engagement, including solution assessment, scope definition, design review and acceptance of delivered work.
* Contribute to portfolio-level planning by advising on feasibility, effort, sequencing and platform readiness across competing initiatives.

**What You Need To Bring**
Architecture
  
  

* Demonstrable experience owning solution architecture for enterprise systems that reached production and remained in service, not proof-of-concept work alone.
* Strong command of integration architecture, API design, event-driven patterns, and data architecture across transactional and analytical estates.
* Proven ability to produce architecture documentation and decision records that withstand enterprise architecture and security review.
* Experience designing for non-functional requirements — scale, resilience, performance, observability and cost — with evidence that the design held in production.

AI and Automation
  
  

* Hands-on experience architecting and delivering GenAI or LLM-based enterprise solutions, including RAG, tool and function calling, and agentic orchestration.
* Working knowledge of agentic frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Copilot Studio or equivalent, with a clear view of where each fits.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI or comparable enterprise LLM platforms, including evaluation, guardrails and cost management at scale.
* Understanding of the machine learning lifecycle — feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring and drift — sufficient to architect ML solutions and govern the teams building them.
* Experience with enterprise automation and RPA platforms, and sound judgement on where automation beats an AI-first approach.

Engineering
  
  

* Strong hands-on Python, retained and current — able to prototype, review code credibly and debug a production issue.
* Strong SQL and practical experience with Databricks, cloud data warehouses and modern data pipelines.
* Solid grounding in Microsoft Azure services, containerisation, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Platform and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem as delivery surfaces for finance solutions.

Domain
  
  

* Experience delivering solutions in enterprise Finance — forecasting, financial reporting, reconciliation, transfer pricing, deal desk, tax or order and backlog analytics.
* Understanding of financial controls, audit expectations and the governance constraints that apply to systems handling financial data.

**Preferred Skills**

* Recognised architecture certification, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks or TOGAF.
* Experience establishing AI governance, model risk or responsible-AI frameworks in a regulated enterprise.
* Experience defining reusable platform capabilities or an internal developer experience adopted across multiple teams.
* Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimisation for AI and data workloads.
* Experience operating in a global organisation across multiple regions and time zones.

**Candidate Profile**

* Thinks in systems and trade-offs, and can hold both the enterprise view and the implementation detail at once.
* Makes decisions under incomplete information, records the reasoning, and revises the position when evidence changes.
* Retains genuine hands-on credibility and earns the respect of engineers by doing the work, not by title.
* Communicates with equal effectiveness to a CFO stakeholder and to a data engineer.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements, and able to shape a defensible scope from an open-ended problem.
* Willing to say no, or not yet, with reasoning and an alternative attached.
* Takes ownership beyond the design phase and treats production outcomes as part of the architect's accountability.

**Experience And Education**

* Ten or more years in software engineering, data or AI, including at least three years in a solution architecture or technical lead capacity.
* A track record of architecting and delivering multiple enterprise solutions into production and through post-release support.
* Recent hands-on delivery of GenAI or agentic AI solutions in an enterprise setting.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline. Equivalent industry experience will be considered.

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
  
  
**Let's Stay Connected**
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Engineering

TCP\_05

Our goal is to be one global team that is representative of our customers, in an inclusive environment where we can continue to innovate and grow together. 72e6bfe7.title: Solutions Architect
72e6bfe7.description:
**Role Summary**

The HCL Now Solution Architect defines and architects customer solutions across the HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud portfolio, guiding engagements end-to-end from initial opportunity through go-live and into steady-state operation. The role combines deep cloud-native architecture expertise with hands-on delivery ownership: understanding stakeholder requirements, designing scalable and secure solutions, maintaining architectural standards, controlling cloud cost and risk, and resolving issues throughout the customer lifecycle. Solution Architects typically support multiple concurrent engagements across the HCL Software product portfolio — including HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL CDP, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL iControl, Mosaic, Mosaic Vibe Studio, and others.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Assess customer IT landscapes and design end-to-end cloud-native architectures meeting business, security, and scalability requirements.
* Define migration roadmaps and architecture blueprints; drive solution standardization and templatization for reuse.
* Architect data and analytics components (pipelines, storage, reporting) to meet customer data-driven requirements.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Support Sales in scoping HCL Now / HCL Business Cloud opportunities and lead technical discovery with customers.
* Deliver Product Cloud Workshops and act as the customer's trusted technical contact from opportunity through go-live.

**Delivery, Onboarding & Automation**

* Guide deployments on HCL SoFy; templatize onboarding procedures and drive automation with DevOps/CloudOps.
* Apply AI-driven DevOps practices to automate delivery pipelines, monitoring, and operations.
* Mentor delivery engineers and provide technical oversight to keep implementations aligned to architectural intent.

**Cost, Performance & Risk Management**

* Own cost modeling and FinOps-driven cloud cost optimization; monitor sizing and resolve bottlenecks.
* Support performance, scaling, and DR testing; identify and mitigate architecture risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Feed recurring QC issues and customer learnings back to Product and DevOps teams.
* Stay current on cloud-native trends and HCLSoftware roadmaps; build reusable reference architectures for the practice.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record designing and delivering complex customer solutions in public and hybrid cloud architectures, ideally in a customer-facing or professional-services context.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying workloads on at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), with Architect-level (or equivalent) certification strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes and containerization (Docker), including implementation, setup, infrastructure, networking, and security on cloud.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, DB2, Oracle, or Aerospike.
* Solid, practical understanding of modern networking and interconnection options, security architecture, and global compliance and security standards.
* Deep understanding of design and integration patterns, and of solution standardization and templatization.
* Solid understanding of core AI concepts (ML fundamentals, generative AI, LLMs) and their application to cloud solutions.
* Proven implementation experience with HCLSoftware products — e.g., HCL Commerce, HCL Unica, HCL Workload Automation, HCL Digital Experience, HCL CDP, HCL iControl, or HCL MyXalytics — or a comparable enterprise software portfolio, including migrating, upgrading, and onboarding these products.
* Understanding of data migration strategy and the ability to work with product teams on execution.
* Business and technically savvy, with big-picture vision and the ability to articulate the solution vision to both internal and external audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and analytical/problem-solving skills, with a keen, continuous-learner mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* Experience with architecture design tools such as Visio, Draw.io, or Lucidchart.
* Prior experience with cloud migration factories, migration tooling, or "as-a-service" delivery models.
* Experience in a presales or solution-consulting capacity, including proposal and estimation support.
* Exposure to DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and observability/monitoring tooling.

**Travel**

Approximately 15% travel required (+/-).

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. Master's Degree

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.
* Experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty).
* Ability to architect highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

ef681bc2.title: Senior Technical Customer Solution Manager, India CSM Team
ef681bc2.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
At AWS, we are leading the cloud revolution in India. As a Senior Technical Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in India, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration and modernization outcomes for the customer in relation to AWS Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to your customer. You will leverage your program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand your customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Technical Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration across the customer organization. You will use the AWS Transformation Guide and other mechanisms, to inform the customer migration journey.
  
  
#aws-ags-india
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 9+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Job Purpose:**

The Senior Principal Engineer – Digital Marketing Cloud Platform Engineering is a critical member of GSK Digital Marketing Cloud Platform Services team. This role is accountable for technical leadership within and across GSK technical teams for GSK Digital Marketing Cloud Hosting technical solution design, implementation & continuous improvement of Commercial D&T/GSK Internet Cloud systems in alignment with Agile and DevOps Principals, working closely with other Solution Principal Engineers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, Release Managers and Product Directors.

This position is a “T-Shaped” role demonstrating both depth and breadth across key cloud and engineer competencies e.g. Cloud Hosting, Solution Development, Innovation/Automation, Testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD and Lifecycle Management, etc. and the ability to successfully collaborate with technical experts from other subject domains.

The role will have deep knowledge and experience of GSK and industry Cloud and Internet technologies, practices and frameworks e.g. Cloud Hosting, Internet Services, IaaC, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe AMCS, GIT, Jenkins, Google GCP, AWS, Azure clouds, Akamai EWAF, Kanban, JavaScript, Python, Docker, Tealium, Gigya, Terraform, and the ability to learn and adapt to new solutions quickly.

In addition, the individual must be knowledgeable in Cloud Internet Architecture Design and Governance to support and educate others. They also act as a consultant between the engineering teams, UX/UI team, Strategic Partner support teams, and product owners and maintain a safe working environment for the team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, enhance, implement, and support the adoption of the Internet Cloud standards and support that is successfully implemented across GSK Digital Marketing Services and other Tech Teams simultaneously.
* Works as a technical leader within Digital Marketing Platform Services team, as well as internal and external stakeholders, to influence and drive technical standards, architecture and decision making and support organizational Cloud technical, project or product teams.
* Contributes and aligns solutions to the Digital Marketing Platform roadmap, Target Architecture working closely with various GSK Enterprise Architecture teams.
* Extensive understanding of Internet DNS with ability to manage large DNS services for GSK Internet platform (over 3,000 domains managed).
* The continuous delivery of technology solutions from product roadmaps adopting SRE, Agile, and DevOps Principals.
* Ensures that technical delivery is fully compliant with GSK Security, Quality and Regulatory standards, Security of services is always Job #1.
* Ensures use of relevant Commercial D&T / central services and collaborating with service partners in identification and delivery of service improvements.
* Supports product teams to deliver value continuously, fostering and maintaining close links with customers, related Solution groups e.g. Global Therapy Areas, Marketing Operations Center (MOC), Design Center (DC) and GP&T.
* Manages and keeps relevant technical documentation up to date in support of the lifecycle plans and always ready for audits/reviews.
* Pro-actively engages in experimentation and innovation to drive relentless improvement e.g. to Cloud Hosting, UX/DQ/DI and reducing technical debt/risk
* Provides technical leadership, technical direction and GSK expertise to teams composed of GSK FTEs, strategic partners and software vendors.
* Contributes to release planning and roadmaps working closely with Digital Marketing stakeholders.
* Contributes to the advancement, visibility, and improvement of Cloud Hosting practices within the organization (DevSecOps, Cloud FinOps, Cyber Security, etc.)

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

fea30093.description:

The organization specializes in ServiceNow modules such as ITSM, HRSD, ITOM, AIOps, IRM, Strategic Portfolio Management, as well as AI Control Tower, Moogsoft AIOps, AI agents, and enterprise AI governance. This full-time remote role includes leading discovery and design workshops, defining technical standards, and configuring and integrating ITOM modules such as Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB. * Candidates should possess Software Development and Integration skills, including hands-on experience with ServiceNow configuration/customization, scripting, APIs, and integrating ServiceNow with third-party systems.
* Candidates should possess ServiceNow platform expertise, particularly in ITOM modules (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB), and familiarity with ITSM, AIOps, and related ServiceNow products.
* Candidates should possess strong communication and documentation skills, including the ability to produce clear solution designs, technical specifications, and client-facing presentations.
* Experience in enterprise IT operations, ITIL/ITSM practices, and cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, on-prem) is beneficial.
* Relevant certifications such as ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (ITOM), ServiceNow Certified System Administrator, or equivalent industry certifications are preferred.

Bachelor masters degree in computer science Information Technology or a related field

Overall of 12 years and minimum 8 years of experience implementing, solutioning and administering ServiceNow ITOM capabilities including Discovery Service Mapping and CMDB integration

Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure components including servers networks cloud platforms containers and applications

Proven ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision

Exceptional interpersonal skills including teamwork facilitation and negotiation

Strong knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture modules and functionalities

Hands on experience in configuring Business Rules Client Scripts UI Policies UI Scripts UI Actions UI

Experience in developing ServiceNow integrations using APIs web services and data

Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between complex technical solutions and nontechnical business stakeholders

Strategic thinker who can develop long term roadmaps while staying engaged at the operational level

Collaborative team player who works effectively with technical teams business users and vendor partners

**Certifications**

CSA and CIS associated to ITOM is required. CTA would be preferable.

97458746.title: Technical Delivery Manager - Applied AI and Engineering Management
97458746.description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**About The Team**
We have outgrown traditional "Tools and Automation". Our new identity as the Applied AI and Engineering team reflects our bold vision: engineering a self-correcting, multi-agent ecosystem that pioneers the blueprint for the autonomous Google enterprise.
  
  
The Applied AI and Engineering team is responsible for architecting, deploying, and scaling agentic workflows, production-grade intelligence systems, and self-healing systems across Google Operations using modern internal and external technologies (including Gemini, Vertex AI, and advanced foundational models). This team goes beyond isolated automations to design coordinated, self-correcting multi-agent architectures that fundamentally transform how Google runs its global operations.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Technical Delivery Manager in the Google Operations Center, you'll play a critical role in overseeing the development and delivery of our essential internal tools and applications. You'll collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders across Google to define project scope, manage timelines, mitigate risks, and ensure successful execution. If you have a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions, a deep understanding of software development lifecycles, and exceptional communication and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply!
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Organizational Leadership: Manage and develop a team of Developer Leads. Provide regular coaching, mentoring, and performance management to elevate their leadership capabilities and support their career growth.
* Workflow Oversight: Serve as the focal point of contact for internal and external project queries, ensuring that the team’s actions remain in synergy with broader business goals.
* Strategic Alignment: Ensure the development teams' work aligns with the overall strategic goals and roadmap of the Google Operations Center. This includes understanding the big picture and translating it into actionable plans for the teams.
* Cross-Team Coordination: Work with domain experts, Full stack, UX, and PM to translate project requirements into technical tasks.
* Risk Management and Mitigation: Proactively identify and assess potential risks that could impact project delivery, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues as needed to ensure timely resolution.
* Dependency Management: Identify and manage dependencies between different projects and teams, ensuring that roadblocks are removed and projects are delivered efficiently.
* Process Optimization: Continuously analyze and improve development processes, workflows, and tools to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall team performance. This could involve implementing Agile best practices, refining communication channels, or introducing new technologies.
* Project and Process Governance: Establish and enforce delivery frameworks across traditional and AI initiatives. For standard projects, drive SDLC compliance, quality gates, and SLA adherence; for AI projects, oversee model lifecycle governance, including validation, responsible AI standards, and drift monitoring.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary liaison between engineering, product, operations, and executive leadership. Translate technical and AI constraints into business trade-offs, manage expectations via structured reporting, and align priorities across distributed teams.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience: 12y+ in technical project management, with a focus on maintenance & core development with multiple dev models like agile / scrum / waterfall.
* People Management: 7y+ people management experience involving performance management .
* Strong Experience in Project Planning and Scheduling, Team Coordination, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, Resource Management, and Quality Assurance
* Excellent organizational skills to track project / scrum timelines, roadmaps, and deliverables.
* Strong Experience in end to end Software Development Life Cycle
* Experience with multiple full lifecycles from Design & Architecture through Development, Testing, Deployment and Debugging production issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Having as many of these specific qualifications is a plus, but transferable skills/experiences may be equally valuable:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience in SQL, Python, database concepts.
* 5y+ experience using GIT based continuous integration & delivery
* Experience with Cloud Computing platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS
* Experience in Middleware development/design (remote procedure call based, publish subscribe based, etc…)

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Operations Center (GOC) jobs profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to GOC's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.
  
  
Google Operations Center (GOC) is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
  
  
To ensure a barrier-free interview, please mention any required assistance or specific arrangements in your application and confirm them with your recruiter.
  
  
To all recruitment agencies: Google Operations Center (GOC) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, GOC employees, or any other organization location. GOC is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
  
  
*Thanks for your interest in this opportunity! Our recruitment team will contact you if your profile is a good fit for the role. If you don't hear from us within 2-3 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time. We value your patience throughout this time. For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at goc-candidate-global@googleoperationscenter.com.*
