* Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited institution.
* 15+ years of experience out of which at least 2+ years of Program Management or Technical Product Management experience in a technology-oriented organization.
* Physical Layer and Protocol layer experience on AT LEAST ONE High speed SERDES on Ethernet/PCIe/CXL/UCIe
* Experience in PCIe/UCIe LTSSM states / UCIe Interfaces / Ethernet standards
* Proficient with Ethernet, PCIe, UCIe standards and Protocols. Proven experience to interpret the standard’s specification reg. Protocol, Interoperability and Compliance test suites

* Demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically when executing the project and solving problems.

Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical individuals.

ec783f06.title: Google Workspace Delivery Manager
ec783f06.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional technical teams, stakeholders, and external deployment partners.
* Experience programming in one or more of the following: Java, Python, Go, C++, or similar programming languages.
* Experience with cloud computing, IT systems integration, and deploying enterprise Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions (specifically Google Workspace).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Professional certification in Google Workspace Administration or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of the Workspace or equivalent products and a clear, business-oriented grasp of its principles and potential, and ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value for an executive audience.
* Demonstrated record in implementing cloud or software projects in corporate environments.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical tradeoffs to both executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage the end-to-end delivery and technical strategy for Google Workspace deployments, ensuring architectural alignment and smooth data migrations from legacy systems.
* Act as the central interface, coordinating complex technical requirements between customers, internal cross-functional teams, and external system integrators.
* Define project scope, establish baselines, and manage schedules while identifying and mitigating risks to successfully deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Conduct regular service reviews, monitor service level agreements (SLAs), and track quality metrics to ensure optimal service delivery and customer satisfaction.
* Guide customers through technical change management and user adoption strategies to help them maximize the value of their Google Workspace investment.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

3822e4ea.title: Senior Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant – Solution Advisory & Presales
3822e4ea.description:
**About the Role**

AIM is seeking a commercially minded Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant who can connect business needs with technology, lead compelling customer conversations, and turn opportunities into clearly defined projects.

This role combines business discovery, functional solution design, project scoping, presales, demonstrations, and marketing support. You will work closely with our sales, delivery, and marketing teams to help customers understand the value of Dynamics 365 and establish a practical path to implementation.

The ideal candidate brings experience across **ERP and CRM**, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core Dynamics 365 area and the ability to shape solutions across interconnected business processes.

**Exceptional presentation and communication skills are a critical success factor.** You must be able to engage executives, facilitate productive workshops, explain complex concepts clearly, and deliver persuasive demonstrations grounded in customer needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Business Discovery and Solution Design**

* Lead discovery workshops with executives, business leaders, and operational teams.
* Understand customer objectives, business processes, pain points, existing systems, and reporting requirements.
* Translate requirements into future-state processes and recommended Dynamics 365 capabilities.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments, prioritizing standard functionality and identifying justified extensions or integrations.
* Define phased implementation roadmaps with clear outcomes, priorities, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with specialists and technical architects to validate cross-application, integration, security, and data migration requirements.
  

**Project Scoping and Estimation**

* Develop statements of work covering deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, customer responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
* Break projects into workstreams and estimate functional effort, collaborating with technical and delivery leads to validate the overall plan.
* Identify risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and factors that could affect cost or timelines.
* Recommend implementation phases that balance business value, budget, and delivery capacity.
* Ensure a complete handover from sales to delivery, maintaining alignment between customer expectations and project commitments.
  

**Presales, Presentations, and Demonstrations**

* Partner with sales to qualify opportunities and assess customer needs and solution fit.
* Lead executive presentations that connect Dynamics 365 capabilities to business priorities.
* Build and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting the customer’s industry, processes, and challenges.
* Use clear storytelling to explain how a solution improves day-to-day work and business performance.
* Respond confidently to questions, manage objections, and communicate tradeoffs honestly.
* Clearly distinguish standard functionality from configurations, integrations, and custom development.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, executive presentations, and customer workshops.
* Maintain reusable demonstration environments, scripts, and business scenarios.
* Support licensing discussions alongside licensing specialists.
  

**Marketing and Practice Development**

* Collaborate with marketing to create solution one-pagers, presentations, webinars, demo videos, and campaign content.
* Translate technical capabilities into compelling business use cases and customer outcomes.
* Present at customer events, partner sessions, and webinars.
* Help develop repeatable assessments, implementation packages, and industry-specific offerings.
* Bring customer insights and recurring requirements into AIM’s service development process.
  

**Delivery Collaboration**

* Support functional design, configuration, testing, training, and adoption where required.
* Maintain continuity between the proposed solution and implementation.
* Help resolve functional questions and assess change requests during delivery.
* Mentor junior consultants and improve discovery, documentation, and demonstration standards.
  

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of Dynamics 365 functional consulting experience, including multiple completed implementations.
* Ideally, experience across **both ERP and CRM**, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core area:
  + **ERP:** Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management.
  + **CRM and service applications:** Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, or Project Operations.
* Ability to lead discovery across interconnected business processes, scope cross-application solutions, and engage specialists where deeper expertise is required.
* Demonstrated experience leading discovery workshops, fit-gap assessments, tailored demonstrations, and project scoping.
* Strong understanding of business processes within the candidate’s primary area of expertise.
* Experience producing clear requirements, process maps, functional designs, proposals, and statements of work.
* Familiarity with Power Platform and the role of automation, analytics, and integrations within Dynamics 365 solutions.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with sales, technical, delivery, and marketing teams.
  

**Critical Success Factor: Presentation and Communication**

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

* **Executive presence:** Confidence and credibility when engaging senior decision-makers.
* **Clear communication:** Ability to explain complex business and technology concepts in accessible language.
* **Compelling demonstrations:** Ability to tell a coherent story through customer-specific workflows and outcomes.
* **Strong facilitation:** Ability to ask thoughtful questions, listen actively, manage discussions, and build alignment.
* **Persuasive business writing:** Ability to produce clear proposals, scopes of work, presentations, and marketing content.
* **Audience awareness:** Ability to adapt the level of detail and message for executives, business users, and technical teams.
* **Commercial judgment:** Ability to communicate value, address objections, and set realistic expectations.

**Candidates should be prepared to deliver a short solution presentation or demonstration and discuss how they would scope a customer opportunity as part of the interview process.**

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a Microsoft partner or consulting organization.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications.
* Experience with legacy ERP or CRM migrations.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, and agent-based business scenarios.
* Experience developing packaged services, industry solutions, or marketing content.
* Background in finance, accounting, supply chain, professional services, or customer operations.
  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers understand the proposed solution, its business value, and the implementation approach.
* Presentations and demonstrations build confidence and advance qualified opportunities.
* Scopes of work contain realistic estimates, clear assumptions, and achievable commitments.
* Delivery teams receive complete, actionable handovers.
* Sales and marketing gain reusable assets that strengthen customer engagement.
* AIM develops a more repeatable and scalable Dynamics 365 practice.
  

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You combine functional expertise, commercial judgment, and outstanding communication. You can move confidently from an executive conversation to a detailed process workshop, then translate what you have learned into a compelling demonstration and a well-defined project scope. You take ownership and understand the delivery implications of the commitments you make.

1d9fc1d0.title: Solutions Architect
1d9fc1d0.description:
**About Anthrasec**

Anthrasec is a UK AI and IT services company and a member of the AWS Partner Network.
At Anthrasec, our mission is to build software that makes people's lives better and to make sure it can be trusted. We design and develop secure applications where protection is part of the foundation, not an afterthought. Every decision, from architecture to deployment, is made with the safety of the people and businesses who depend on the software in mind.

We also believe that new technology should not be out of reach or risky for the businesses that want to use it. Emerging technologies such as AI, automation, and cloud platforms can open real opportunities, but adopting them without guidance can expose organisations to serious risk. We work alongside our clients to understand what is worth adopting, how to adopt it safely, and how to make it work for their people and their goals.

We measure our work by whether the technology we build makes life simpler, safer, and more productive for the people who use it.

In that future, businesses of every size can embrace emerging technologies without fear of the risks. They have a trusted partner to help them adapt, and they can innovate quickly because security is built into everything they create.

Anthrasec aims to be that partner: the company organisations turn to when they want to build the technology of tomorrow, and be confident it is ready for the challenges that come with it.

**Role purpose**

As our Solutions Architect, you'll be the technical bridge between our clients, our delivery engineers and our product team. You'll design secure, scalable and cost-effective solutions on cloud, hybrid and AI platforms, lead the technical side of client engagements from discovery to delivery, and help shape Anthrasec products based on real customer needs. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company: you'll design solutions, build proofs of concept and influence how Anthrasec grows.

**Key responsibilities**

*Solution design and architecture*

* Turn business requirements into well-documented solution architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP and on-premises or hybrid environments.
* Design landing zones, network topologies, identity and access models, data platforms and disaster recovery strategies in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
* Write and maintain architecture decision records, high and low-level designs, and reference architectures.
* Make sure every solution meets non-functional requirements: security, resilience, performance, scalability and cost.

*Client engagement and presales*

* Lead technical discovery workshops with client stakeholders, from founders to IT managers.
* Produce technical proposals, statements of work, effort estimates and pricing inputs together with leadership.
* Run demos and proofs of concept, and answer security questionnaires and requests for proposals.
* Be the trusted technical adviser on client accounts and find chances to improve and expand our work with them.

*AI and automation*

* Design production-grade AI solutions using large language models: retrieval-augmented generation, agent and tool-use systems, guardrails, evaluation and monitoring.
* Advise clients on AI adoption: model choice (managed services such as Amazon Bedrock and Azure OpenAI, open-source or self-hosted), data privacy, cost control and responsible AI governance.
* Help define products's integration architecture with ITSM, observability, identity, hypervisor and cloud platforms.

*Security and compliance*

* Build security into every design: zero trust, least privilege, segmentation, encryption, secrets management, logging and threat modelling.
* Map solutions to UK and international frameworks, including Cyber Essentials, ISO/IEC 27001, UK GDPR, NCSC guidance.

*Delivery and governance*

* Hand designs over to delivery engineers with clear infrastructure-as-code patterns (OpenTofu or Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Provide design authority and assurance during delivery, and review changes against agreed architecture standards.
* Keep track of cloud costs and recommend FinOps improvements.

*Thought leadership and growth*

* Contribute reference architectures, whitepapers and guides to Anthrasec's free resources hub.
* Represent Anthrasec at AWS Partner Network events, webinars and industry meetups.
* Mentor engineers and interns, and help build our architecture practice as the company grows.

**Essential skills**

* Deep, hands-on AWS knowledge: VPC networking, IAM and Organizations, Control Tower, EC2, EKS and ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, GuardDuty and Security Hub.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Intune and Conditional Access.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, plus configuration management with Ansible.
* CI/CD and DevOps practice with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, containers and Kubernetes.
* Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPNs, firewalls and hybrid connectivity.
* Solid security architecture knowledge: identity, zero trust, segmentation, encryption, and logging and monitoring.
* Able to produce clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

**AI skills**

* Experience designing and deploying LLM-based applications: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, and agent or tool-calling patterns.
* Familiar with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI or self-hosted open-source models (for example through Hugging Face, Ollama or vLLM).
* Understands AI security and governance: prompt injection, data leakage, evaluation and red-teaming, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and the UK AI Cyber Security Code of Practice.
* Able to judge cost, latency and accuracy trade-offs when choosing models and architectures.

**Desirable skills**

* Experience with GCP.
* Virtualisation and on-premises platforms: VMware vSphere and ESXi, Proxmox, Hyper-V.
* Observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk or Elastic.
* ITSM and integrations: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, and REST APIs or webhooks.
* Scripting or programming in Python, Go, TypeScript, Bash or PowerShell.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or building integrations for AI agents.
* Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimisation.
* Experience in regulated sectors such as healthcare, finance, education or the public sector.

**Qualifications**

* *Essential:*
   AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
* *Highly desirable:*
   AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* *Desirable (any of):*
   AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), CKA, HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, CISSP or CCSP, or an AWS or Azure AI certification.
* A degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**Personal attributes**

* A hands-on builder who's comfortable going from a client workshop to writing infrastructure code on the same day.
* Commercially aware, with a focus on what clients actually need.
* Self-driven, organised and comfortable with the ambiguity of an early-stage company.
* Curious, with a habit of continuous learning in AI, cloud and security.
* Collaborative, with clear written and spoken communication.

**What we offer**

* The chance to shape the architecture practice and products of a fast-growing AI and security company from the ground up.
* Remote-first, flexible working.
* A funded certification and training budget.
* Direct influence on Anthrasec product direction.

**Equal opportunities**

Anthrasec is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive, diverse workplace. If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Our certified consultants bring extensive expertise to support clients through each phase of their Oracle HCM journey, from initial planning to deployment and ongoing maintenance. **About Us**
Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
  
  
In the UK we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From motorways to tramways, and nuclear power plants to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges - delivering climate-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Solution Architect is responsible for defining, ensuring consistency, and strengthening the robustness of IS architectures within the EARTH ecosystem scope (ERP, HCM, CRM, E-PROD “Project and Portfolio Management” and complementary SaaS solutions).
  
  
This is a high-visibility role for a transformational leader, offering the opportunity to work extensively with international IT and business high-level stakeholders. Working closely with the ERP Ecosystem Run (L2-L3) Delivery Manager and the Middleware integration leader, the Solution Architect will contribute directly to the stability, performance, and evolution of the EARTH solutions ecosystem, reducing structural incidents, and strengthening end-to-end business process fluidity & data quality.
  
  
What do we need from you
  
  
**Solution & Technical Architecture**

* Own the target and existing architecture for the EARTH ecosystem, covering applications, interfaces, data flows and key dependencies across Oracle Fusion ERP, HCM, PPM and satellite solutions.
* Define, document and enforce architecture standards, integration patterns, API principles, data-flow models and technical design guardrails.
* Ensure end-to-end solution consistency, scalability, security, maintainability and alignment with enterprise architecture principles. Business–IT Alignment
* Translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions, working closely with Business Analysts, BPOs, IT leadership and delivery teams.
* Support prioritization of technical choices based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency and long-term reusability.
* Reduce the gap between business expectations and delivery by clarifying solution options, impacts, constraints and arbitration points. Project Framing, Design and Build-to-Run
* Contribute to project framing and design phases, validating integration within the existing ecosystem and anticipating impacts on Run, supportability and performance.
* Embed operability, monitoring, documentation and support requirements from the design stage to secure smooth Build-to-Run transition. Challenge customization, duplication and technical complexity to limit technical debt and promote reusable core model capabilities.

**Contribution to Run and Continuous Improvement**

* Provide L3 expertise on major incidents and recurring structural issues, identifying root causes related to interfaces, data, dependencies or solution design.
* Drive actions to improve IS stability, performance, data quality and end-to-end business process fluidity.
* Promote automation, monitoring, knowledge capitalization and AI-assisted practices to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Governance and Capitalization
* Contribute to sustainable architecture governance across a multi-application, multi-country and multi-stakeholder environment.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical decision-making forums and solution arbitration with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership.
* Establish reliable documentation for architectures, interfaces, data flows, decision records and operational knowledge base content.

**Essential Experience**

* Significant experience as a Solution Architect, Lead Architect or Senior Functional/Technical Architect in complex enterprise application environments.
* Strong exposure to Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle HCM; experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, OCI and integration architecture is highly expected.
* Experience working across Build and Run contexts, including project framing, solution design, support transition, incident analysis and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to operate in international, matrixed and multicultural organizations with both IT and business stakeholders. Technical & Functional Expertise
* Deep understanding of ERP, HCM, CRM, PPM and complementary SaaS ecosystems, with the ability to assess dependencies, data flows and integration impacts.
* Knowledge of Dynamics 365 CRM B2B is a plus; experience with Planview or comparable PPM solutions is appreciated.
* High ownership, curiosity, resilience and capacity to work in a changing environment where documentation and governance are still being strengthened.
* Strong command of architecture documentation, interface mapping, data-flow modelling, technical debt management and architecture governance practices.
* Good understanding of ITIL-oriented Run processes, especially incident, problem, change, release and knowledge management. Leadership & Soft Skills
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure complex topics, identify root causes and propose pragmatic architecture options.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to align diverse stakeholders and explain technical matters to senior business and IT audiences.
* Balanced strategic and operational posture, combining long-term architecture vision with hands-on pragmatism in Run and delivery contexts.

**Sucess Metrics**
Architecture for the EARTH ecosystem is progressively documented, controlled and shared with Run, Build and Enterprise Architecture stakeholders.
  
  

* Reusable solution patterns, integration standards and data-flow principles are defined and applied across new initiatives.
* Structural incidents and recurring root causes linked to solution design, interfaces or data quality are reduced through corrective architecture actions.
* Business–IT alignment improves through clearer arbitration, stronger architectural governance and better readability of solution impacts. WORKING CONDITION
* Build-to-Run handovers become more reliable, with clear documentation, supportability requirements and operational readiness checks.
* Location: Bangalore, India. This is an office-first role; remote work is permitted only on an occasional and exceptional basis.
* International Exposure: This role involves frequent collaboration with European time zones and global teams, requiring flexibility and strong cross-cultural communication skills.

What's in it for you?
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience: Typically, 10+ years of experience in enterprise applications, including at least 5 years in solution architecture, integration architecture or senior ERP/HCM architecture roles.
* Preferred background: consulting, system integration, large international IT organization, global ERP transformation program or complex SaaS ecosystem management.

8a713df9.title: IT Solutions Consultant
8a713df9.description:
**Technical Consultant – API Management Platform Resiliency**

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.

**No AI Without API. Digitalization. Simply delivered.**

Join us at DHL Group Digital Platforms department, where innovation thrives and technology evolves. With a presence across three countries and two continents, we are building a One Stop Shop for all DHL Group APIs and AI-enabled services. Our startup spirit within a stable enterprise environment enables us to deliver secure, scalable, and modern platforms powered by Agile and DevSecOps practices.

**About the Role**

Join the API Management Platform (AMP) Resiliency team and strengthen the availability, recoverability, scalability and operational resilience of enterprise API services. The role assesses platform risks, defines resilience standards and recovery requirements, and drives improvement initiatives across cloud and on-premises environments.

The position requires knowledge of both Apigee X, Apigee Hybrid or another enterprise API gateway to support the resilience of our API management platforms. You will work across DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to improve disaster recovery, business continuity, service readiness and operational controls.

**#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #digitalplatforms #APIPlatform #Resiliency #Cloud**

**Grow together**

**Your role as Technical Consultant - AMP Resiliency:**

* Coordinate platform resilience assessments, technical risk reviews and improvement roadmaps.
* Assess platform architecture for single points of failure, capacity constraints, service-dependency risks and recovery limitations.
* Define platform resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and operational-readiness requirements.
* Identify critical service dependencies and support the definition and validation of recovery objectives.
* Plan, coordinate and govern disaster recovery, failover and recovery-readiness exercises; validate evidence, document outcomes, identify gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Define and maintain resilience standards, runbooks, support procedures and service-readiness documentation.
* Establish minimum resilience and operational-readiness criteria for platform services.
* Work with DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to address availability, capacity, connectivity and recovery risks.
* Define and review monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboarding, observability and service-health reporting requirements.
* Assess the resilience and operational impact of vulnerabilities, BitSight findings, security findings and control gaps; coordinate remediation plans and monitor actions through closure.
* Support incident reviews and root-cause analysis, converting lessons learned into preventive improvements.
* Review platform changes, upgrades and architecture decisions for their impact on availability, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Report material risks, unresolved gaps, dependencies and remediation progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Promote consistent resilience practices across API gateway technologies and hosting models.
* Participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required, providing resilience, recovery and cross-team coordination expertise.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here's what we are looking for:**

* Demonstrated experience in platform operations, infrastructure consulting, service reliability, SRE, disaster recovery or enterprise API platform support.
* Practical knowledge of both Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, failover, capacity management and operational risk.
* Experience assessing technical architectures for resilience, recoverability and operational-readiness risks.
* Experience planning or governing disaster recovery and recovery-readiness exercises.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, observability and service-health reporting.
* Understanding of networking, connectivity, certificates, security controls and platform dependencies.
* Experience with incident management, problem management and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to define technical standards, produce clear assessments and drive cross-team remediation activities.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management and technical-consulting skills.
* Willingness and ability to participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with SRE practices, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation or cloud platforms.
* Experience supporting security and compliance remediation in an enterprise environment.
* Knowledge of GCP and API platform network-connectivity patterns.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, Kubernetes and automation concepts.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre-existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

Understand end-to-end application architectures diagrams (data ingestion to data consumption to AI/ML).

Prepare detailed ADM effort estimates for application maintenance and enhancements and get them validated with AI & Data capability SMEs.
  
  
Design optimal staffing models based on onshore/offshore/nearshore mix and pyramid structure.
  
  
Build solution plan power point decks for use in sales and delivery alignment.
  
  
Engage in solution and delivery reviews with leadership across geographies.
  
  
Act as the strategic link between sales and delivery teams.
  
  
Contribute to client-facing proposals, SOWs, and contracting documents.
  
  
Present and defend your solution in internal and external forums.
  
  
Seamlessly transition the solution to the delivery team post-deal closure.
  
  
Travel may be required for this role.  The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on business need and client requirements.
  
  
Here’s What You Need:
  
  
Must Have: Strong Data engineering or Business intelligence or AI/Gen AI experience in application maintenance projects
  
  
Working knowledge of cloud ecosystems – Azure or AWS, or Google Cloud.
  
  
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, filters, vlookup etc.).
  
  
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  
Experience working in cross-functional and global environments.

Location: Any city having Accenture office.

Good PowerPoint skills for leadership and client storytelling.
  
  
External client-facing experience

The engineer also leads asset-data quality and lifecycle improvements across Jira Service Management (JSM) Assets, Axonius, Tenable, Lansweeper, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise platforms, partnering with Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Application Services, Network, Endpoint, and ITSM teams.

  
Primary Skills

* Enterprise CMDB architecture, administration, governance, and object-schema design; Jira/JSM and JSM Assets.
* Axonius, Lansweeper, Tenable, AWS, Azure, discovery, IT asset management, and cloud asset lifecycle management.
* API integrations, workflow automation, data normalization, correlation, reconciliation, deduplication, and reporting.
* ITSM/ITIL configuration-management practices, application/service mapping, troubleshooting, and stakeholder collaboration.

  
Key Responsibilities  
1. CMDB Architecture, Governance & Data Quality

* Design and maintain CMDB data models, CI classes, attributes, relationships, ownership models, lifecycle states, naming standards, and mandatory data-quality rules.
* Define authoritative data sources and reconciliation priorities; automate CI creation, updates, validation, certification, archival, and retirement.
* Maintain accurate relationships across applications, services, servers, databases, network devices, endpoints, cloud accounts/resources, and storage services.
* Identify and remediate duplicate, stale, orphaned, incomplete, or inaccurate records; support audits, certification, compliance reviews, and governance reporting.
* Maintain technical documentation for schemas, relationship models, integrations, governance standards, and operational procedures.

  
2. Cloud Modernization & Cloud CMDB Schema Development - Priority

* Design a scalable CMDB/JSM Assets model for AWS Organizations, organizational units, accounts, regions, applications, environments, and cloud resources, with reusable onboarding patterns for migration waves.
* Model AWS services including EC2, EBS, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC/network components, load balancers, IAM-related identities, backup/recovery, storage, and application/platform services.
* Automate onboarding so new AWS accounts and resources are discovered, normalized, reconciled, related, updated, and retired with minimal manual intervention using AWS APIs, AWS Config, Axonius, and approved inventory sources.
* Use stable identifiers such as account IDs, ARNs, regions, and tags; establish required metadata for ownership, application, environment, service, cost center, support group, and lifecycle status.
* Extend object schemas and integrations to Azure, particularly subscriptions, resource groups, storage accounts, containers, file shares, and related application/service relationships.

  
3. Tenable, Axonius & Asset Hygiene - Priority

* Partner with Cybersecurity and Infrastructure teams to define governed asset inclusion, aging, retention, suppression, pruning, and retirement criteria across Tenable, Axonius, and the CMDB.
* Identify stale, transient, decommissioned, duplicated, incorrectly correlated, unowned, or undiscovered assets while protecting valid assets that are temporarily offline or subject to maintenance cycles.
* Reconcile hostnames, IPs, serial numbers, cloud IDs, agent IDs, operating systems, owners, support groups, and lifecycle states across Tenable, Axonius, CMDB, Lansweeper, endpoint, network, AWS, and Azure sources.
* Automate exception identification, review/approval, remediation, CMDB updates, pruning evidence, and reporting to improve vulnerability-management coverage and auditability.

  
4. Axonius Automation, Discovery & Inventory

* Configure and optimize Axonius connectors, queries, correlation rules, dashboards, reports, workflow triggers, notifications, and API-based automations.
* Monitor connector health, collection schedules, authentication, source coverage, and data freshness; troubleshoot mapping, correlation, synchronization, and automation issues.
* Configure and optimize discovery/inventory solutions, including Lansweeper, and integrate discovery sources with the CMDB for CI creation, updates, relationship mapping, and retirement.
* Improve discovery coverage for remote endpoints, cloud-hosted workloads, network devices, virtual infrastructure, and segmented environments; manage discovery failures, stale records, duplicates, and unclassified assets.

  
5. Application, Service & Cloud Storage Mapping

* Maintain business application, technical application, application service, platform service, and infrastructure relationships, including ownership, criticality, support groups, environments, lifecycle states, recovery needs, and service dependencies.
* Map applications and services to AWS/Azure resources, databases, storage, servers, network components, and security assets; keep current-state and target-state relationships accurate through cloud migrations and retirements.
* Design and maintain schemas and discovery/reconciliation processes for S3, EBS, Azure Storage accounts, blob containers, file shares, and other approved storage services.
* Identify cloud/storage resources that are unowned, untagged, unused, incorrectly classified, or missing from the CMDB and support lifecycle, migration, audit, and security reporting.

  
6. Jira Service Management, Integration & Automation

* Configure and enhance Jira/JSM workflows, forms, fields, request types, permissions, notifications, queues, SLAs, automation rules, and JSM Assets schemas to support CMDB, asset, cloud-onboarding, discovery, and security processes.
* Integrate CMDB, Jira/JSM, Axonius, Lansweeper, Tenable, AWS, Azure, and other systems using REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled imports, scripts, and approved integration platforms.
* Automate cloud CI onboarding, relationship mapping, resource updates/retirement, Axonius-to-CMDB synchronization, Tenable/Axonius reconciliation, stale-asset workflows, duplicate detection, ownership/tag validation, discovery exceptions, and certification/audit reporting.
* Define source-to-target mappings, transformation and reconciliation logic, monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, retry processes, access controls, and version-controlled technical documentation.

  
7. CMDB Health, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

* Develop dashboards and metrics for completeness, correctness, compliance, uniqueness, freshness, discovery coverage, ownership, relationship completeness, reconciliation success, cloud-tagging compliance, pruning status, and integration/connector health.
* Establish measurable thresholds and improvement targets; lead root-cause analysis for recurring data issues and track remediation through completion.
* Provide actionable reporting to technical owners, service owners, management, security, audit, and governance stakeholders.

  
Immediate Role Priorities

* AWS Cloud Modernization: scalable CMDB/JSM Assets schemas, automated onboarding, application/service mapping, and storage visibility for AWS/Azure resources.
* Tenable and Axonius hygiene: governed, auditable pruning/suppression of stale, duplicate, invalid, and decommissioned assets with stronger reconciliation and security coverage.
* Automation and data quality: expand Axonius/Jira/API workflows for ownership, tagging, lifecycle, exceptions, CMDB updates, and measurable health improvements.

  
Required Qualifications

* Strong experience designing, administering, governing, or improving an enterprise CMDB, including cloud infrastructure and application/service schemas.
* Hands-on Jira/JSM and JSM Assets (or comparable CMDB/asset platform), plus Axonius connectors, correlation, queries, reporting, and automation.
* Experience with Lansweeper or comparable discovery/inventory tooling and Tenable or another vulnerability-management platform.
* Working knowledge of AWS account structures, resource types, APIs, tagging, lifecycle management, and cloud governance; relevant Azure infrastructure/storage experience.
* Experience integrating systems through REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled imports, scripts, or automation platforms, with strong data normalization, reconciliation, and deduplication skills.
* Strong ITIL/ITSM, troubleshooting, reporting, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional stakeholder-management skills.

  
Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting large-scale AWS migration/Cloud Modernization; familiarity with AWS Organizations, AWS Config, CloudTrail, Azure subscriptions/resource groups, Azure Resource Graph, and Azure Storage.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Groovy, or similar scripting and with Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or comparable infrastructure-as-code tools.
* Knowledge of service mapping, vulnerability-management asset lifecycle, regulated/audited environments, and relevant ITIL, Jira, Axonius, AWS, Azure, or asset-management certifications.

  
Measures of Success

* Standardized, scalable cloud CMDB schemas and automated AWS onboarding with minimal manual intervention.
* Improved alignment across CMDB, Axonius, Tenable, Lansweeper, AWS, and Azure, with measurable reductions in duplicate, stale, orphaned, unowned, and untagged assets.
* Governed asset pruning, stronger discovery/security coverage and application-to-cloud relationships, reduced manual effort through automation, and improved CMDB health and stakeholder confidence.

dc138214.description:
**About the Role**

  

Gartner Consulting partners with clients to solve their most critical business and technology challenges through collaborative problem solving, and increasingly delivers production-grade solutions alongside its advisory work. We are looking for a hands-on Power Platform & Copilot Solutions Architect to own the architecture and delivery of Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot solutions – both internal assets used by Gartner consulting associates and client-facing solutions deployed in client environments.

This is an all-rounder role: you will articulate solution value to clients, design and build the architecture yourself, lead delivery in client engagements, and guide Power Platform engineers to deliver. You will enhance existing Gartner solutions and build new ones.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

**Client Engagement & Solutioning**

  

* Work with clients and Gartner consultants to understand business problems and translate them into clear, practical solution designs.

* Communicate solution value to business and technical stakeholders; support pre-sales through demos, solution approaches, effort estimates and proposal inputs.

Lead discovery workshops and convert outcomes into requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.  

  

**Architecture & Hands-on Build**

  

* Architect and build solutions using Model-driven and Canvas Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Power BI.

* Design and build Copilot Studio agents (generative orchestration, topics, tools, knowledge/RAG, autonomous triggers, multi-agent patterns) and Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents.

* Deliver integrations using REST/OData APIs, custom and HTTP connectors with Microsoft Entra ID authentication, and Azure services; extend with JavaScript and C# plugins where needed.

Understand, maintain and evolve existing Gartner assets, and create reusable components and patterns across engagements.  

  

**Delivery Leadership**

  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery lifecycle in client engagements – planning, estimation, sprint delivery, testing/UAT, deployment, hypercare and handover.

* Guide, review and mentor Power Platform engineers; set design and development standards and conduct solution reviews.

Manage scope, risks and dependencies; provide clear status updates to engagement leaders and client stakeholders.  

  

**Governance, ALM & Platform Administration**

  

* Administer and govern Power Platform via the Power Platform Admin Center – environment strategy, Managed Environments, DLP policies, security roles, capacity and licensing.

* Own ALM: managed/unmanaged solutions, connection references, environment variables and Power Platform Pipelines/Azure DevOps across DEV, QA and Production.

Set up monitoring and adoption tracking using Copilot Studio analytics, Azure Application Insights, and Copilot Studio Kit; embed security and responsible AI practices.  

  

**What You Will Need**

  

**Must Have**

  

* 5–7 years of overall experience, with hands-on Microsoft Power Platform delivery.

* Strong expertise in Power Apps (Model-driven and Canvas), Power Automate, Dataverse (data modelling, security, business rules) and Power BI.

* Hands-on Copilot Studio experience, including generative AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, knowledge sources and agent evaluation/testing.

* Experience with Power Platform administration, governance, environment management and ALM/deployment pipelines.

* Integration experience with REST APIs, custom connectors, Microsoft Entra ID (app registrations, authentication) and Azure services.

* Experience leading small delivery teams and owning end-to-end delivery of client or enterprise projects.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology and explain solutions simply to senior audiences.  

  

**Good to Have**

  

* Microsoft certifications such as PL-600, PL-400 or PL-200; Azure AI certifications are a plus.

* Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

* Pro-code skills in JavaScript, C# (.NET) or TypeScript for Dataverse plugins and client-side extensions.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience, or exposure to AI strategy and governance solutions.

32634056.title: Solution Architect - SCON
32634056.description:
**Global Cyber Solution Hub**

Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect

**Global Consulting Services**

Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Senior Consultant**

The Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect will join the Global Cyber Solution Hub and support Deloitte member firm teams on strategic and complex Cyber opportunities. The role will help pursuit teams turn business and technical requirements into practical Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions. It will bring relevant leading practice methods, assets, alliance relationships, and delivery experience into the pursuit process.

This is an internal advisory role. The Solution Architect will work with pursuit teams, Cyber Defense & Resilience leaders, specialists, and delivery teams across the Deloitte network. The primary focus will be shaping differentiated solutions across areas such as security operations, managed detection and response, threat detection engineering, cyber incident response, technology resilience, attack surface management, and cyber recovery. This aligns with Deloitte's Cyber Defense & Resilience offering that helps clients detect, respond to, recover from, and build resilience against cyber threats.

**Work you'll do**

**Solution shaping and technical win strategy**

* Shape Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions for strategic and complex pursuits, including the operating model, delivery approach, service architecture, and technical win themes
* Work with pursuit teams to understand the opportunity and define the role Cyber Defense & Resilience should play in the overall solution
* Use Deloitte methods, assets, and tools to structure a differentiated solution
* Develop the scope, key assumptions, effort estimate, transition approach, and staffing model
* Collaborate with pricing specialists so the commercial model reflects the solution and delivery approach
* Review solution designs for feasibility, differentiation, and fit with the client need
* Support Deloitte firm teams as they prepare for solution workshops, proposals, demonstrations, and oral presentations
Help teams articulate outcomes related to threat detection, response effectiveness, operational resilience, incident readiness, and business continuity  

**Cyber Defense & Resilience domain leadership**

* Bring experience across security operations, attack surface management, threat intelligence, managed detection and response, incident response, cyber recovery, and resilience capabilities
* Support development of operating models for SOC modernization, MXDR, and managed security services
* Help pursuit teams evaluate technology ecosystems and alliance opportunities that strengthen the defense and resilience proposition
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI, automation, orchestration, and advanced analytics into Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions
Review proposed service levels, performance measures, operating procedures, and governance approaches to support sustainable operations  

**Cross-cyber integration**

* Identify where Cyber Defense & Resilience should connect with Enterprise Security, Digital Identity, Cyber Operate, or our other offerings
* Help teams bring Cyber into broader transformation pursuits when there is a clear client need
* Review priority opportunities identified through the intake process and shape the Cyber Defense & Resilience scope where it adds value
* Consider how the solution will move from advisory and implementation activities into ongoing operations and managed services
Connect resilience and recovery requirements with broader technology transformation and business continuity objectives  

**Global coordination and pursuit support**

* Act as a force multiplier for Deloitte firm pursuit teams by bringing Global assets, proof points, and operational experience into the opportunity where appropriate
* Connect teams with Cyber Defense & Resilience specialists, delivery centers, and alliance resources
* Build working relationships with offering leaders and technical specialists across the Deloitte network
* Coordinate existing expertise and materials rather than recreate work already available elsewhere in Deloitte
Keep assumptions, dependencies, transition considerations, and open decisions clear so the Deloitte firm team can approve the final approach  

**AI-enabled solution development**

* Use approved AI tools to support research, solution workshops, and development of proposal content
* Assess how AI, automation, and intelligent operations could improve the security solution or delivery model
* Support development of solution concepts into demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and operational use cases
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI-driven detection, response, threat analysis, and operational efficiencies into solution architectures
Apply professional judgment when reviewing AI-generated content and remain accountable for the quality of the final work  

**Assets and offering development**

* Turn successful pursuit approaches into reusable solution patterns, playbooks, operating models, and reference architectures
* Capture qualifications and proof points that can support future opportunities
* Contribute Cyber Defense & Resilience content to sales materials and other Global Cyber priorities
* Feed pursuit insights back to Global Cyber Defense & Resilience leadership to help improve the offering
Maintain reusable content in line with confidentiality, intellectual property, and data-handling requirements  

**The Team**

Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help organizations strengthen their ability to detect, respond to, recover from, and adapt to cyber threats. The portfolio includes security operations, attack surface management, threat detection and response, cyber incident readiness and recovery, managed extended detection and response (MXDR), threat intelligence, and technology resilience services. Deloitte helps organizations modernize security operations, improve incident preparedness, accelerate response, and build resilience across business and technology environments.

The Global Cyber Solution Hub supports Deloitte member firm teams on priority opportunities across the Cyber portfolio. This global team helps teams shape solutions, locate relevant expertise, and reuse proven materials. Deloitte member firms remain responsible for the client relationship, approvals, and final deliverables.

**Qualifications**

Must have skills / project experience / certifications

* 5 to 8 years of experience in cyber consulting, security operations, incident response, cyber resilience, managed security services, or a solution architect or presales architect role
* Experience supporting large or complex pursuits
* Depth in one or more Cyber Defense & Resilience domains, such as SOC transformation, MXDR, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, attack surface management, incident response, cyber recovery, or technology resilience
* Demonstrated ability to shape a solution from operating model and service architecture through delivery model and estimate
* Ability to explain and defend a technical approach with senior pursuit stakeholders and technical specialists
* Commercial fluency, including an understanding of managed services pricing models, margin considerations, and deal constructs
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce proposal-ready content and a clear presentation narrative
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams
Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities  

**Good to have skills / project experience / certifications**

* Practical use of approved AI tools in proposal drafting, research, or solution development
* Familiarity with Deloitte methods and the Global Cyber offering portfolio
* Experience with leading cyber defense technologies, security operations platforms, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, cloud-native security tooling, or attack surface management solutions
* Experience with managed security services and transition-to-operate programs
* Experience working with global delivery centers or distributed teams
* Relevant credentials such as CISSP, GIAC certifications, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCFE, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Security certifications, or equivalent technical certifications
Experience incorporating automation, orchestration, AI, and analytics into security operations  

**Education:**

* BE, B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or an equivalent degree from an accredited university

**Location:**

* Deloitte US-India Offices, based on applicable talent and business requirements

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

In this role, you will spearhead architectural blueprints, define target-state topologies, and deliver resilient, production-ready enterprise platforms uniting Modern Lakehouse architectures with state-of-the-art Generative AI capabilities.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

* **End-to-End Architecture & Solution Design:** Lead architectural strategy, high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), and technical governance for enterprise Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and AI platforms using Azure Databricks and the Microsoft Azure cloud ecosystem.

* **Full Lifecycle Implementation Ownership:** Own the entire lifecycle of enterprise solution architecturefrom pre-architecture discovery, business requirements translation, and platform selection to architectural governance, reference designs, and production deployment.
* **Observability, Security & LLMOps:** Establish enterprise-grade guardrails including unified logging, exception handling, data lineage, LLM evaluation metrics (hallucination, ground truth, toxicity), RBAC, and model monitoring to guarantee platform resilience.
* **Technical Ownership & Code Governance:** Retain full architectural authority over complex modules, driving technical reviews, architectural decision records (ADRs), and enforcing best-in-class engineering benchmarks across teams.
* **Strategic Advisory & Collaboration:** Interface directly with client CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Data Scientists, and Business Consultants to articulate solution blueprints, trade-offs, and value delivery for mission-critical Data & AI ecosystems.
* **Mentorship & Capability Building:** Mentor senior data engineers and designers, establish reusable GenAI design patterns and accelerator frameworks, and spearhead organizational center-of-excellence (CoE) initiatives.

* **Architecture & System Design:** Enterprise Solution Architecture, HLD/LLD, Modern Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Medallion Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, Cost Optimization & Sizing
* **Generative AI & LLMOps (Mandatory):** Azure OpenAI, Databricks Mosaic AI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG Architecture, Vector DBs (Chroma, Pinecone, FAISS, Qdrant), Embeddings, Prompt Engineering, Model Evaluation, Guardrails
* **Core Cloud & Platform:** Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics
* **Data Engineering & Languages:** Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, SQL, Structured Streaming
* **Data Governance & Security:** Unity Catalog, Purview, Data Lineage, RBAC/ABAC, Data Privacy & Security Guardrails

  

Who We Are

Tiger Analytics is a global leader in AI and analytics, helping Fortune 1000 companies solve their toughest challenges. Our team of 4000+ technologists and consultants are based in the US, Canada, the UK, India, Singapore, and Australia, working closely with clients across CPG, Retail, Insurance, BFS, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Healthcare. 02e16c18.title: Director Principal Architect (AWS)
02e16c18.description:
**Job Description: AWS Field CTO**

Role Overview: We are seeking a highly strategic and experienced AWS Field CTO to lead our AWS practice and technology initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical evangelist, strategist, and solution architect for our AWS partnership. You will be responsible for driving offering and solution build, establishing thought leadership, accelerating internal engineering capabilities, and enabling presales, with a heavy emphasis on modern AWS data, analytics, and Generative AI technologies—specifically Amazon Bedrock, Amazon QuickSight, AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift.

**Core Responsibilities**

Offering & Solution Build

* Solution Ideation & Design: Conceptualize, design, and build innovative, enterprise-ready solutions on the AWS cloud stack, leveraging AWS Lake Formation and Amazon Redshift for unified data lakes/warehouses, and Amazon QuickSight for business intelligence.
* Tools & Accelerator Build: Develop proprietary tools, frameworks, and accelerators using AWS Generative AI services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, SageMaker JumpStart) to accelerate time-to-value for clients.
* Product Management: Collaborate with internal Studio and Product engineering teams to build, manage, and evolve AWS-centric offerings and repeatable solution blueprints.
* GTM Content & Collateral: Create compelling, partner-centric Go-To-Market materials, including technical content decks, battle cards, and solution briefs highlighting the ROI of AWS data and AI solutions.
* Solution Endorsement: Engage directly with AWS Partner Solution Architects and Partner Development Managers (PDMs) to secure official solution endorsement and joint GTM support.

**Thought Leadership**

* Public Speaking & Evangelism: Represent the company at major AWS events (e.g., AWS re-Invent, AWS Summits, Partner Forums), speaking on topics like cloud-native data architecture, modern analytics, and enterprise Gen AI adoption.
* Content Creation: Author and publish joint webinars, tech blogs, and whitepapers with AWS, showcasing success stories and cutting-edge implementations of Amazon Bedrock and QuickSight.
* POV Creation: Develop authoritative, partner-centric Points of View (POVs) on industry trends, serverless architectures, and how AWS technologies solve complex enterprise challenges.
* Mindshare Expansion: Actively cultivate and expand AWS mindshare both internally among consulting teams and externally across the ecosystem.

**Capability Acceleration**

* Product Roadmap Influence: Engage with AWS service teams and product managers to provide field feedback and influence product roadmaps for Bedrock, QuickSight, and AWS data services based on client requirements.
* Knowledge Community & COE: Establish and lead a Center of Excellence (COE) and internal community of practice focused on AWS Cloud, Data, and AI technologies.
* Innovation & POCs: Spearhead Proofs of Technology (POTs) and Proofs of Concept (POCs) on emerging AWS services and features (e.g., Bedrock agentic workflows, QuickSight Q, serverless analytics).
* Talent & Certification: Drive AWS certification programs across the practice. Onboard, mentor, and elevate technical talent across cloud engineering and data architecture disciplines.
* Partner Differentiation: Lead technical audits and assessments required to achieve and maintain key AWS Competencies (e.g., Data & Analytics, Generative AI, Migration) to differentiate our practice.

**Presales & Tech Enablement**

* Sales Enablement: Train and empower account executives and sales teams on pitching AWS offerings, positioning the strategic value of AWS Data and Gen AI services.
* AWS Professional Services Alignment: Establish joint engagement strategies and align closely with AWS Professional Services (ProServe) on strategic enterprise accounts.
* Presales Support: Provide high-impact presales architectural support on key pursuits, leading complex customer discovery sessions and technical proposals.
* Consumption & Cost Estimation: Architect cost-effective AWS solutions and prepare precise AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for large-scale data and AI workloads.
* Deal Expansion: Identify opportunities to expand client engagements by introducing new AWS services and modernization roadmaps.
* Delivery Oversight: Conduct delivery reviews and provide high-level technical governance for critical AWS client implementations.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of overall experience in IT architecture, software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical leadership roles.
* 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and building solutions specifically on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Proven experience operating as a Field CTO, Chief Architect, or Enterprise Solution Architect within the AWS ecosystem or a top-tier AWS Consulting Partner.
* Deep technical expertise in AWS Data & Analytics services (AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon EMR, Amazon QuickSight).
* Hands-on experience and strong architectural knowledge of AWS Generative AI and ML services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q, Vector Databases).
* Track record of public speaking, technical writing, and driving thought leadership in cloud technologies.
* Strong presales capability, with experience building AWS consumption models and driving deal closure.
* Relevant AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) are highly preferred.

dff96c0d.title: Oracle Cloud Inventory & Costing Lead

Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
Peloton is seeking an Oracle Cloud SCM Workstream Lead with deep expertise in Inventory and Cost Management to support large-scale Oracle Cloud implementations. This role is responsible for leading the Inventory and Costing workstream, driving solution design, and ensuring successful delivery aligned with client business objectives.
  
As an Oracle Cloud SCM Lead, you will partner with supply chain and finance stakeholders to design and implement solutions that improve inventory visibility, valuation accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Workstream Leadership & Delivery
  
- Lead the Inventory and Costing workstream across the full project lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
  
- Own solution design, configuration, and delivery for Inventory Management and Cost Management modules
  
- Manage workstream scope, risks, issues, and dependencies
  
Process Assessment & Solution Design
  
- Assess current-state inventory and costing processes and identify improvement opportunities
  
- Design future-state solutions aligned with Oracle Cloud best practices
  
- Define and refine business processes across areas such as: - Inventory transactions and controls
  
- Inventory valuation and costing methods (Standard, Average, FIFO, Actual)
  
- Cost accounting and subledger integration
  
  
Requirements Gathering & Configuration
  
- Lead workshops to gather and document business requirements
  
- Translate requirements into functional designs and system configurations
  
- Ensure alignment between business needs and Oracle Cloud capabilities
  
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
- Partner with Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Order Management teams to ensure end-to-end process integration
  
- Align Inventory and Costing with upstream and downstream processes (e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report)
  
Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement
  
- Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders on inventory and costing strategies
  
- Communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences
  
- Provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency and financial accuracy
  
Testing, Deployment & Support
  
- Lead testing activities (SIT/UAT), including scenario design and validation
  
- Support deployment, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization
  
Practice Development
  
- Contribute to continuous improvement of Peloton methodologies, accelerators, and intellectual property
  
- Mentor junior team members and support capability development
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience:
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  
- 7+ years of experience in Oracle SCM Cloud implementations
  
- Strong functional expertise in:- Inventory Management Cloud
  
- Cost Management Cloud
  
  
- Experience with costing methods such as:- Standard Costing
  
- Average Costing
  
- FIFO / Actual Costing
  
  
- Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Cloud SCM implementation
  
- Strong understanding of inventory processes, costing, and accounting impacts
  
- Ability to translate business requirements into system solutions
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  
- Ability to work independently in a remote, client-facing environment
  
- Alignment with Peloton values: Amplify Ideas, Can-Do Attitude, Teamwork, Integrity, Own Your Voice, and Next-Level Service
  
- Willingness to travel as required
  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Oracle Cloud certifications in Inventory Management and/or Cost Management
  
  
- Experience across broader SCM modules (e.g., Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing, Planning)
  
  
- Understanding of financial integration points (e.g., subledger accounting, GL impact)
  
  
- Experience supporting multi-pillar Oracle Cloud implementations (ERP + SCM)
  
  
- Experience mentoring junior team members
  
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including:
  
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

**Transformation Architect specializing in Data**
to lead the transformation of large-scale enterprise delivery programs for strategic clients. This role is ideal for a hands-on, client-facing architecture leader who can translate business challenges into modern data, analytics, and AI solutions.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience across
**enterprise data architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/data integration, Azure Data Factory (ADF), AI/BI, and Azure/AWS cloud environments,**
along with the executive presence to consult with clients, shape solution roadmaps, and lead transformation from strategy through implementation.

**What You Will Do**

l Serve as a
**client-facing Data Solution Architect,**
partnering with client executives, technology leaders, data teams, and delivery organizations to define and execute enterprise data transformation strategies.

**modernization roadmaps across data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, and data engineering.**

**data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure, and AWS.**

**data ingestion, ETL/ELT, lakehouse architectures, data warehousing, analytics, BI, and AI use cases.**

**cloud-based data ecosystems.**

**AI, advanced analytics, and BI**
to improve decision-making, automation, productivity, and customer experience.

l Data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and consumption

**Azure and AWS**
