l AI/BI strategy and architecture

l Generative AI and AI-enabled analytics

l Power BI and enterprise visualization

l Enabling AI/ML use cases through modern, governed data platforms

l Translating enterprise data into actionable business insights

**Delivery Transformation**

l Modernization of large-scale enterprise delivery environments.

l Global and offshore delivery models.

l Automation and productivity improvement.

l Governance, quality, security, and operational excellence.

**Core Skills & Experience**

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

l Strong experience designing
**enterprise-scale data architectures and modern data platforms .**

l Hands-on architectural experience with
**Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.**

l Deep understanding of
**ETL/ELT processes, data integration, data pipelines, and orchestration.**

l Experience designing and modernizing
**Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines.**

l Understanding of modern architectural patterns including
**lakehouse, data lake, and data warehouse architectures.**

l Experience integrating structured and unstructured data across multiple enterprise systems.

**Cloud**

l Strong experience with
**Microsoft Azure,**
particularly Azure-based data services.

l Experience working with
**AWS data environments**
and/or designing multi-cloud solutions.

l Experience migrating legacy data platforms and workloads to cloud-based architectures.

**AI, Analytics & BI**

l Experience designing data platforms that support
**AI, machine learning, GenAI, advanced analytics, and BI use cases**

l Strong understanding of how enterprise data architectures enable AI adoption

l Experience with
**Power BI and/or Tableau**

l Ability to connect technical data strategy to measurable business outcomes

**Architecture & Delivery**

l Experience designing integrations using APIs, microservices, and enterprise data services

l Understanding of DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD, observability, security, and data governance

l Ability to take solutions from
**discovery and architecture through POC, implementation, and enterprise-scale adoption**

**Qualifications**

**l 8+ years of experience**
in solution architecture, data architecture, data engineering, technology consulting, or enterprise transformation roles.

l Demonstrated experience architecting
**large-scale enterprise data and analytics solutions.**

l Strong experience with
**Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/ELT, ADF/data pipelines, and Azure and/or AWS cloud environments.**

l Experience leading
**data modernization or cloud data transformation initiatives**
from strategy through implementation.

l Strong enterprise consulting and client-facing experience, including the ability to lead discovery sessions and architecture discussions with senior technical and business stakeholders.

l Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and business value for executive audiences.

l Proven ability to lead cross-functional engineering, architecture, data, and delivery teams.

l Experience delivering measurable improvements across cost, scalability, performance, quality, and customer experience.

**Why This Role**

**data strategy, architecture, AI, and enterprise transformation.**

Nice to Have

b2815d0e.title: Integration Architect
b2815d0e.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) Business Process Owner

\_\_

We are seeking an experienced Integration Architect with a strong foundation in **full-stack development, specializing in .NET backend technologies and Microsoft Azure**. The ideal candidate will design scalable and secure solutions while providing technical leadership and aligning architectural strategy with business goals. Guides cross-functional teams through architectural decisions, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.

The preferred Working Model: Hybrid / Remote.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Design practical, scalable, and secure solutions using .NET and Microsoft Azure that meet business and product needs.
* **Integration & APIs:** Design and guide integrations between applications, APIs, internal systems, and external solutions to ensure smooth and reliable connectivity.
* **Technical Guidance:** Provide technical guidance to development teams across .NET, front-end, database, and cloud technologies, helping teams make sound technical decisions.
* **Azure Solutions:** Design and improve Azure-based solutions with a focus on performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
* **DevOps & Engineering Practices:** Support good engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, coding standards, and technical documentation.
* **Architecture & Security Standards:** Ensure solutions follow relevant architecture, security, data privacy, and development standards while keeping governance practical and effective.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage technical dependencies, address challenges, and support successful delivery.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions and support the long-term product vision.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical leadership within enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and designing modern, scalable applications and APIs.
* Good understanding of system integrations, microservices, event-driven architecture, databases, and modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Familiarity with DevOps and cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and infrastructure as code; experience modernizing existing or legacy applications is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, development teams, business stakeholders, and external partners in a global environment.
* Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ / CLM are preferred.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply. If you have .NET and Azure experience and enjoy designing solutions and collaborating across teams, we encourage you to apply.

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

* Working knowledge of Python, Lambda, Ansible and Terraform.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, automation and Jira.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and client communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* AWS, EDB or CKA certifications.
* Graduate in Computer Science, IT or Engineering.

4a6486dc.title: Managed Services Consultant
4a6486dc.description:
### **About ITRS**

At ITRS, we make society’s critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.

We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you’ll find:

* **A culture that backs you** – We’re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
* **Work that matters** – Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
* **Room to grow** – Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we’re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who’ve been excelling here for 10+ years.

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity–backed global partner.

### **Scope of Role**

Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client’s Geneos environment. We also work with our on-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.

### **As a Managed Services Consultant, you will:**

* **Monitor** ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.
* **Answer Client Queries** providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.
* **Restore Client Incidents** by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis** using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands-on implementation of technical solutions** to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors** and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests** by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information** by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions** improve products, services, or processes.

**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:**

* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.

* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

 **Requirements**  

### **You will have:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in a client-facing environment preferably in a financial institution or vendor and preferably in an IT Operations role.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Passionate about our client experience.
* Experience in Unix and Windows Operating Systems.
* Experience in one or more scripting languages such as Shell, Bash, Perl, XML.
* An understanding of Databases e.g. Oracle and an understanding of SQL.
* Willingness to work onsite at either our Pune or Mumbai office and flexibility to work on a rotational shift schedule, including night shifts as required.

### **A person in this role would benefit from the following:**

* Experience using or administering a real-time monitoring tool, e.g. Geneos, BMC Patrol, AppDynamics, Nagios.
* Exposure to an ITIL Operations environment.
* Experience of Application Support in Financial Services.
Deliver continuous improvement  

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements

ITRS is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.

We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

d86ddf82.title: Success Architect - Industry Specific
d86ddf82.description:
**Apply here :**

https://salesforce.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/External\_Career\_Site/job/India---Hyderabad/Salesforce-Senior-Architect\_JR322959

  

Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.

Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforces most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.

The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude:**

We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements:**

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**

* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

**2. Communication & Leadership**

* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.

**3. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving**

* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Desired Technical Skills:**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof-of-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years overall experience including 3+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre-sales and solution consulting customer-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.

* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

****Nice to Have****

* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Advisory Solution Consultant, Core Business Solutions is an expert pre‑sales professional who combines deep domain expertise across Core Business workflows (for example, HR Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery, Legal and Contract Operations, Finance and Procurement–related solutions) with advanced consultative selling skills. The Advisory Solution Consultant is a lead contributor in the Solution Consulting organization, a trusted advisor to customers and partners, and a mentor to other Solution Consultants. This role works closely with Sales to build and execute account penetration strategies in a defined market vertical and maintains strong external networks with customers and technology partners to identify and shape market opportunities. This is a hands-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Partner with Account Executives and broader account teams to develop and execute account penetration strategies for Core Business Solutions in a defined territory or vertical.
* Lead discovery sessions with customers to understand business objectives, challenges, and current processes across HR, Workplace, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and supplier management operations, and translate them into Core Business Solution opportunities.
* Design solution architectures and value‑based proposals on the Now Platform that align Core Business workflows to customer business outcomes, including cross‑workflow and cross‑platform scenarios.
* Deliver compelling, story‑driven product demonstrations and presentations that articulate the vision, value, and differentiation of ServiceNow Core Business Solutions to both executive and technical audiences.
* Lead complex pre‑sales engagements, including RFP responses, proof‑of‑concepts, and workshops, ensuring proposed solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with ServiceNow leading practices.
* Build and maintain strong, long‑term relationships with key customer stakeholders as a trusted advisor on Core Business transformation and the Now Platform.
* Develop and maintain relationships with Product Management and Development to provide field feedback, influence roadmap, and stay ahead on new capabilities across Core Business Solutions.
* Maintain an active external network with customers, partners, and industry communities to identify emerging trends, shape ServiceNow’s point of view, and uncover new market opportunities.
* Contribute to internal enablement, reusable assets, and best practices (e.g., demo scenarios, discovery frameworks, industry use cases) specific to Core Business Solutions.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* To be successful in this role you have:
* 8+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience or similar customer‑facing role (e.g., solution consulting, value engineering, product management with heavy customer engagement), ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.
* Deep domain expertise in at least one Core Business area (for example, HR Service Delivery, Workplace/Facilities, Legal and Contract Operations, Finance operations, Sourcing and Procurement, or Supplier Lifecycle operations), with the ability to credibly engage with senior business stakeholders.
* Proven track record designing and presenting end‑to‑end solutions that drive measurable business outcomes and value for customers.
* Strong consultative skills, including discovery, qualification, objection handling, and executive communication.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex pre‑sales cycles collaboratively with Sales and cross‑functional teams.
* Excellent presentation, storytelling, and demo skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and tailor messages to different audiences.
* Ability to work in a fast‑paced, matrixed, global environment and manage multiple priorities and opportunities in parallel.
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Travel, as necessary

**Success in This Role**

* Positive impact on pipeline creation and progression for Core Business opportunities.
* Win rate and deal quality for opportunities where you are engaged.
* Demonstrated mentorship and uplift of the broader Solution Consulting team.

FD21

**Job Description**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization

* 10+ years of related industry experience with FSI & Enterprise background
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus

Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

1276d865.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development.
  
  
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

3bb75979.title: Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Architect
3bb75979.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Compute & Cloud Architect in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your cloud and infrastructure expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a critical role in shaping the Alstom Transport strategy, designing compute and cloud services—especially public cloud services—and ensuring seamless integration of business solutions within Alstom’s infrastructure landscape. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as IS&T Business Partners, Projects, and Operations), evaluate new technologies, and contribute to strategic roadmaps, among other responsibilities.

  

You’ll specifically take care of designing and promoting public cloud services, but also providing technical assistance for business solutions within Alstom’s IT environment.

We’ll look to you for:
  
Responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing cloud architectures across public, private, and hybrid environments. This role ensures that cloud solutions are secure, scalable, cost-efficient, and aligned with business and enterprise architecture standards.
  
Acts as a technical leader, trusted advisor for stakeholders, and mentor for cloud and platform teams.

* Collecting and analyzing business demands from IS&T Business Partners
* Evaluating and integrating new technology solutions into strategic roadmaps
* Initiating and contributing to projects identified in strategic roadmaps
* Defining the service catalog and technological standards roadmap
* Participating in IS&T innovation initiatives
* Define and govern Kubernetes architectures ( AKS, OKE, OpenShift) Establish cloud-native architectural patterns
* Contributing to and validating project scoping, general design, and business cases
* Providing technical assistance and expertise in adopting public cloud services
* Collaborating with the global Compute & Cloud team to consolidate infrastructure strategies
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

Define cloud architecture solutions for complex enterprise systems
  
Design scalable, resilient, and secure architectures across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
  
Lead architectural decisions for cloud migrations, modernizations, and cloud-native initiatives
  
Establish reference architectures, patterns, and standards

**Technology Leadership**

Provide expertise and Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies
  
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance frameworks

**Security, Governance & Compliance**

Integrate security-by-design principles (IAM, encryption, network security, zero trust)
  
Ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements (ISO, GDPR, etc.)
  
Define cloud governance models (landing zones, guardrails, cost controls)

**Delivery & Transformation**

Partner with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver cloud solutions
  
Support large-scale cloud migration and transformation programs
  
Review and approve architectural designs and technical roadmaps
  
Optimize cloud cost management (FinOps best practices)

**Stakeholder Management**

Collaborate with business leaders to translate requirements into cloud solutions
  
Present architectural decisions to executive and technical stakeholders
  
Work closely with vendors, system integrators, and cloud service providers

* Degree in Engineering, preferably in Information Technology.
* Overall 10+ yrs, More than 5 years of experience in Architecture, with a focus on hosting and cloud services
* Certification as an Azure Solution Architect (AZ305) is mandatory
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Shell, Bash, Ansible, and Terraform
* Experience with operating systems such as Windows Desktop, RHEL, and Ubuntu
* Familiarity with DevOps tools like GitLab CI, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Terraform, Packer, Ansible, Git, and REST API
* Strong communication skills, efficiency, and ability to execute
* Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and a results-oriented mindset
* Fluency in English and eagerness to work autonomously in an international environment

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our dynamic and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards advanced leadership or technical roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Information Technology, IT Architecture, Developer, Solution Architect, Cloud, Technology

b68935fa.title: Bank IN Solution Architecture - VP
b68935fa.description:
Date live: 11/05/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131567

  

Join us as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VPat Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VP, you should have experience with:

* Work closely with engineers, QA engineers, UX designers, architects, and Scrum Masters to deliver high-quality software.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with engineering teams to define scalable, secure, and maintainable Android solutions.
* Define architecture, APIs, integrations, and cloud-based services.
* Support release planning and dependency management.
* Ensure product increments deliver measurable business value.

* Develop architecture roadmaps supporting the modernization and strategic evolution of the Core Banking estate.
* Identify opportunities to:
  + Reduce legacy technology risk.
  + Simplify architecture.
  + Reduce technical debt.
  + Improve automation.
  + Increase API enablement.
  + Improve resilience and recoverability.
  + Introduce appropriate cloud and container capabilities.
* Assess build vs buy vs reuse vs vendor-platform options and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support incremental modernization strategies that protect critical banking services while reducing transformation risk.
* Ensure near-term project decisions remain aligned with longer-term target architecture.
* Define and assure non-functional requirements covering:
  + Availability
  + Resilience
  + Recoverability
  + Performance
  + Capacity
  + Scalability
  + Security
  + Maintainability
  + Observability
* Assess failure modes and dependencies across Core Banking customer journeys.

* Exp with Fiserv in Core banking and account servicing capabilities, Customer, account, transaction and product integrations.
* Interfaces between Fiserv-based services and digital channels, payments, cards, data and downstream banking platforms.
* Experience with OpenText in Enterprise content and document-management capabilities supporting banking processes.
* Document creation, storage, retrieval, archival and records-management integrations.
* Integration of content-management capabilities with customer and operational journeys.
* TSYS experience with Card-processing and card-servicing capabilities.
* Account, transaction, authorization and servicing integrations.
* Integration between TSYS capabilities and core banking, digital channels, payments and supporting services.
* Define integration patterns between Core Banking platforms.
* Design solutions that minimize blast radius and avoid unnecessary single points of failure.
* Ensure architecture supports effective monitoring, fault diagnosis and operational support.

* Partner with Engineering and Operations teams to investigate complex performance, availability and integration issues.
* Ensure capacity and performance implications are understood before significant production changes.
* Act as the architecture interface between business, product, engineering, operations and enterprise technology teams.
* Technically challenge vendor proposals and ensure proposed solutions meet enterprise architecture requirements.
* Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to both senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influence stakeholders where immediate delivery objectives conflict with longer-term technology strategy or acceptable risk.
* Provide architecture input into commercial and technology discussions where vendor capability, licensing, infrastructure or product direction impacts strategic decisions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
  

  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based in Bangalore.

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.

**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

73144497.title: Senior Solutions Architect
73144497.description:
**Company Description**
Conversive is a demand capture and conversion platform focused on organizations where every customer decision has significant impact. The company helps businesses turn inbound customer inquiries across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, social channels, and voice into booked appointments, qualified opportunities, and closed deals through AI-orchestrated, compliant conversations. Conversive’s Conversational Harness connects each interaction to customer history, business rules, and CRM data, ensuring seamless, contextual experiences and efficient use of human judgment. Built for high-consideration decisions in sectors such as healthcare, mortgage, education, automotive, and legal, the platform deploys in days or weeks and writes outcomes back to CRM systems for clear revenue attribution. With 18 years of experience serving more than 5,000 organizations, Conversive operates on ISO 27001-certified infrastructure as a native Salesforce ISV and integrates with Zoho and other leading CRMs.

**Role Description**
The Senior Solutions Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, secure solutions on Conversive’s demand capture and conversion platform. This role involves collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, translating them into technical architectures, and leading end-to-end solution design across integrations, data flows, and application components. The Senior Solutions Architect will work closely with product, engineering, and implementation teams to guide software development efforts, validate designs, and ensure solutions align with best practices, performance, and compliance standards. Day-to-day activities include conducting technical discovery and consulting sessions, preparing architectural documentation, overseeing integration with CRM and communication systems, and supporting pre-sales efforts with demos and technical proposals. The role also includes mentoring junior team members, contributing to architecture standards, and continuously improving solution patterns for high-consideration industries.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and maintainable enterprise solutions.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Business Process skills to translate complex requirements into practical architectures and optimized workflows.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills, with experience in modern programming languages, APIs, and cloud-based application design.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills, including experience with REST/JSON APIs, webhooks, messaging platforms, and CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zoho or similar).
* Relevant experience in customer engagement, contact center, or conversational AI platforms is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience in industries such as healthcare, mortgage, education, automotive, or legal is a plus.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering

01899228.title: Senior Solution Architect - SAP S/4HANA
01899228.description:
**Title:**
Senior Solution Architect, Pre-sales, SAP S/4HANA

**Location:**
India

**Reports to:**
VP SAP S/4HANA Business

**Works with:**
Global Sales leaders, SAP account teams and Acuiti delivery

**Start:**
Immediate

**Who We are:**

Acuiti Labs is an SAP Endorsed Partner with a strong reputation in SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management). We help subscription, usage and consumption based businesses modernise how they monetise, bill and recognise revenue.

We are now launching a dedicated SAP S/4HANA business as a new growth engine. It will operate as a start-up within Acuiti Labs: entrepreneurial and fast moving, with the backing of an established partner's delivery capability, client base, SAP relationships and global footprint.

This is a rare chance to join an SAP practice as one of its founding

members and help shape how it wins in the market. Please visit our website.

https://www.acuitilabs.com/

* ***Most Innovative Companies in The UK, 2024***
* **Great Place to Work® Certified™ (2022 to Present)**

**What we believe in:**

We take pride in having a diverse and talented workforce spread across various geographical locations. We are a gender-neutral organisation and we strongly believe in Diversity and Inclusion. Our core values include:

* **Excellence**
* **Integrity**
* **Learning**
* **Organizational pride**
* **Respect**

**The Role:**

Acuiti Labs is hiring a senior solution architect to lead pre-sales for our new SAP S/4HANA business. You will bring broad S/4HANA solution expertise; good experience in SAP Finance will be a strong advantage.

**The mandate:**

Your job is to help win S/4HANA business. Working alongside the regional sales leader, you will be the trusted solution voice in front of clients: understand their business challenges, design the right S/4HANA solution, and build the proposals, demos and estimates that win the deal.

As a founding member of the practice, you will also build the pre-sales toolkit that others will use: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts and estimating models. Once a deal is won, you will make sure it moves smoothly into delivery with a solution the team can execute well.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Pre-sales and deal support**

* Partner with the regional sales leader on qualified opportunities, from discovery through to contract.
* Lead client discovery workshops with CFOs, CIOs and business leaders to understand their business and process requirements.
* Own the solution response for RFIs, RFPs and proposals, including scope, approach, assumptions, estimates and commercials.
* Plan and deliver compelling solution demonstrations and presentations, including SAP system demos where appropriate.

**Solution architecture**

* Design end-to-end S/4HANA solutions across core business processes, such as finance, order to cash, procure to pay and supply chain.
* Bring good experience in SAP Finance to client conversations where helpful, including financial accounting, controlling, the Universal Journal and financial close.
* Advise clients on the right route to S/4HANA, including RISE with SAP (Private Cloud), GROW with SAP (Public Cloud), and greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition approaches.
* Shape end-to-end architectures covering integration, SAP BTP, data migration and clean core principles.
* Where relevant, connect S/4HANA with order to cash, billing and revenue recognition, including Acuiti's SAP BRIM expertise.
* Establish and evolve Acuiti's S/4HANA architecture principles, reference architectures and design standards, ensuring consistency across opportunities

**Proposition and asset development**

* Help define Acuiti's S/4HANA offerings, including Finance and revenue transformation for complex billing and subscription businesses.
* Build reusable pre-sales assets: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts, estimating models and case studies.

**Expected outcomes**

Onboarded to Acuiti's propositions and BRIM capability; core S/4HANA solution collateral and demo in place; actively supporting pursuits with the sales leader

Months 4 to 6

Leading solution design on qualified opportunities; first S/4HANA win supported; strong working relationships with SAP pre-sales and account teams

Months 7 to 12

Contribution to multiple wins; repeatable pre-sales toolkit of reference architectures, estimators and demo scripts; smooth handover of won deals to delivery; case studies and thought leadership published

**Candidate profile: experience and expertise**

**Must Have**

* 12 or more years in the SAP ecosystem, including at least 5 years in pre-sales or solution architecture roles with an SAP partner, systems integrator or SAP.

* Strong understanding of RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP and S/4HANA migration approaches, and what it takes to deliver them well.
* Hands-on implementation experience as a solution architect, finance lead or functional lead on S/4HANA programs.

**Good to Have**

**What we look for:**

Mindset matters as much as experience. We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks like a founder.**
  Energised by building something new, takes ownership and creates assets others can reuse.
* **Works as one team.**
  Collaborates closely with sales, delivery, SAP and colleagues across the US, UK and India.
* **Is AI-native**
  . Uses AI to improve how presales and delivery are performed and helps shape our AI-enabled S/4HANA proposition.

**What we offer**

* The chance to be a founding member of a new SAP S/4HANA business and shape how it goes to market.
* The backing of an established SAP Endorsed Partner: delivery capability, SAP relationships, an existing client base and global teams spread across the US, UK, Netherlands and India.
* Direct access to, and partnership with, the practice leadership and Acuiti Labs leadership team.

Given Antier's work across Web3, Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise applications and technology services, the individual must possess the ability to understand emerging technologies, evaluate their business applicability and guide the development of solutions from conceptualisation to production.

This is a hands-on architecture and strategic technology leadership position. We are looking for someone who can independently establish technical direction, challenge existing approaches, guide engineering teams and contribute to building new technology capabilities and solutions from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

cc4b34a3.title: Solution Architect
cc4b34a3.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators who are focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

  

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

  

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies that rely on our best-in-class platform.

  

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
our wins.

  

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!

At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
  
Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.

  

We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
**SOLUTION ARCHITECT**
 to join 
**PROFESSIONAL SERVICES**
in
**INDIA.**
This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading.

  

**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**

  

**Insight on your impact**

  

We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

  

As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping & analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  

  

**Your qualifications, your influence**

  

*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills*

  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning & Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion**

**and Belonging**

  

Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

  

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

  

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

  

Anaplan does not:

  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  

  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

c5c945d7.title: Solution Architect Pre-Sales
c5c945d7.description:
**Position: Solution Architect Pre-Sales**

Experience: 12+ Years

Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in in Engineering / Computer Science / IT (or equivalent)

Location: Trivandrum

About Our Client:

Our Client, with Headquarters in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, is an innovative IT consulting company with almost 3 decades of industry presence with a primary focus on Public Administration. They have established themselves as an organization delivering mission critical projects to Government Clients across the country. Our client confirm to Global Quality Standards including CMMI DEV/5, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000 and ISO 27001. Currently they are working on Government Projects in multiple states in the Country.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Solution Architect – Pre-Sales who will take ownership of the technical solutioning and technical content of bids and proposals. The primary responsibility of this role is to analyse RFPs and customer requirements, define the appropriate technical solution and architecture, make technology and implementation approach decisions, and lead the preparation of the technical response for bid submissions.

The candidate will work closely with Business Development, Domain Experts, Product Teams, OEMs/Technology Partners, Project Management, and senior management to develop technically sound, compliant, scalable, and commercially viable solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

1. RFP Analysis & Technical Assessment

* Lead the
  **technical analysis of RFPs, RFIs, EOIs, and tender documents**
  .
* Analyse and interpret functional, technical, architectural, integration, infrastructure, security, performance, data migration, and O&M requirements.
* Prepare a detailed
  **technical requirement and compliance matrix.**
* **Identify technical gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and deviations in the RFP.**
* **Identify areas requiring clarification from the customer and prepare technical clarification queries.**
* **Assess the technical feasibility of the opportunity and advise BD team on the appropriate solution approach.**

2. Technical Solutioning & Architecture

* Take ownership of the technical solution proposed for the bid.
* Define the solution approach based on the RFP requirements, existing products, customer needs, and project constraints.
* Decide whether the requirement should be addressed through product/framework, customization, custom development, OEM/third-party solution, integration, or a combination of these.
* Prepare the required solution architecture, architecture diagrams, workflows, and integration architecture.
* Evaluate different technical options and recommend the most suitable solution considering functionality, scalability, security, timeline, complexity, risk, and cost.

3. Technical Proposal Preparation

* Lead and own the preparation of the technical proposal / bid response.
* Prepare and review all technical sections of the proposal.
* Ensure the technical response is clear, accurate, and compliant with the RFP.
* Coordinate with domain, product, and technical teams to collect the required inputs.
* Ensure the proposed solution, architecture, resources, timeline, and commercials are aligned.
* Conduct the final technical review of the bid before submission.

4. Technical Compliance & Bid Quality

* Take ownership of the
  **technical compliance matrix**
  and ensure that all mandatory requirements are adequately addressed.
* Validate that every important RFP requirement has a corresponding response in the technical proposal.
* Identify non-compliance or potential technical disqualification risks before bid submission.
* Review the complete bid from a technical perspective before final submission.

5. Technology & Product Evaluation

* Evaluate available products, frameworks, OEM technologies, and third-party solutions against RFP requirements.
* Recommend appropriate technologies and products for the proposed solution.
* Coordinate with OEMs and technology partners to obtain technical inputs, architecture information, compliance details, and product capabilities.
* Evaluate
  **build vs. buy vs. customize vs. integrate**
  options.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing company IP, products, reusable frameworks, and accelerators.

6. Technical Estimation & Solution Planning

* Prepare technical estimates covering effort, resources, skills, timelines, infrastructure, licences, third-party components, integrations, data migration, testing, security, and O&M requirements.
* Validate whether the proposed solution is technically feasible within the proposed timeline and budget.
* Work closely with the Commercial/Bid Team to ensure alignment between the technical solution and commercial proposal.

7. Customer & Technical Presentation

* Participate in customer discussions, technical workshops, pre-bid meetings, and clarification sessions.
* Present the proposed solution and architecture to customers and evaluation committees.
* Conduct technical demonstrations and solution walkthroughs when required.
* Respond to technical queries raised during the bidding and evaluation process.
* Support technical negotiations and post-bid technical clarifications.

8. Bid-to-Delivery Transition

* Conduct structured technical handover of the awarded solution to the delivery team.
* Explain the proposed architecture, technical commitments, assumptions, dependencies, and solution approach.
* Highlight any specific technical commitments made during the bid that need to be tracked during implementation.
* Support the delivery team during the initial project phase where clarification of the proposed solution is required.

**Required Technical & Architecture Skills**

Strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts, including:

* DBMS (RDBMS and NoSQL)
* Web Servers and Application Servers
* Hands-on development experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, .NET or equivalent)
* Application design patterns and coding best practices
* APIs and system integrations (REST / SOAP / event-based integrations, etc.)
* Microservices and monolithic architecture concepts
* Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP – architectural and deployment understanding)
* Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes – conceptual)
* Data migration strategies and ETL concepts
* Analytics, reporting, and dashboards
* AI / ML fundamentals and use cases
* Blockchain and IoT concepts
* Data Centre (DC) and Disaster Recovery (DR) architecture

**Experience & Qualification**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT or equivalent.
* **12+ years of overall IT experience.**
* **Minimum 5–8 years of experience in Solution Architecture/Technical Pre-Sales Head/ Technical Consulting**
  .
* Prior hands-on software development experience is mandatory.
* Proven experience in
  **technical proposal preparation and RFP-based bidding.**
* **Experience in large-scale Government / PSU / Enterprise IT projects is highly desirable.**
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.**
