1ed579b9.description:
Hi,

  

Wishes. GSN provides corporate search services, identifying and bringing talented professionals to meet the needs of IT and non-IT clients across India. The company has been supporting client hiring needs for over 20 years.

  

Currently we are actively hunting for **Senior Security Architect** for one of our MNC Client. Kindly find below the detailed Job Description for your better understanding.

  

**Exp Range : 12 to 20 yrs**

**Work Location : Bangalore / Pune / Chennai**

**Work Mode : Hybrid**

**CTC Range : Rs 45 LPA to Rs. 50 LPA**

  

**\*\*\*** Looking for **SHORT JOINERS \*\*\***

**Job overview :**

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within clients offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through clients controlled UK service boundary.

  

**Essential skills:**

* **Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.**
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying **risk assessment methods** such as **ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30**.
* Working knowledge of the **NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.**
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Clients Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

  

**Required Qualification :**

* **12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.**
* **Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.**
* **Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.**
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.
* **CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).**
* **TOGAF,** a cloud security certification (e.g. **CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty**) or **GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification** would be advantageous.

  

**\*\*\*** Looking for **SHORT JOINERS \*\*\***

If this role excites you and aligns with your aspirations, don't hesitate to call me @ **9840035825** directly or click **APPLY ONLINE**. Let's explore this opportunity together!

  

Thanks and Regards,

**Ananth** | GSN | +91.98400.35825 | Google review : https://g.co/kgs/UAsF9W

afac32f0.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

1a862fe5.title: Program Manager
1a862fe5.description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

### **Role summary**

The Program Manager, Services runs the internal programs that make Mindtickle Services efficient, predictable and profitable. The role spans all four service lines — Professional Services, Content as a Service (CaaS), Managed Services and Technical Solutions — rather than a single customer engagement.

You will own portfolio-wide visibility into cost, revenue, margin and sourcing (in-house vs. outsourced); run strategic Services initiatives from charter to closure; coordinate internal response on escalations and accounts that need operational support; and build the executive narratives that leadership uses with founders, Sales and customers.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a structured operator who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a platform, a cross-functional working session and an executive deck.

### **Key responsibilities**

**1) Services portfolio governance & visibility**

* Build and maintain a single source of truth across PS, CaaS, Managed Services and Technical Solutions: active programs, capacity, utilization, delivery health and risk.
* Run the Services governance cadence — weekly portfolio reviews, monthly business reviews and quarterly planning — with clear decision logs and action tracking.
* Define and standardize portfolio metrics and reporting so leadership can see issues early and act on data, not anecdotes.

**2) Program financials: cost, revenue & sourcing**

* Track Services revenue, cost and margin by service line, account and program; surface variance and its drivers.
* Maintain clear visibility into what is delivered in-house versus outsourced — vendor spend, contractor utilization and the cost/quality trade-off of each.
* Support pricing, estimation and capacity models with leadership, Finance and Presales; flag margin risk before deals are signed and during delivery.
* Prepare inputs for budgeting, forecasting and headcount planning.

**3) Strategic initiatives**

* Charter, plan and drive Services-wide initiatives end to end — e.g., AI-led delivery transformation, new service packaging, operating-model changes and tooling rollouts.
* Own initiative governance: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, RAID logs and success metrics.
* Hold cross-functional owners accountable and report progress and outcomes to leadership.

**4) Escalation & account operations support**

* Act as the program lead on escalations: assemble the right internal team, run the recovery plan, track commitments and close the loop.
* Provide operational support to accounts that need it — resourcing gaps, cross-team dependencies, commercial or scope clarity — without becoming the day-to-day delivery owner.
* Capture root causes and turn recurring issues into process or product fixes.

**5) Operational efficiency & process improvement**

* Identify inefficiencies across service functions — hand-offs, duplicated effort, tooling gaps, manual reporting — and drive measurable fixes.
* Standardize playbooks, templates and operating rhythms across service lines.
* Partner with team leads to apply AI and automation to internal workflows (reporting, estimation, resource allocation).

**6) Executive communication & storytelling**

* Build executive presentations for founders, leadership reviews, Sales/GTM forums and customer executive meetings.
* Turn operational data into a clear narrative: what is happening, why it matters and what decision is needed.
* Draft briefs, business cases and updates for Services leadership.

**Tools, cadences & metrics**

**Tools:** Jira, Rocketlane, Excel/Google Sheets, Salesforce (inputs), BI dashboards, Google Slides/PowerPoint, and AI assistants for analysis and drafting.

**Our Culture & Values**
------------------------

We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.

Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.

Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.

We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.

We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

**Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

c9d9a75d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
c9d9a75d.description:
**Aliases**
**:**
Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands-off-the-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
  
  
You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow-through.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role you will:
  
  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.

**Required Qualifications**
The experience requirement is 11+ years in total, composed of 7+ years in a hands-on individual-contributor technical role and 4+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
  
  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands-on individual-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
The following skill sets would be good to have:
  
  

* SQL or equivalent data-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best-in-class program management practices.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Strategy & Planning
  
  

* Drive strategic, cross-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.

Technical Execution & Delivery
  
  

* Lead and facilitate regular program-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive-level escalations and program-level change management processes as-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.

Process & Communication
  
  

* Manage high-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non-technical partners at different levels of the organization.

2673a1ca.description:

a2a98c65.description:
**Description**
The Program Manager – Automation & Engineering Projects drives end-to-end project governance for automation, capacity, and Innovation Lab initiatives within the GESI-IN (PMO/Ops Eng/Automation) team. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of approved OP1/OP2 intake requests, maintaining the India Product Development System (IPDS) master tracker, and ensuring project health through continuous risk analysis and timely escalation. The Program Manager owns launch readiness planning with backward-scheduled timelines, coordinates cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners, and delivers executive-level business review narratives (WBR, MBR, QBR). Additionally, the role produces monthly newsletters, event-driven flash reports, and leads weekly project reviews and gate-review logistics to maintain cadence and accountability across all active programs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Tracking all approved OP(OP1 & OP2) Intake requests (ATL/BTL Category) through Laminar intake flow on Capacity, automation initiatives, Innovation Lab, Study & assessment/any other category that requires GESI-IN (Ops Eng/Automation) team’s delivery.
* End to end monitor and control of project through continuous risk analysis at each phases by leveraging Source. Timely escalation of leadership support through proper technical write up & WP doc.
* Own the Innovation lab’s master project tracker — India Product Development System (IPDS) phase, milestones, dev-cycle time, RAG status and payback for every active project. Keep it current and audit-ready.
* Create and maintain tracker of launch (ETA: Go-Live) backward updated status for timely actions/support.
* Business Review Docs: Owning end to end details & quality of all automation/capacity/IL charters for narratives for all business review docs (WBR, MBR & QBR).
* Monthly Innovation Lab Newsletter — project progress, wins, look ahead and team spotlights.
* Issue event-driven flash reports for gate outcomes, milestone hits and critical blockers for leadership attention.
* Coordinate across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners to keep cross-functional commitments on track.

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day begins with a standup reviewing project health dashboards on GES Source, flagging any RAG status shifts or emerging risks across active Engineering projects and automation charter. Mid-morning is spent updating tracker, aligning milestone timelines, and preparing concise escalation notes for leadership. After lunch, cross-functional syncs with Operations, RME, Finance, and vendor partners keep launch commitments on track. The afternoon wraps up drafting business review narratives or newsletter updates, followed by a gate-review prep session to finalize agendas and close out action items before end of day.
  
  
**About The Team**
GESI-IN (Global Engineering Services & Innovation – India) is the team that delivers for Amazon's India network expansion and consolidation. The team partners with Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and all other cross functional teams to design, develop and deploy engineering solutions, capacity programs, and automation charters that improve safety, quality, and throughput at scale. The team takes ideas from concept through pilot to network-wide rollout. You will join a fast-paced, data-driven group that values deep-dive problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias for action to deliver measurable impact on the ground.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems

426ec4de.title: SoC Program Manager
426ec4de.description:
CScale is building the interconnect for gigawatt-scale AI. As AI scale-up moves toward deployments spanning thousands of accelerators and dozens of racks, the network needs to deliver high bandwidth, predictable low latency, and continuous communication. CScale is building integrated optical interconnect designed for this new scale, enabling accelerators to work together like a single, much larger computer. But at this scale, performance is only part of the challenge. Optical failures are inevitable, and the system needs to keep running. CScale is designing the interconnect for continuity.
**Lasers will fail. Compute shouldn’t.**
The ambition is simple:
**Build AI interconnect you can take for granted.**
CScale came out of stealth in September 2026 with $145 million in Series C funding, bringing total funding to $188 million.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Be the primary point of contact for SoC program execution, and own the end-to-end plan from concept to release to manufacturing: architecture, IP, RTL, verification, physical design, DFT, tapeout, bring-up, validation, qualification and sampling.
* Build the integrated plan across SoC and chiplet/multi-die design, hardware, firmware, software, foundry, packaging, test and QA.
* Set milestones, phase gates and the critical path (spec freeze, RTL freeze, netlist and timing signoff, tapeout readiness) with engineering leads, and own the gate reviews.
* Front-end: Drive RTL milestones and the RTL change-control process, track lint/CDC/RDC and DFT closure, and own verification closure (coverage, regression health, bug burn-down).
* Physical design: Drive floorplan, bump map, timing and power convergence, IR/EM and signoff, and coordinate netlist, constraint, IP-view and package handoffs across FE, PD, analog and packaging.
* Emulation: Own the emulation and FPGA prototyping plan, and make sure results feed back into RTL and firmware before tapeout.
* SW interfacing: Keep hardware and software aligned on register map, memory map, boot flow and driver/firmware interfaces, and track SW readiness for bring-up.
* Dependencies: Maintain a cross-team dependency tracker with owners and dates, resolve blockers, and escalate with options and a recommendation.
* Manage IP vendors (SerDes, PCIe/Ethernet/UCIe, processor cores, PHYs), the foundry and OSAT partners, holding them to delivery and quality commitments.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, MPW/mask and resource plans, and drive decisions when they change.
* Identify technical and schedule risks early (IP maturity, timing, power, area, package co-design, test coverage), drive mitigation, and escalate.
* Define program health metrics and build the executive dashboards (bug burn-down, coverage, timing and power convergence, bring-up status).
* Own sample readiness and release-to-manufacturing criteria with engineering and operations, including ATE test, yield and silicon characterization.
* Run the program cadence across global sites and establish program management processes and tools as CScale moves into production.

**Skills And Knowledge**

* Strong technical program management: integrated scheduling, critical path ownership, driving issues to closure.
* Working knowledge of the full SoC flow: architecture, IP integration, RTL, verification (UVM, formal, emulation), physical design, STA, DFT, tapeout, post-silicon validation and qualification.
* Enough technical depth to engage engineers on PPA, IP configuration, clocking/reset, power domains and package co-design tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with emulation platforms, firmware/software bring-up, and high-speed interfaces (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, SerDes).
* Leads matrixed teams through influence, decides well with incomplete information, and communicates clearly with engineers and executives.
* Proficient with scheduling and tracking tools (MS Project, Jira, Notion).
* Bonus: reliability qualification (JEDEC/AEC), production test, yield ramp.

**Required Experience**

* 12+ years in semiconductor product development, including 7+ years leading SoC/ASIC programs, with earlier hands-on engineering experience.
* Has driven multiple SoC programs from concept through tapeout and release to manufacturing, ideally on advanced nodes.
* Experience managing IP vendors, foundries and OSAT partners, and leading programs across global teams.
* Startup or first-generation product experience.
* B.Sc. or higher in EE, Computer Engineering, Physics or a related field.
* Bonus: chiplet/multi-die and advanced packaging (2.5D/3D), silicon photonics or optical engine programs, high-speed connectivity products.

**Solutions Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure**
**What You'll Do**

* Partner with Account Executives and sales teams to understand customer priorities, identify opportunities, and shape technical strategies.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, demonstrations, and presentations.
* Translate customer business and technical requirements into scalable, differentiated Cisco solutions.
* Develop end-to-end architectures leveraging Cisco's portfolio and relevant technology ecosystems.
* Contribute technical insights to account planning, opportunity development, cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive strategies.
* Stay current on emerging trends across data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure and translate insights into customer opportunities.
* Collaborate with portfolio teams, technical specialists, partners, and sales stakeholders to drive customer outcomes.
* Support customer workshops, partner engagements, enablement sessions, and industry events.
* Travel as required for customer, partner, and Cisco engagements across India and internationally.

**Who You'll Work With**
You will be part of a global Cloud and AI Architecture organization, partnering with Account Executives, portfolio sellers, partners, and customers.
  
  
The primary focus will be
**India**
, with opportunities to support broader
**APJC engagements**
and collaborate with global teams.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You are a customer-focused technical sales professional with strong architecture expertise and a passion for
**data center networking, compute, and AI infrastructure**
.
  
  
You can engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, simplify complex technology concepts, and translate customer challenges into business value. You thrive in a collaborative, matrixed environment and are comfortable influencing across teams to deliver customer outcomes.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical presales, solutions engineering, or relevant hands-on infrastructure experience data center networking, compute, storage and how compute, storage, and network integrate.
* Deep knowledge and practical experience with the relevant switching and routing protocols and technologies (e.g.,Spanning Tree, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, Multicast, QoS, Network Segmentation, etc).

* Solid understanding of network security in data center including design and implementation of multi-tenancy, N-S/E-W firewall and microsegmentation.

* Experience with the Cisco data center portfolio (Nexus/ACI, UCS, Intersight, HyperFabric) or comparable competitive platforms.

With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
**Professional Summary**
Pre‑Sales Solution Engineer with
**4–6 years**
of experience designing and positioning
**enterprise networking and wireless solutions across mixed OEM environments**
including
**Aruba, Juniper, and Ruckus**
. Strong background in
**switching, routing, wireless, security integration, and SD‑WAN**
, working closely with sales, partners, and customers to translate business requirements into scalable, secure architectures. Proven ability to deliver
**HLDs, LLDs, BoQs**
, PoCs, and winning technical proposals.
  
  
**Core Technology Expertise (Multi‑Vendor Aligned)**

* 6–8 years of experience as a Pre‑Sales Solutions Engineer delivering enterprise networking and wireless solutions
* Understanding in L2/L3 switching and routing on Aruba CX and Juniper EX/QFX platforms
* Strong skills in VLAN design, segmentation, inter‑VLAN routing, and traffic optimization
* Proven high‑availability designs using MLAG, VSF, Virtual Chassis, LACP, and Spanning Tree
* Experience in campus and branch network architecture, scaling, and modernization
* Hands‑on with Aruba and Ruckus wireless (Aruba Central, ClearPass, SmartZone, Cloud Wi‑Fi)
* Strong understanding of RF design, site surveys, capacity planning, and Wi‑Fi security (802.1X, captive portals)
* Solid background in WAN/SD‑WAN, Juniper SRX routing, MPLS to internet migration, and VPNs
* Knowledge of network security integration, NAC with ClearPass, and secure BYOD access
* Proven ability to deliver HLDs, LLDs, BoQs, PoCs, and support winning technical proposals

**Solution Architecting**

* Engage with sales, channel partners, and enterprise customers to gather business and technical requirements
* Design end‑to‑end enterprise network solutions (Campus LAN, WLAN, Branch/WAN) and deliver HLDs, LLDs, and BoQs aligned to OEM best practices

**Customer Engagement & Consultative Selling**

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, delivering solution presentations, demos, and architecture walkthroughs
* Support wired and wireless PoCs and translate technical designs into clear business value propositions

**RFP / Proposal & Deal Support**

* Lead technical responses for RFPs/RFIs/RFQs, including compliance matrices, solution narratives, and scope documents
* Support deal qualification, pricing discussions, OEM registrations, and solution validation with distributors and OEM teams

**Collaboration & Delivery Readiness**

* Coordinate with professional services and deployment teams to ensure smooth handover and implementation readiness
* Maintain detailed design documentation and provide technical guidance to junior engineers and delivery teams

**Mandatory Skills (JD Aligned)**

* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ICMP) with an enterprise design and troubleshooting mindset
* Expertise in wireless security, authentication, access policies, and infrastructure integration (AD, DNS, DHCP, NTP)

**Certifications & Education**

* OEM and vendor‑neutral certifications such as Aruba and Juniper (as applicable)
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BE/B.Tech) or equivalent qualification

76aa4bf2.title: Scrum Master - GenAI/Cloud
76aa4bf2.description:
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions help Deloitte client service teams improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Position Summary

**Level: Delivery Management Engineer III**

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

The Scrum Master is a key member of an Agile team, responsible for facilitating the Scrum process, coaching team members in Agile best practices, and ensuring the teams effectiveness in delivering high-quality products. The Scrum Master acts as a servant leader, removing impediments and fostering a collaborative, transparent, and high-performing team environment.

**Work you’ll do:**

As a Delivery Management Engineer III on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for supporting Agile delivery execution, enabling team effectiveness, and helping drive high-quality outcomes across POD-based delivery environments.

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives.
* Coach teams and stakeholders on Scrum, Agile practices, and scaled Agile ways of working to support effective delivery.
* Remove impediments, manage dependencies, and help resolve delivery risks impacting sprint execution.
* Support backlog refinement, prioritization, and communication of delivery goals in collaboration with Product Owners and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Track sprint progress, delivery flow, and quality metrics, while preparing status updates and maintaining Scrum artifacts to promote transparency.

**The team:**

 Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru**

**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM; 2 PM to 11 PM**

**Qualifications**

Require

* 6+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar Agile delivery role supporting POD-based delivery models and collaboration across multiple PODs, including Scrum of Scrums.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience applying Scrum and scaled Agile frameworks, including SAFe, in software delivery environments.
* Experience with software development life cycle, project planning and estimation, risk identification, and capacity and dependency management.
* Experience using Agile project management tools, including Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, or Rally, and building dashboards to report delivery metrics.
* Experience coaching Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and development teams on Agile practices, Lean delivery practices, and product delivery tools.
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university, or equivalent degree.

Preferred:

* SAFe Agilist certification.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in enterprise-scale delivery environments.
* Experience tracking sprint plan, definition of done, quality, and delivery flow metrics.
* Experience supporting backlog refinement and backlog management with Product Owners.
* Experience with version control systems, including GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, and continuous integration, continuous deployment, and release management processes.
* Experience using objectives and key results and key performance indicators to measure Agile team performance.

7d303f89.title: PLA Principal, Enterprise Solutions
7d303f89.description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
ERP: Finance Focus (FICO)
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Lead ERP – Finance Specialist, you will lead finance transformation programs leveraging ERP solutions such as SAP S/4HANA FICO, Treasury, and Financial Planning & Budgeting. You will collaborate with client CFOs, finance leaders, and BCG partners to deliver end-to-end ERP-enabled finance modernization initiatives.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Lead finance-focused ERP transformations across General Ledger, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, and Treasury Management.
* Drive integration between Controlling (CO), Project Systems (PS), and Planning & Budgeting.
* Provide strategic guidance on finance data models, cost allocations, and statutory reporting.
* Design future-state processes for financial close, consolidation, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (IFRS, GAAP) and internal controls.
* Work closely with clients to optimize Capex/Opex through ERP and digital finance initiatives.

**What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)**

* 16+ years in ERP finance roles with deep SAP FICO, Treasury, or BPC/Group Reporting experience.
* Experience designing and deploying end-to-end finance solutions in S/4HANA or equivalent ERP.
* Exposure to projects integrating finance with supply chain, procurement, and HR.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and project accounting.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Transformation leaders.

ERP – Sales and Distribution Focus (SD)
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Lead ERP – Sales Specialist, you will lead end-to-end design and delivery of ERP sales, order management, and pricing processes using SAP SD, AATP, and CRM/BRIM capabilities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Lead ERP transformations across Order-to-Cash (O2C), Billing, and Pricing processes.
* Implement and optimize SAP SD, AATP, and integrated CRM/BRIM platforms.
* Enable digital customer experience and omnichannel sales models within ERP.
* Develop revenue recognition and subscription-based pricing capabilities.
* Collaborate with marketing and supply chain functions for integrated sales operations.

**What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)**

* 16+ years’ experience in ERP-led sales and customer operations transformation.
* Deep SAP SD and CRM/BRIM expertise; AATP experience preferred.
* Strong grasp of order fulfillment, returns, rebate, and pricing management processes.
* Exposure to industries like CPG, manufacturing, or telecom.
* Experience engaging with Sales, Commercial, and Digital Transformation leaders.

ERP – Procurement and Supply Chain Focus
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Lead ERP – Procurement & Supply Chain Specialist, you will design and implement ERP-driven procurement and sourcing processes that deliver efficiency, transparency, and savings. You will lead initiatives using SAP MM, WM, and complementary tools like Ariba, Coupa, and iValua.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Lead ERP transformations in Procurement, Vendor Management, and Warehouse Operations.
* Architect and integrate eProcurement and Source-to-Pay platforms (Ariba, Coupa, iValua) with ERP.
* Optimize inventory and warehouse operations through SAP MM and WM modules.
* Enhance supplier collaboration through catalogs, SRM, and spend analytics.
* Develop KPIs for procurement effectiveness, compliance, and sustainability goals.

**What You’ll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)**

* 16+ years’ experience in ERP procurement and logistics, with deep SAP MM and WM expertise.
* Working knowledge of QM, SRM, Ariba, Coupa, or iValua integration with ERP.
* Strong understanding of supply base rationalization, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
* Experience advising CPOs and Procurement Transformation teams.
* Exposure to AI/analytics-driven procurement insights preferred.

**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions. BCG Platinion is a rapidly growing global team of leading tech experts. We are shaping the future of technology consulting by combining business expertise with cutting-edge technology capabilities. We help our clients solve their most pressing challenges by designing and delivering enterprise architecture solutions. We partner with clients across industries to design and implement enterprise architecture and digital transformation programs that drive innovation, agility, and scalable value.
  
  
Why Join BCG Platinion
  
  
**At BCG Platinion, You Will Enjoy:**

* A challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting
* A diverse and inclusive culture that values your unique perspective and contribution
* Enterprise Architecture consulting with implementation and value realization in a client setting
* A supportive and collaborative environment that fosters your personal growth and development
* A competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects your skills and experience
* Opportunity to deepen knowledge in specific industries and gain implementation experience.

If you want a challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting, apply now!
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

60aaf254.title: Solutions Architect , AGS India Public Sector
60aaf254.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).
  
  
As a solutions architect you will provide a consistent approach for customers and partners to evaluate architectures, and implement designs that will scale over time based on five pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework — operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of AWS, India. We work with the central government ministries, state and local governments, public sector units, education institutions, EdTechs, nonprofits, and healthcare. Our vision is to help public institutions in India to make a significant impact to the lives of citizens, by taking a technology generation leap through use of AWS cloud services within the domains of Skilling, Smart Infrastructure, Healthcare and Inclusion (Physical, Digital and Financial).

Helping make customer success a reality and seeing the impact in real-time drives our teams to explore new frontiers in leveraging AWS cloud for both commercial and public sector organizations.
  
  
If you have worked with Amazon Web Services technologies or have AWS certifications you would like to leverage, we will help you maximize the impact of your skills and knowledge.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain continuous integration and delivery pipelines .
* Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.
* Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage.
* Perform troubleshooting bottom up from bare metal, operating system, software stack and application level.
* Being a technical resource, develop, re-define and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams Support Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs for future improvements .

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering fields with at least 8 years work or research experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture.
* 5+ Years of Design, implement and maintain large scale HPC/AI clusters with monitoring, logging and alerting Manage Linux job/workload schedulers and orchestration tools.
* Knowledge of HPC and AI solution technologies from CPU’s and GPU’s to high speed interconnects and supporting software.
* Direct design, implementation and management experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Experience with job scheduling workloads and orchestration technologies such as Slurm, Kubernetes and Singularity.

* Python programming and bash scripting experience. Comfortable with automation and configuration management tools including Jenkins, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, etc.
* Deep knowledge of Networking Protocols like InfiniBand, Ethernet Deep understanding and experience with virtual systems (for example VMware, Hyper-V, KVM, or Citrix).
* Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are critical.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Knowledge of CPU and/or GPU architecture .
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, container related microservice technologies.
* Experience with GPU-focused hardware/software (DGX, CUDA.)
* Background with RDMA (InfiniBand or RoCE) fabrics.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Technical Program Manager
  
  
Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
The Digital Solutions Engineering team is responsible for Mastercard’s electronic payment system as well as ensures payments are convenient and secure. The products are primarily focused on authentication, tokenization, fraud prevention, and risk mitigation across all payment channels as well as all stakeholders, issuers, acquirers, merchants, processors, and consumers. The key objectives of the solutions are to prove identity, reduce abandonments, reduce fraud, increase approval rates, and secure the payments ecosystem.
  
  
We are hiring a Lead Technical Program Manager (TPM) as part of the Authentication Solutions platform. The core Authentication Solutions (3DS and Passkey based) teams use a mix of technologies as we work to revolutionize our technology offerings.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Technical Program Managers at Mastercard collaborate to define the how and when of our strategic delivery goals. This role plays a pivotal role in driving complex, cross-functional projects and maintain alignment of our goals to organizational objectives. The responsibility of this teammate is to ensure technical solutions are delivered on time and meet the desired outcomes.
  
  
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive progress, manage complex projects, and ensure optimal delivery. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in decision-making, problem decomposition, and effective communication, while maintaining a strong grasp of business context and technical details.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Accelerate project progress by making crisp, timely decisions and clearing blockers.
* Navigate difficult situations to find viable paths forward and decompose problems into manageable units from ideation to execution.
* Organize work for optimal delivery, negotiating priorities, facilitating progress, and raising issues to management as needed.
* Maintain TPM artifacts, track SDLC milestones, and manage dependency target dates actively.
* Secure shared understanding and buy-in for solutions, clearly describing their impact on Mastercard and its customers.
* Use communication as a preventive control, ensuring meetings are effective, consensus is built, and decisions are well-documented.
* Optimize approaches, demonstrate improvements using data, and drive continuous improvements through retrospectives, staff meetings, and status updates.
* Proficiently manage scrum delivery, understand business context, customer use cases, and the functionality, architecture, and dependencies of involved systems.
* Represent team services to stakeholders and external partners, bringing developers or SMEs to meetings as necessary.
* Actively manage dependencies, influence vendors and partners, and ensure alignment with program goals.
* Deliver independently while occasionally seeking direction from peers and managers.

**All About You**

* Born simplifier.
* Proven experience in technical program management, with a strong ability to make timely decisions and manage complex projects.
* Proficiency in scrum delivery and a track record of optimizing processes and demonstrating improvements with data.
* Deep understanding of business context, customer use cases, system functionality, and industry technologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to lead effective meetings, build consensus, and clearly articulate decisions.
* Experience in managing dependencies, influencing external partners, and representing team services to stakeholders.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.

* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

e325a17f.title: Salesforce Application Architect
e325a17f.description:
SOVOS
  
  
Salesforce Application Architect
  
  
Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India
  
  
Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process
  
  
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
  
  
1
  
  
Pre-Employment Assessment
  
  
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
  
  
2
  
  
Video Interview
  
  
A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
  
  
3
  
  
Meeting with a Recruiter
  
  
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
  
  
4
  
  
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
  
  
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
  
  
Life at Sovos
  
  
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
Company Background
  
  
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
  
  
Ready to make your move?
  
  
We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

**Responsibilities:**

* Develops technology road maps, while keeping up-to-date with emerging technologies, and recommends business directions based on these technologies.
* Provides technical leadership and is responsible for developing components of, or the overall systems design.
* Translates complex business problems into sound technical solutions.
