c0dd4211.title: Solution Architect, Customer Data
c0dd4211.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!
  
  
The department's core objective is to build and govern AGCO’s Customer Platform, ensuring trusted, high-quality customer data across the organization. It enables customer-centric business processes, analytics, marketing, CRM, AI, and digital solutions by providing a single, reliable source of customer information. The department collaborates closely with Business Teams, Data Governance, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, CRM, Marketing, Analytics, and Digital Product teams. It receives customer data requirements from business stakeholders (upstream) and delivers trusted customer data products and integrations to CRM, analytics, AI, dealer systems, and customer-facing applications (downstream).
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Lead the Customer Platform architecture design, including customer identity, master data, consent, Customer 360, integration, and data consumption.
* Translate requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable platform designs.
* Define target architectures, integration patterns, data flows, technical decisions, and implementation guidance across Reltio, Salesforce, Databricks, and related services.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and data governance standards.
* Drive simplification, reuse, modernization, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to support reliable, future-ready customer data capabilities.

**Your Experience And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Business Informatics, Data, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered 6-8 years of Solution Architecture experience.
* Strong knowledge of Customer Data Platforms and MDM concepts.
* Experience with Reltio, Salesforce, Databricks, or similar platforms.
* Strong integration, cloud, and enterprise architecture expertise.
* Strong working knowledge of system integration methods, APIs, data exchange patterns, security contr- ols, architecture documentation,

**Your Benefits**

* GLOBAL DIVERSITY – Diversity means many things to us, different brands, cultures, nationalities, genders, generations – even variety in our roles. You make us unique!
* ENTERPRISING SPIRIT- Every role adds value. We are committed to helping you develop and grow to realize your potential.
* POSITIVE IMPACT – Make it personal and help us feed the world.
* INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES - You can combine your love for technology with manufacturing excellence – and work alongside teams of people worldwide who share your enthusiasm.
* MAKE THE MOST OF YOU – Benefits include health care and wellness plans and flexible and virtual work options.

**Your Workplace**
We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.
  
  
**Join us as we bring agriculture into the future and apply now!**
Please note that this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all required activities, duties, responsibilities, or benefits and may change at any time with or without notice.

75f0d076.title: Bank IN Solution Architecture - VP
75f0d076.description:
Join us as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VP, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Work closely with engineers, QA engineers, UX designers, architects, and Scrum Masters to deliver high-quality software.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with engineering teams to define scalable, secure, and maintainable Android solutions.
* Define architecture, APIs, integrations, and cloud-based services.
* Support release planning and dependency management.
* Ensure product increments deliver measurable business value.

* Develop architecture roadmaps supporting the modernization and strategic evolution of the Core Banking estate.
* Identify opportunities to:

+ Reduce legacy technology risk.
+ Simplify architecture.
+ Reduce technical debt.
+ Improve automation.
+ Increase API enablement.
+ Improve resilience and recoverability.
+ Introduce appropriate cloud and container capabilities.

* Assess build vs buy vs reuse vs vendor-platform options and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support incremental modernization strategies that protect critical banking services while reducing transformation risk.
* Ensure near-term project decisions remain aligned with longer-term target architecture.
* Define and assure non-functional requirements covering:

+ Availability
+ Resilience
+ Recoverability
+ Performance
+ Capacity
+ Scalability
+ Security
+ Maintainability
+ Observability

* Assess failure modes and dependencies across Core Banking customer journeys.
* Exp with Fiserv in Core banking and account servicing capabilities, Customer, account, transaction and product integrations.
* Interfaces between Fiserv-based services and digital channels, payments, cards, data and downstream banking platforms.
* Experience with OpenText in Enterprise content and document-management capabilities supporting banking processes.
* Document creation, storage, retrieval, archival and records-management integrations.
* Integration of content-management capabilities with customer and operational journeys.
* TSYS experience with Card-processing and card-servicing capabilities.
* Account, transaction, authorization and servicing integrations.
* Integration between TSYS capabilities and core banking, digital channels, payments and supporting services.
* Define integration patterns between Core Banking platforms.
* Design solutions that minimize blast radius and avoid unnecessary single points of failure.
* Ensure architecture supports effective monitoring, fault diagnosis and operational support.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations teams to investigate complex performance, availability and integration issues.
* Ensure capacity and performance implications are understood before significant production changes.
* Act as the architecture interface between business, product, engineering, operations and enterprise technology teams.
* Technically challenge vendor proposals and ensure proposed solutions meet enterprise architecture requirements.
* Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to both senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influence stakeholders where immediate delivery objectives conflict with longer-term technology strategy or acceptable risk.
* Provide architecture input into commercial and technology discussions where vendor capability, licensing, infrastructure or product direction impacts strategic decisions.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Bangalore.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

9e9ad8dc.title: Senior Architect - Java and Generative AI - Vice President
9e9ad8dc.description:
The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* Core Java & Microservices Architecture: 10+ years of hands-on software development experience with mastery of Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, reactive programming, and designing scalable, fault-tolerant microservices architectures.
* Deep LLM & Architecture Understanding: Comprehensive knowledge of Large Language Models (transformer architectures, tokenization, context windows, embeddings, fine-tuning vs. prompt-tuning trade-offs) across major frontier and open-source models.
* Advanced Prompt Engineering: Proven experience designing, testing, and optimizing complex system prompts using structured techniques (Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) to reliably produce deterministic, structured outputs (JSON/Pydantic/XML)
* Cloud-Native & Container Orchestration: Extensive experience architecting and containerizing applications using Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Helm, with solid exposure to hybrid and public cloud infrastructure (AWS / GCP).
* Event-Driven Architecture & Messaging: Deep practical experience implementing distributed, event-driven systems using Apache Kafka / Confluent Kafka, IBM MQ, and pub/sub patterns for real-time, low-latency transaction processing.
* Enterprise Data & Storage Systems: Strong proficiency with modern DBaaS environments, relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle), NoSQL data stores (MongoDB), and distributed caching solutions (Redis), including schema design and performance optimization.
* CI/CD Automation & Modern DevOps: Demonstrated expertise in continuous integration and automated deployment pipelines (Lightspeed / Tekton / Harness / Jenkins / GitHub Actions), automated test frameworks (JUnit, Testcontainers), and GitOps delivery models.
* Enterprise Security & Secrets Management: Strong adherence to enterprise security governance, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, HashiCorp Vault secrets management, and automated vulnerability scanning (SonarQube, Checkmarx, Snyk).
* Technical Leadership & Agile Delivery: Proven leadership capabilities to guide cross-functional engineering teams, drive technical blueprints, enforce rigorous code review standards, mentor junior engineers, and translate complex business requirements into robust solution architectures.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

6e429fb8.title: Solution Consultant - Veeva QualityOne - India
6e429fb8.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

As part of our regional expansion in our Veeva QualityOne business, Veeva is currently looking for a Solution Consultant who has a passion for helping our customers in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Food & Beverage, and related consumer industries achieve their business vision for excellence in Quality Management.

As a key member of the Solution Consulting team, you will be responsible for working with our Account Partners to understand customers’ business challenges & needs, driving technical win strategies, and providing deep solution expertise including value-based product demonstrations of the Veeva Quality application suite.

Your contribution will be critical in driving technical sales execution to support the Veeva QualityOne Asia team as we scale our market presence across India and the region.

At Veeva, we offer excellent opportunities for our people to capitalize on their skills and grow in a fast-paced, unique and exceptional work environment.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Identify customers' challenges and objectives and demonstrate solutions that address these requirements and bring business value to the organisation
* Communicate product knowledge and industry expertise to customers
* Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle for all product- and technology-related inquiries
* Assist the sales support team to prepare compelling, professional content for RFP (Request for Proposal) and RFI (Request for Information) responses for prospective clients
* Partner with Professional Services to help define project scopes, best practices, and high-level project proposals for prospects
* Support marketing initiatives and represent the company at key events, including public speaking and presentations

### **Requirements**

* 4+ years of experience working for a SaaS Enterprise Software company in a customer-facing pre-sales / Solution Consulting / Technical Sales Engineering role (or related professional services consulting background)
* Strong understanding of or direct exposure to Quality Management functions at Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Food & Beverage, or related process manufacturing industries
* Proven track record of managing and prioritizing multi-faceted technical engagements across complex customer accounts
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated success delivering compelling technical presentations and solution demos to both technical and executive audiences
* Self-reliant with a strong ability to drive initiatives, operate autonomously in a remote or hybrid environment, and collaborate effectively with remote multi-disciplinary teams
* Full professional fluency in English with the right to work in India

### **Nice to Have**

* Direct hands-on product experience with systems such as Veeva Vault, ETQ Reliance, Sparta TrackWise, OpenText, SharePoint, Documentum D2, FirstDoc FirstPoint, NextDocs, UL ComplianceWire, SAP QM and other quality information management or content management systems
* Understanding of global quality requirements, compliance considerations and processes for Quality process and content management, Consumer Products/FMCG/Food & Beverage/Chemical and/or computer systems validation
* Experience working with large, multi-national customers in India and across Asia/Pacific
* Customer-facing consulting or project experience

###### **#LI-MidSenior**

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

988a27f6.title: Associate Architect
988a27f6.description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
  
  
**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership & Leadership**

* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.

**Operational Excellence & Automation**

* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin-up/spin-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.[MS1]
* Create self-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.

**FinOps, Cost Governance & Optimization**

* Implement a FinOps-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.

* $9.2 billion in revenue
* #20 on Fortune’s World's Best Workplaces™ list

We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.
  
  
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Cloud Engineer III, you will be part of the consulting and delivery practice, utilizing cutting-edge automation tools and provisioning in public cloud providers—preferably Azure or AWS. You will be responsible for designing and deploying well-architected cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer-facing roles and a proven track record of delivering cloud solutions with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) automation on various projects. Along the way, you will:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and manage cloud infrastructure resources across AWS and Azure, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and databases.
* Support the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud solutions in collaboration with senior engineers and architects.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, ARM templates, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins to automate application and infrastructure deployments.
* Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
* Configure monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic.
* Support cloud migration initiatives using tools such as Azure Migrate and assist with disaster recovery and BCDR implementations.
* Perform troubleshooting, performance optimization, and cost optimization across cloud environments.
* Implement cloud security best practices including identity and access management (IAM), network security, and encryption.
* Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders in Agile/Scrum environments to support successful project delivery.

  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–6 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or related roles.
* Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud platform (AWS or Azure), with basic exposure to the other being a plus.
* Experience with core cloud infrastructure services including:
* Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VNet, Azure Storage, Azure Monitor, Azure AD, Load Balancers, DNS, and Application Gateway.
* AWS: EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, Elastic Load Balancers, and Auto Scaling.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, PowerShell, or AWS CloudFormation.
* Hands-on experience in SQL Server configuration, administration, and troubleshooting, including performance tuning, backup/restore, and maintenance.
* Experience with SQL Server Always On AG, Windows Failover Clustering, Replication, and Azure SQL PaaS services such as Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting DR, migrations, upgrades, and modernization of SQL workloads across on-premises, Azure, and hybrid environments, including planning, execution, and post-migration validation.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, GitHub, or Azure Repos.
* Experience with Linux/Unix and Windows environments, including system troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes (AKS or EKS).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Azure Monitor, or AWS CloudWatch.
* Exposure to cloud migration tools (Azure Migrate or similar) and understanding of BCDR concepts.
* Experience deploying and managing applications in cloud-based production environments.
* Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or similar are a plus.

**Professional Attributes**

* Demonstrates high integrity with a proactive and positive approach to work.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and team-oriented environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on delivering practical solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continuously learn, adapt, and take on new challenges.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with teammates and stakeholders.

* Database Technologies: Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and automating:

+ MongoDB Atlas
+ SQL Server on AWS
+ AWS RDS and Aurora

* Scripting: Strong proficiency in Python or Bash for cloud automation and API integration.

6d42549c.title: Sr Advanced SW Architect
6d42549c.description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Advanced Software Architect at Honeywell, you will lead the architecture, design, and evolution of large-scale, cloud-native SaaS applications built on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for defining technical strategy, architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and engineering best practices for secure, scalable, resilient, and high-performing enterprise platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have 12+ years of overall software industry experience, including 8+ years of hands-on software design and development experience and 5+ years in Software Architect, Solution Architect, or Technical Architect roles. This role requires deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture, .NET Core/C#, microservices, distributed systems, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, AKS/Kubernetes, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hub.
  
  
As an Architect, you will provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams, drive architecture governance, evaluate emerging technologies, and ensure alignment between business objectives and technology solutions. You will mentor engineers, lead design reviews, oversee solution quality, and guide modernization initiatives using cloud-native and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in backend technologies, while maintaining a solid understanding of modern frontend frameworks and SPA architectures to effectively guide end-to-end solution design. Experience in DevOps, CI/CD, security-first development, observability, platform engineering, and enterprise integration patterns is highly desirable.
  
  
Additionally, the successful candidate will champion the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering practices, including the use of developer productivity tools, AI-powered coding assistants, and emerging AI Agent frameworks to accelerate software delivery, improve quality, and drive innovation.
  
  
You will report to the Engineering Manager and work from Bangalore, India, in a hybrid work environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define architecture and technical strategy for cloud-native Azure SaaS platforms.
* Lead solution design, architecture reviews, and technical governance across multiple product teams.
* Design scalable microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
* Drive adoption of Azure cloud-native services, AKS, containerization, and modern engineering practices.
* Ensure application scalability, performance, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Mentor engineers and architects while fostering engineering excellence and innovation.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Lead PoCs, technology evaluations, modernization initiatives, and architecture roadmap planning.
* Champion AI-assisted development practices and explore opportunities to leverage AI Agents in engineering workflows.

**Qualifications**
Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar AI frameworks.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep).
* Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, and observability platforms.
* Experience in Physical Security, PSIM, Building Automation, or Connected Buildings domains.
* Azure Architect Expert, Kubernetes, or Cloud Architecture certifications.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and large-scale modernization programs.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

912b5524.title: Technical Support Engineer (Cloud), India
912b5524.description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.
  
  
For this position, we are specifically looking for a candidate with strong Cloud, Linux, and automation experience who can complement the networking and firewall expertise already existing within the team and support AlgoSec's continued evolution toward SaaS, cloud-based capabilities, and AI integrations.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Support Team Leader / Support Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, India – office-based preferred; remote work may be considered
  
  
**Employment:**
Direct employment
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to AlgoSec customers and partners worldwide via email, phone, and web sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to product installation, configuration, operation, cloud infrastructure, applications, networking, and security environments.
* Guide customers, partners, and Sales Engineers through technical issues and product-related questions.
* Investigate complex technical problems across cloud, Linux, application, and network environments.
* Work closely with global Support teams, R&D, Delivery, and Product Management to drive issues to resolution.
* Take ownership of customer issues and manage them through resolution.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts and automations to improve Support efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase service reliability.
* Document technical findings and maintain and improve the AlgoSec knowledge base.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Support processes, methodologies, tools, and automation.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience in Technical Support or a similar customer-facing technical role within a software company.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux/Unix environments.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or maintaining operational automations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, or enhance service reliability.
* Experience supporting network security, infrastructure, or other complex enterprise software products.
* Good understanding of networking and security concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across cloud and application environments.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and take ownership through resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as part of a 24x7 global Support organization.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Experience implementing AI-powered operational workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent alerting, or GenAI-based Support automation solutions.
* Experience with SaaS products or cloud-native application environments.
* Experience with firewall technologies such as Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with R&D, Product, or Delivery teams on complex customer issues.
* Experience creating technical documentation or Knowledge Base content.

**Personal attributes**

* Independent, resourceful, and results-oriented.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
* Fast learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, and AI-driven operations.
* Strong team player with high integrity and a customer-first mindset.
* Comfortably operating under pressure and handling multiple technical issues simultaneously.

AlgoSec is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), committed to creating a friendly, diverse and inclusive company culture.

382f2ea4.title: Lead Technical Program Manager Fraud Technology
382f2ea4.description:
The
**Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology**
is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.
* Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.
* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.
* Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.

**Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration**

* Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.
* Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.
* Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.

**AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence**

* Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:

+ Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
+ Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.
+ Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.

**Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication**

+ Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.
+ Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.
+ Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).
+ Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.

**Risk, Governance, and Control Management**

+ Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.
+ Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).
+ Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.

**Qualifications & Competencies**
**Experience & Domain Expertise**

+ 10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.
+ 2+ years of experience supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.
+ Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.
+ Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.
+ Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.

**Project Management & AI Tooling**

+ PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.
+ Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.
+ Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.

**Leadership & Communication**

+ Demonstrated ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, drive consensus, and influence technical and business partners in a cross-functional environment.
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business-focused messaging.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.

**Education**

+ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts
* Experience working with customers in the manufacturing industry would be beneficial.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

7fe3a652.description:
**Bring more to life.**

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Pall Corporation, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The **SAP BTP Integration Architect** owns the architecture, engineering standards, and technical governance for integrations across Pall's global SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms.

This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements.

**In this role you will have the opportunity to**

* **Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture**, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices.
* **Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design** across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs.
* **Architect secure integrations across the SAP and enterprise technology landscape**, including SAP S/4HANA, DRC, Ariba, BTP solutions, third-party applications, suppliers, customers, and government platforms.
* **Establish integration, API, event, and security governance**, including identity and access, authentication, authorization, encryption, versioning, lifecycle management, reuse, privacy, and segregation of duties.
* **Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions**, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight.
* **Ensure integration reliability, compliance, and modernization**, including monitoring, error handling, performance, service levels, clean-core alignment, regulatory requirements, global e-invoicing, and migration of legacy interfaces such as SAP PI/PO.
* **Provide technical leadership and oversight**, including architecture reviews, design documentation, technical risk assessments, partner deliverables, developer/consultant mentoring, complex issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**The essential requirements of the job include**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* **10+ years of SAP architecture experience**, including at least 5 years delivering solutions on SAP BTP, with hands-on experience with Joule.
* **Demonstrated leadership of complex SAP transformation programs**, including at least three end-to-end SAP BTP integration implementations or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* **Deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and BTP architecture**, including Cloud Integration, API Management, event-driven integration, hybrid connectivity, identity services, environments and runtimes, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure operations.
* **Strong SAP and enterprise integration expertise**, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP platforms using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, messaging technologies, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy.
* **Experience designing secure, reliable, and AI-enabled enterprise integrations**, including Joule/AI agents, API and tool access, authorization, auditability, OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates, mutual TLS, exception handling, performance, availability, and responsible AI controls.
* **Strong technical leadership and communication skills**, with the ability to translate business, technical, security, and compliance requirements into architecture decisions and lead internal teams and external partners through design, build, testing, deployment, hyper care, and operational transition.

**Travel**

* Up to 20 percent travel, including international travel, based on project and deployment needs.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in**

* SAP Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Advanced Event Mesh, SAP Cloud ALM, or comparable observability and service-management tooling.
* Current SAP certification in Integration Suite, BTP solution architecture, or a closely related discipline.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

==========================================================

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Developer – Senior Analyst will develop, enhance, and support reporting and analytics solutions for Global Finance Services. The role is primarily focused on hands-on SAC story and dashboard development, data modeling, testing, documentation, and production support.

The Senior Analyst will work within established architecture, security, and governance standards to translate finance and operational requirements into accurate, intuitive, and reliable analytics products.

The successful candidate will collaborate with business analysts, data teams, quality assurance teams, and reporting stakeholders to deliver solutions, resolve issues, and support continuous improvement.

**Work You’ll Do**

As part of the Global Finance Services Reporting and Analytics team, you will build and support SAC solutions that convert business requirements and complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will contribute to the modernization of reporting by applying established development standards and delivering scalable, user-focused analytics products.

* Develop, enhance, and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud stories, dashboards, and analytical applications based on defined business requirements.

* Support dashboard performance tuning by optimizing calculations, filters, queries, and data-refresh processes.
* Apply established security, role-based access, development, and governance standards.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, quality assurance teams, subject matter experts, and end users throughout the development lifecycle.
* Prepare technical documentation, data definitions, test evidence, user guides, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Support deployments, production validation, maintenance, and enhancement activities.
* Provide work estimates, communicate progress and risks, and manage assigned deliverables with guidance from team leaders.

**Work Location and Shift**
---------------------------

**Work Location: India, Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 2:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.**

**Required Qualifications and Skills**
--------------------------------------

* 3–6 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, or enterprise reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, including story and dashboard development, data models, calculations, filters, input controls, and linked analysis.
* Working knowledge of dimensional and semantic data-modeling concepts, including dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and calculated measures.
* Experience using SAP data sources such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW, SAP HANA, or SAP Datasphere.
* Proficiency in SQL and experience with data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of finance reporting concepts, including actuals, budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, and management reporting.
* Experience with requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
* Ability to troubleshoot data-quality, performance, refresh, connectivity, and user-access issues.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities and deliver quality work within established timelines and standards.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP Datasphere, or related SAP cloud data and analytics services.
* Experience with SAC planning capabilities, including versions, data actions, allocations, forecasting, or scenario modeling.
* Experience with Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence, or another enterprise visualization platform.
* Familiarity with SAP BW queries, CompositeProviders, ADSOs, InfoObjects, SAP HANA calculation views, or related SAP data structures.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, Power Query, or Power Pivot.
* Relevant SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP BW, SAP HANA, or SAP Business Data Cloud certification.
* Experience working with global, virtual, or cross-functional teams.

**Portfolio Submission**
------------------------

* Anonymized or mock examples using public data are acceptable when confidentiality applies.

---------------

* Ability to explain technical information in practical business terms.
* Collaborative approach when working across business and technology teams.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, communicate risks, and meet deadlines.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. f965b7c6.title: Manager, Managed Services
f965b7c6.description:
**Why project44?**

At project44, we believe in better.

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn't just possible—it's essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.

With our **Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement,** we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

**AI at project44**

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

  

**Role Overview**

As a **Manager,** **Managed Service** , you will play a highly visible role partnering with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure world class delivery across a diverse portfolio. You will drive customer value through data analysis, operational excellence and proactive project management. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and requires the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple complex accounts and translate insights into long-term solutions.

As the Manager, Managed Services, you will lead a team of Managed Service Consultants and own the delivery of a diverse portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers. You will partner with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure strong outcomes in adoption, data quality and service performance, and you will set the operational standards, analytics practices and people development that make the team successful. This role blends strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving. You will influence senior stakeholders, coach your team through complex accounts and turn data insights into scalable, long-term solutions. This role reports to VP, Customer experience, manages a team of 5+ consultants and covers global region. Location: Bengaluru

**What You Will Work On**

* Hire, onboard, lead, coach and develop a team of Managed Service Consultants, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback and building a strong, high-performing culture.

* Own the health of the team’s customer portfolio, including delivery timelines, milestones, end-to-end project plans and risk management across global regions and multiple project44 products.

* Serve as an executive point of contact for key customers and carriers and escalate and resolve complex issues.

* Set the strategy for carrier initiatives, from planning through adoption, and review data-driven insights and best-practice recommendations presented by the team.

* Drive a culture of deep-dive data analysis, ensuring the team identifies patterns, uncovers root causes and delivers improvements that increase data quality and availability, using visualization tools and internal data platforms to triage errors and speed up issue resolution.

* Define and monitor team KPIs, review progress across accounts, and publish regular reports to leadership that highlight risks and business impact.

* Hold customers, carriers and internal teams accountable for actions that improve operational outcomes.

* Partner with Product, Support, Carrier Operations, Engineering and Sales to drive customer value, and represent the voice of the customer and carrier in cross-functional forums.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks and process improvements that raise quality, consistency and efficiency across the Managed Services practice, and identify process gaps and share scalable solutions across the organization.

* Allocate and balance workload across the team, and manage capacity, prioritization and competing demands.

* Maintain a deep understanding of carrier integration methods across modes, and guide the team’s technical decision-making.

What You Need

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, consulting or account management, including at least two years leading or managing a team.

* Experience in SaaS, software or logistics is preferred.

* Proven ability to manage a complex portfolio of enterprise customers and to lead multiple projects with competing priorities.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.

* Solid understanding of source data, data formats (such as EDI, API and file-based feeds) and data behaviour.

* Proficiency in Excel and SQL, and familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Kibana or Observe.

* Experience with APIs or basic coding concepts is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and develop talent, and to manage performance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels and a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

* Exceptional organizational skills and a track record of process improvement.
* Fluency in English and Spanish. Additional languages are a plus.

**In-office Commitment:** Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site, **in office five days a week** as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we’re building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**More about project44:**

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

2ca0682f.title: Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
2ca0682f.description:
Requisition ID: 25559

Job Category: Information Technology

Career level: Specialist

Contract type: Permanent

Location:
Pune, IN

**About SKF**
=============

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

  

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: *www.skf.com**/in*

  

**SKF Purpose Statement**
=========================

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

  

**JOB** **DESCRIPTION**

  

**Position Title:** Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms  
**Reports To:** Head of Digital Commercial Solutions  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor  
**Location:**Pune

  

**Purpose of the role**

  

Digital experience is becoming increasingly important in how customers discover, engage with, and do business with SKF. As part of SKF's digital transformation journey, we are evolving the capabilities that enable customers, partners, investors, job seekers, and employees to interact with SKF in more seamless, consistent, and personalized ways.

We are looking for a Solution Owner to drive the evolution of key digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management. These capabilities are fundamental to SKF's ambition of delivering compelling, scalable, and globally consistent digital experiences across channels and markets.

As a Solution Owner, you will be responsible for translating business needs and customer insights into prioritized initiatives that create measurable value. Working closely with stakeholders across business and technology, you will ensure that SKF's digital platforms and capabilities continue to support a modern, efficient, and customer centric digital ecosystem.

In addition to continuously improving today's capabilities, you will help shape SKF's future digital landscape. This includes exploring and enabling new opportunities in AI, automation, content operations, personalization, and customer experience optimization, ensuring SKF is well positioned to adapt to rapidly changing customer expectations and technological advancements.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Shape and drive the vision, strategy, and evolution of SKF's digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management.
* Own and prioritize the SKF.com product backlog, ensuring investments are aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and SKF's digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities that strengthen SKF's brand, improve customer engagement, and create seamless end-to-end digital journeys.
* Lead the evolution of digital capabilities that enable global content creation, management, localization, and delivery at scale.
* Drive strategic transformation initiatives that modernize how SKF creates, manages, delivers, and optimizes digital experiences across markets, channels, and touchpoints.
* Explore and enable emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and data driven personalization, to improve efficiency, content effectiveness, and customer experiences.
* Define roadmaps and investment priorities that balance innovation, operational excellence, scalability, security, and long term business value.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, UX specialists, web developers, content teams, and external partners to turn strategy into impactful digital solutions.
* Champion a customer centric and data driven approach to decision making, ensuring digital experiences are informed by insights, user behavior, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure digital platforms and capabilities remain secure, resilient, adaptable, and ready to support future business growth and changing customer expectations.
* Build strong partnerships with technology vendors and implementation partners to accelerate innovation and maximize the value of SKF's digital investments.

6e817f3f.title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
6e817f3f.description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.
