16c70eba.title: Community Growth & Engagement Manager
16c70eba.description:
**Company:**
The Marcom Avenue

**Client:**
Leading Consumer Technology Brand

**Location:**
Gurugram / Delhi NCR

**Experience:**
4–7 years (preferred)

**Department:**
Digital Strategy & Community Growth

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Client-facing

About the Role

We are looking for a
**community-first thinker, growth strategist, and relationship builder**
who can help transform our client's brand community app into a thriving ecosystem of engaged users, loyal brand advocates, and meaningful conversations.

This is not a traditional client servicing or social media management role.

We need someone who understands that
**a community is not built by posting more content. It is built by giving people compelling reasons to participate, contribute, connect, and return.**

**You will act as the strategic bridge between the client and The Marcom Avenue, aligning brand objectives, community insights, creative execution, and measurable growth.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Own Community Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to drive app registrations, active users, engagement, and retention.
* Identify opportunities to acquire new community members through digital campaigns, partnerships, influencers, product launches, and referral programs.
* Build initiatives that convert passive members into active participants and brand advocates.
* Identify friction points in the user journey and recommend improvements to onboarding, activation, and repeat engagement.

**2. Drive Community Engagement & Advocacy**

* Create innovative community-led IPs, challenges, contests, discussions, recognition programs, and exclusive experiences.
* Build engagement opportunities around the client's products, technology, photography, gaming, lifestyle, and innovation.
* Develop super-user, ambassador, and advocacy programs that reward meaningful participation.
* Encourage authentic user-generated content, peer-to-peer interactions, and community-led conversations.
* Ensure community initiatives go beyond vanity metrics and contribute to sustained participation.

**3. Act as the Strategic Brand–Agency Liaison**

* Serve as the primary coordination and strategic interface between the client's stakeholders and TMA's internal teams.
* Translate brand objectives into actionable community growth briefs, campaigns, and execution plans.
* Proactively recommend new growth opportunities instead of waiting for client instructions.
* Coordinate with creative, content, performance marketing, technology, and analytics teams to ensure timely execution.
* Conduct regular client reviews, document decisions, and maintain clear ownership of action items.
* Build a trusted relationship with the client through proactive thinking, responsiveness, and measurable outcomes.

**4. Build a Data-Driven Growth Engine**

* Track app acquisition, activation, daily/monthly active users, retention, and engagement.
* Analyze member behavior, content performance, participation patterns, and campaign effectiveness.
* Identify what makes users join, participate, return, and advocate.
* Develop weekly growth dashboards and monthly performance reviews.
* Translate data into experiments, recommendations, and measurable improvements.

**5. Bring Fresh Thinking & Innovation**

* Research successful global brand communities and emerging community engagement trends.
* Identify opportunities for gamification, loyalty, rewards, member recognition, and exclusive access.
* Explore collaborations with creators, technology enthusiasts, student communities, and relevant interest groups.
* Build a continuous pipeline of experiments to improve community acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to improve the overall community experience.

Skills & Experience Required

* 4–7 years of experience in community growth, consumer engagement, digital growth, product marketing, or brand communities.
* Proven experience driving measurable user acquisition, engagement, or retention.
* Strong understanding of digital communities, consumer psychology, and engagement mechanics.
* Experience working with consumer technology, smartphones, gaming, lifestyle, or youth-focused brands preferred.
* Ability to understand app analytics, user funnels, retention cohorts, and growth dashboards.
* Strong client communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate business objectives into creative, executable campaigns.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with community platforms, CRM, gamification, and growth experimentation is advantageous.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who:

* Thinks like a
  **growth marketer**
  , not just an account manager.
* Understands community behavior, not just content calendars.
* Is obsessed with what makes users return to an app.
* Can challenge conventional thinking and bring fresh ideas to the client.
* Combines creativity with numbers and execution discipline.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply coordinating tasks.
* Understands how to turn customers into contributors, and contributors into advocates.

Why This Role Matters

Our client's community should become more than another brand-owned digital platform.

**It should become a destination where people come for the experience, stay for the connections, and advocate because they genuinely belong.**

* **Your job is to help make that happen.**

52297708.title: PRINCIPAL, TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
52297708.description:
**About Team**
Walmart Global Tech team enables our stores and eCommerce operations across the world. The platforms that we build are used in most of the markets where Walmart has its presence. Global Marketplace team focuses on building Seller Platforms and interfaces which enables sellers across multiple countries to sell and generate business on eCommerce platforms.
  
  
We're looking for highly skilled and experienced Principal Technical Program Manager with a breadth of skills who can create and execute a plan for new strategic initiatives as well as driving the global technology platforms across Global Tech. You should be able to drive high level design, solutioning & delivery of program with our next generation platforms keeping scalability, robustness and security aspects in focus. The platforms we build will be used by customers & sellers across multiple countries with each of them being a multi billion dollar business for Walmart. If you thrive on solving complex technical problems and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment with passionate software developers, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you. As our business continues to expand into new opportunities and evolve with innovations in supply chain and customer experience, we have an exciting opportunity to build software that scales our operations, leads the industry through innovation, and delights millions of customers worldwide. We leverage cutting-edge technologies such as big data, machine learning, AI, real-time analytics, and high-volume, low-latency, high-availability services to achieve these goals.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a part of the Marketplace Program Management team you will impact the shopping of our customers to build solutions that will enable a seamless, highly scalable omni-channel experience for a multi-billion dollar enterprise. You impact the Walmart business directly in driving technology strategies to enable the sellers with the best user experience to onboard, list items and sell and grow their business by selling on Walmart eComm platforms. You may have to travel to the United States and other international locations, working closely with Business Stakeholders, World Class Product Teams, and fellow globally based engineering teams, bridging the gap between business and technology worlds.
  
  
Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development programs. You will work closely with architects, engineers, product, design and business leaders to ensure the successful completion of these programs' To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and software design principles. You will also need to demonstrate influential skills by building strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and programs project cadences. Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints. Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in. You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process. Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise. Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  

* Drive quarterly planning efforts, effectively negotiate against priorities, resources, and timelines to secure commitments from partner teams.
* Create the environment for effective collaboration across 4ITB by establishing appropriate forums and enabling Ways of Working improvements.
* Establish processes that drive efficient planning and execution.
* Work with product and engineering in solutioning of new capabilities, driving clarity in product requirements.
* Create a detailed program plan with milestones and timelines and maintain program documentation.
* Resolve ambiguous situations and bring clarity to the program teams.
* Manage program scope, including changes and scope creep ensuring that the program stays aligned with its original scope.
* Monitor program progress against the established schedule and provide weekly status reports to the program stakeholders.
* Proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation plan and manage cross-functional issues to unblock program team.
* Ensure monitoring and alerting are set up and ensure effective operational excellence frameworks are implemented.
* Ensure that the program adheres to the organization’s standards, policies, and best practices.

**What You'll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computerscience/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall 15+ years of technical experience with 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts,architecture,UXdesign, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, projectmanagement tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, BigPicture, GenAI etc.would be advantageous.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+years of experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
* Project Management Certification.

**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Work
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing diversity- unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people

Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management

Develops, defines, and executes plans of record, including: schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks. Monitors budget/spending, on-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* PMP Certification.
* 7+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 3+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 2+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
* 2+ years of experience with program management tools such as dashboards, Gantt charts, etc.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop goals, set the prioritization of deliverables, and discuss necessary priorities and stakeholder needs.
* Manages and takes responsibility for multiple small programs/technology with moderate complexity or a single complex program/technology by applying up-to-date program management knowledge to meet deadlines.
* Develops and manages the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope) for multiple small programs or a single medium sized or complex programs/technologies which includes schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholder identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization.
* Tracks and manages all key metrics pertaining to a program and identifies when metrics deviate significantly from Plan of Record; escalates issues in a timely manner and proposes corrective actions.
* Manages and prioritizes the work of the program team by establishing schedules, task assignments, and tracking tasks of team members.
* Identifies program issues/risks and creates a risk mitigation plan for multiple small programs or a single medium sized or complex program. Maintains and updates the risk tracker.
* Helps to promote program vision and objectives within own team, and ensures program objectives are met or exceeded.
* Supports the adoption of processes by applying best practices and identifying and recommending process improvement opportunities within respective programs.

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Working independently with little supervision.
* Making decisions that are moderate in impact; errors may have financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.
* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. May require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
* Having a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to provide input on key decisions).
* Completing tasks that do not have defined steps; simultaneous use of multiple mental abilities is generally required to determine the best approach; mistakes may result in significant rework.
* Exercising substantial creativity to innovate new processes, procedures, or work products within guidelines or to achieve established objectives.
* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or conflicting; advanced data analysis and interpretation skills are required.
* Occasionally participates in strategic planning within own area affecting immediate operations.

**The Responsibilities Of This Role Do Not Include**

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).

Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. f59bb93d.title: Project / Program Manager
f59bb93d.description:
**Job Title**: Project / Program Manager

**Experience** : 10 19 yrs

**Notice Period**: Immediate to 15 Days.

**Location** : Pune

  

**Role Summary**

The Program Manager will lead a high impact marketplace platform program for a large enterprise client in a delivery focused client facing role This role involves end to end program management strategic leadership and stakeholder management to ensure the programs objectives are met on time within budget and to the required quality and scope The Program Manager is accountable for planning executing and governing multiple project workstreams aligning project outcomes with the clients business goals and marketplace platform strategy

This position demands strong leadership communication and organizational skills to coordinate cross functional teams and deliver a successful marketplace program that achieves the desired business outcomes

**Key Responsibilities**

The Program Manager will have full ownership of program delivery and governance Key responsibilities include  
Program Planning Execution Develop a comprehensive program plan and schedule based on client needs establishing a scope budget and timeline baseline Oversee daytoday program execution including Multi project coordination resource planning and change management to keep all workstreams aligned with program goals  
Delivery Management Drive the program to completion on time within budget and to scope Monitor progress across all projects implement rigorous milestone tracking and budget control and proactively manage variances to ensure the program stays on track and in control.  
Risk Issue Management Anticipate potential risks and issues across projects Establish a structured risk and issue management process identify assess and mitigate risks promptly and effectively7 Develop actionable contingency plans to address project challenges and ensure minimal impact on timelines or deliverables  
Stakeholder Communication Interface regularly with client and internal stakeholders at all levels providing clear updates on program status risks and achievements8 Prepare and deliver executive level reports to communicate progress and ensure stakeholder alignment Serve as the primary point of contact for program related communications managing expectations and facilitating issue escalation and resolution.  
Quality Governance Enforce program governance processes and quality standards throughout the program lifecycle10 Conduct stage gate reviews and quality assurance checkpoints to ensure deliverables meet enterprise standards and contract requirements Maintain rigorous adherence to project management methodologies and client's compliance guidelines  
Team Leadership Coordination Lead cross functional teams including project managers and technical leads in a matrix environment to ensure cohesive execution11 Foster collaboration among engineering product operations and other functional teams to meet integrated program milestones Provide mentorship and clear direction to project teams aligning their activities with the program's strategic objectives  
Business Alignment Ensure the marketplace platforms development and deliverables align with the client's business objectives and marketplace strategy12 Collaborate with product owners' architects and business analysts to incorporate marketplace best practices and requirements into the program Support development of business cases and ensure the program delivers expected business value and ROI

**Education Bachelors** degree in Computer Science Engineering Business Management or a related field advanced degree preferred Professional ProjectProgram Management Certification eg PMP PRINCE2 PgMP is highly desired

Domain Knowledge Familiarity with digital marketplaces ecommerce platforms or largescale platform implementation projects Demonstrated ability to quickly understand complex platform architectures and business models

00433403.title: PMO AI Solutions & Enablement Lead
00433403.description:
Job Description PMO AI Solutions & Enablement Lead

Position: PMO AI Solutions & Enablement Lead  
Function: Global PMO / Service Innovation & Transformation  
Experience: 10 Years 

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced PMO AI Solutions & Enablement Lead who can design, develop and implement AI-powered solutions to improve project management processes and PMO operations.  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, workflow automation, AI integrations and low-code/no-code platforms. The person will identify business challenges, build AI prototypes, automate manual processes and work with business and technical teams to implement practical AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Identify opportunities to implement AI and automation across PMO processes.  
Design, build and configure AI-powered solutions and prototypes.  
Develop AI use cases for meeting minutes, project status reports, risk tracking, documentation and project reporting.  
Work with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering and RAG-based solutions.  
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, databases and document repositories.  
Implement workflow automation using low-code/no-code platforms.  
Establish AI governance, testing, security and quality standards.  
Collaborate with Project Managers, PMO leadership and technology teams.  
Conduct pilot testing, gather user feedback and improve AI solutions.  
Train and mentor PMO teams on AI tools and best practices.  
Develop AI implementation roadmaps and ensure knowledge transfer.

Required Skills

Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)  
Prompt Engineering  
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)  
AI Agents and AI Workflow Automation  
Python / API Integrations  
Low-Code / No-Code Automation Platforms  
Workflow Orchestration  
Structured and Unstructured Data Management  
Knowledge Management and Data Integration  
AI Solution Design and Prototyping  
AI Governance, Testing and Evaluation  
Business Process Analysis and Transformation  
Stakeholder Management

Good to Have

Experience with OpenAI, ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex.  
Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform experience.  
Experience with enterprise AI implementations.  
Project Management / PMO experience.  
AI Product Management or Product Owner experience.  
Experience working in enterprise transformation projects.

Candidate Profile

Strong hands-on experience in building and implementing AI-powered business solutions.  
Ability to independently design and develop AI prototypes.  
Good understanding of enterprise integrations and automation.  
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.  
Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.  
Experience coaching teams and driving AI adoption.

Key Expectations

Deliver 2–3 AI-powered solutions or working pilots.  
Automate PMO activities and reduce manual effort.  
Establish AI governance and implementation standards.  
Build internal AI capabilities and provide knowledge transfer.  
Develop a roadmap for future AI adoption.  
  
Recruitment focus: Prioritise candidates with hands-on Generative AI implementation, RAG, AI agents, workflow automation, API integrations and enterprise AI solution-building experience rather than candidates with only traditional PMO or project coordination experience.

8d12320a.title: Senior Presales Consultant- Palo Alto
8d12320a.description:
**Job Purpose**
Working with the Company's Sales Team, the Presales Consultant is responsible for providing presales technical support to the Sales team and presenting tailored demonstrations or qualification discussions to customers and/or prospects. The Presales Consultant also assists the Sales Team with qualifying opportunities - in or out and helping expand existing opportunities through solid questioning. The Presales Consultant will be responsible on conducting Technical Proof of Concept, Demonstration & Presentation on the supported products & solution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assist Account/Product Managers with qualification of opportunities by providing presales technical support.
* Provides pre-sales technical support and deliver deep dive product demonstrations to customers and business partners.
* Delivers training to partners on products solution.
* Contribute to and refine technical RFP/RFI responses
* Customer demonstrations and presentations
* Coordinating and managing technical validation events (POC)
* Coordinating and managing POC assets
* Participating in conferences, shows, exhibitions when appropriate and requested
* Recommend and influence market content.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Requires an in-depth knowledge of vendor products and general networking technologies including TCP/IP, DNS (UNIX) Admin, and experience with switches, routers, and firewalls in Intranet/Internet environments.
* Good Network & Security knowledge
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, with ability to articulate complex technology simply.
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems.
* Self-motivated and flexible.
* Ability to effectively multi-task and be able to handle a high volume of requests, specifically unplanned/unscheduled requests.
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to exhibit ability to be sensitive to the needs, concerns, and feeling of others.
* Able to interact effectively with all levels of management.

These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

00be8511.title: Presales Engineer (BFSI)
00be8511.description:
**Company Description**
**Why Join Us**
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
  
  
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
  
  
This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
  
  
We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
  
  
What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
  
  
If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
  
  
**Your role in a nutshell**
No two days for a Check Point security engineer are the same, from getting hands on with the most advanced technologies in the market, to learning more about the customer’s most pressing security challenges and playing a crucial part in designing a solution, you’re always at the heart of fascinating projects!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Major Responsibilities**

* Winning Sales opportunities by working closely with the partner sales team - identify prospects, progress sales opportunities and help win them demonstrating the Check Point value-proposition
* Present the Check Point story at key forums, including partner led customer events & workshops
* Handholding and jointly conducting POCs and assessments along with partner technical / presales community for prospect customers
* Lead with value-driven conversations with potential and existing customers with ability identify business problems and provide winning solutions
* Become a trusted Cybersecurity advisor for your partner technical community, handling technical questions, presenting Check Point value with the solutions offered
* Demonstrate strong knowledge on Cybersecurity industry developments including tackling competitive threats in sales opportunities
* Help partners respond to RFI’s & RFP’s, share best practices, manage Proof-of-Concepts that translate to best CX through the sales cycle
* Engage and enable key partners and customers on the latest security technologies
* Demonstrate sales acumen through clever positioning of Check Point’s products for optimum cross-sell and Upsell along with partners in their base accounts
* Deliver high impact customer engagements, solution design, winning proposals and uphold the leadership position of Check Point
* Participate and showcase Check Point’s solutions during cyber security events

**Qualifications**
**Desired Background**

* 10+ years of proven experience in technology organizations with over 6 years of direct system engineering and pre-sales experience
* Strong customer centricity with focus on delivering the best experience for customers
* Ability to roll-up the sleeve when required to address gating challenges
* Possess strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent understanding of networking technologies combined with strong understanding of design and applications
* Ability to create an end-to-end security solution for a customer’s environment
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Relevant certifications highly preferred, e.g. CCNP / CISSP/ CCSA / CCSE
* An engineering degree in Computer, Electronics or similar disciplines

28968d66.title: Principal Solution Consultant - General Insurance Industry
28968d66.description:
**Summary**
The Principal Solution Consultant is a high-impact, strategic leadership role essential to Guidewire’s India Market Entry & Penetration. You will be a pivotal member of the India Go-to-Market (GTM) engine, working in lockstep with Field Leadership to transform Guidewire from a global leader into a dominant local force.
  
  
You are a "Market Pioneer" responsible for translating Guidewire’s global SaaS value proposition into a winning strategy for Indian Tier-1 and Tier-2 insurers. Your mission is to disrupt the status quo held by legacy incumbents like by proving Guidewire’s superior agility in the General Insurance industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
Guidewire’s Go to Market organization is focused on scaling AI‑powered innovation, expanding into new markets and product categories, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable through structured, data‑driven execution and tight cross‑functional alignment.
  
  
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you sit at the intersection of this vision and our India growth strategy, serving as the senior field‑facing authority on how Guidewire’s platform, cloud services, and ecosystem can unlock value for Indian insurers.
  
  
Operating as a key member of the regional GTM leadership team, you will design and execute market‑entry and expansion plays for India, partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and our partner ecosystem. You will champion local market needs back into our global roadmap while coaching and scaling an India‑based Solution Consulting team. This is a high‑impact, highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable in the boardroom, on customer sites, and in the details of complex insurance workflows.
  
  
**Core Objectives**

* Go-to-Market Strategy: Co-own and execution of the Indian GTM strategy.
* Strategic Deal Lead: Own the functional "Win Theme" for major prospects, moving beyond feature lists to business outcomes.
* Market Challenger: Effectively position Guidewire as the modern SaaS alternative to legacy incumbents.
* Executive Advisor: Have the gravitas to engage with C-suite stakeholders (CEO, CTO, Business Unit Leaders).
* Thought Leadership: Act as the voice of the Indian market, specifically regarding industry trends, to influence global product roadmaps.
* You’ll work closely with Indian customers, SI Partners, internal product and field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the above objectives. You’ll also support the development of our local team and help scale our operation across the market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* GTM Strategy & Execution: Partner with Field Leadership to refine the India penetration plan. Identify high-propensity targets, define regional "Win Themes," and tailor the global sales playbook for the Indian context.
* Strategic Market Research: Conduct "boots-on-the-ground" discovery to identify unique Indian functional gaps (e.g., specific IRDAI compliance workflows, UPI-based real-time claims, or localized Health TPA models) vs Guidewire’s "Out-of-the-Box" (OOTB) features.
* Competitive Intelligence: Build a detailed "Battlecard" against local incumbents. Identify their architectural weaknesses in the Indian market and train the wider field team on how to exploit them.
* End-to-End Deal Ownership: Lead the functional sales cycle, from initial discovery and RFI/RFP management to final selection and contract alignment.
* Field Leadership Collaboration: Act as the primary technical/functional advisor to the Regional Sales Director and Managing Director. Provide the "solution air cover" needed to close the first wave of lighthouse customers.
* Consultative Discovery: Uncover the "pain behind the pain" in a prospect’s current operations (e.g., rigid legacy codebases, slow speed-to-market for new products).
* Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to build a cohesive business case, ensuring all functional risks are mitigated.
* Product Localization Advocacy: Collate recurring requirements from Indian prospects and present a prioritized "India Roadmap" to Global Product Management.
* Team Leadership: Develop the India-based Solution Consulting team by coaching them on advanced storytelling, competitive positioning, and executive presence.
* Ecosystem Integration: Work with the Guidewire Marketplace and local partners to demonstrate a "frictionless" insurance experience (e.g., integrating with the India Stack, UPI, and AI-driven fraud detection).

**Product & Domain Expertise**

* India P&C Mastery: Deep expertise in the Indian General Insurance market.
* Competitive Displacement: Proven ability to position modern SaaS against legacy core insurance solutions. You must be able to articulate why a modern cloud platform beats a "One-Size-Fits-All" legacy suite.
* Digital Ecosystem (India Stack): Knowledge of how to leverage Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker within the insurance lifecycle to create a frictionless, paperless customer journey.
* Guidewire Cloud Value: Ability to sell the "Evergreen" nature of SaaS—proving to Indian CIOs that they will never have to perform a painful 2-year legacy upgrade again.

**Professional Experience**
**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* 12+ Years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solution Consulting: A proven track record of leading functional sales cycles for complex, high-value SaaS or Core Systems (Policy, Billing, Claims).
* Market Entry Expertise: Experience working in a "pioneer" or "early-hire" capacity for a global technology firm entering the Indian market is highly desirable.
* Competitive Displacement: Demonstrated success in unseating legacy or entrenched incumbents (specifically TCS BaNCS, SAP, or Oracle) within the Indian Financial Services sector.

**Domain & Technical Mastery**

* Indian P&C Specialist: Deep functional expertise in general insurance. You should understand the nuances of the Indian "Grid" system, TPA integrations, and IRDAI product filing requirements.
* Cloud/SaaS Evangelist: While Guidewire experience is a plus, you must have a strong grasp of Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and the ability to sell the business value of "Evergreen" software over traditional on-premise and custom build models.
* Digital Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, eSign) and how these technologies are being leveraged to digitize the insurance value chain.

**Leadership & Strategic Skills**

* Field Partnership: Experience working as a "Strategic Right Hand" to Sales VPs or Managing Directors to build and execute a Go-to-Market (GTM) plan.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional "C-Suite" communication skills; the ability to challenge the thinking of a CEO/CIO and move them from a "safe" legacy choice to a transformative platform.
* Consultative Storytelling: Mastery of "The Challenger Sale" or similar methodologies—turning dry product features into a compelling business narrative that addresses specific Indian market pain points.

**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.
  
  
Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

6cbdce86.title: Solution Area Specialists - Windows Devices
6cbdce86.description:
**Overview**
With a vision to
**build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem**
, the
**Windows and Device Sales (WDS)**
organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
  
  
WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners - to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
  
  
This role contributes to a
**multi‑billion‑dollar business**
and plays a direct role in
**defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform**
, enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
  
  
As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders - anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders - to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
  
  
In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. ### **Summary**

Internal Job Title: Assoc. Dir. DDIT ISC Security Architecture AI
  
#LI-Hybrid
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
Relocation Support: Yes
  
  
Help shape how AI can be built, deployed, and scaled securely. In this role, you’ll influence the security architecture behind next-Generation AI solutions, defining standards and patterns that protect AI models, data, pipelines, and agentic systems throughout their lifecycle. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, and architecture, partnering with technical teams to address emerging threats, strengthen secure AI development, and turn evolving security challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

### **About the Role**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead AI architectural activities and develop secure solution architectures across business and technology domains.
* Define AI security standards and best practices for protecting AI pipelines, datasets, models, and infrastructure.
* Develop logical architecture designs and strategies to secure the organization’s AI domain and infrastructure.
* Establish and evolve AI architecture governance frameworks, including methods, practices, standards, and reusable architecture patterns.
* Assess the AI landscape, identifying and mitigating security risks across model training, deployment, and operations.
* Evaluate AI security technologies and integrate appropriate security controls across AI platforms and Large Language Models.
* Secure AI and agentic systems against model poisoning, adversarial inputs, prompt injection, jailbreaking, and emerging threats.
* Design Model Context Protocol servers, AI agent workflows, secure deployment architectures, and AI gateway integrations.
* Build Python services, developer tools, integrations, and AI security harnesses supporting secure software development.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and DevOps teams to embed security throughout the AI development lifecycle.
  

  

### **Essential Requirements**

* **12+ years of overall professional experience**, including substantial experience across security, architecture, software development, and AI security engineering.
* At least 5 years of security experience, 5 years in architecture, 5 years in development, and 2+ years in AI security and engineering.
* Proven AI security architecture expertise covering training data, models, pipelines, deployed AI solutions, security policies, standards, and architecture patterns.
* Strong knowledge of AI threats, risk identification, threat modeling, data privacy, and defenses against adversarial and AI-based attacks.
* Hands-on experience securing Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning applications across cloud platforms, with strong Amazon Web Services engineering and architecture expertise.
* Production experience with AI coding agents, Model Context Protocol servers, agent workflows, Python development, automated testing, and AI gateway integrations.
  

  

### **Desirable Requirements**

* Security engineering or application security background, with experience evaluating and working with specialized AI security technologies.
* Experience building developer-facing command-line tools and working effectively in multi-vendor, global technology environments.

-------------

----------

* Extensive hands-on experience with enterprise data modeling (Logical, Physical, Conceptual ERD). Data modeling tool experience a plus (like ERWIN)

* Advanced SQL skills

* Knowledge of ETL/ELT frameworks, tools and processes

* Understanding of Business intelligence tools and technologies such as Power BI

40bf45f9.title: Senior Solutions Architect
40bf45f9.description:
**Company Profile**

Our client is a Leather and Fur manufacturer and exporter based out of Delhi and Gurgaon. The

company is an unlisted Indian private company that operates a contemporary clothing brand and

serves as a strategic partner for global brands like Nike and Converse in India. The company acts as a

strategic partner to global brands in India. Operating in major Indian cities and also manage the

brands franchise for Pan India operations. The company also produces trendy and contemporary

apparels and fashion accessories in India.

**Location & work**
– Mumbai / Gurgaon, India

**Employment Type**
- Full Time

**Profile**
– Senior Solutions Architect - Systems, Data & AI

**Preferred experience**
– 10+ Years

**The Role:**

We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect who can join our team. The candidate will own the

overall technology architecture across the organisation's business systems ((ERP, CRM, finance),

integrations, data and AI solutions. The role will focus on building a reliable and scalable technology

foundation that connects systems, improves access to business data and enables applications,

reporting and automation.

The individual will maintain an end-to-end understanding of how business systems operate, how

data moves between them and how it is used by applications and teams. This includes being hands-

on in investigating issues, working with data, designing solutions and guiding implementation, while

ensuring that systems remain reliable, secure and fit for evolving business needs.

**Responsibilities:**

1.
**Systems Architecture & Integration**

∙Assess existing business systems, applications and integrations to identify gaps and

opportunities for improvement.

∙Design how business applications, databases, APIs and data platforms connect and exchange

information.

∙Build and improve integrations across operational systems, ERP, CRM, finance and other

relevant platforms.

∙Evaluate technology options and recommend solutions that balance business needs,

reliability, scalability and cost.

∙Establish clear architecture standards and documentation to support future development

and maintenance.

**2. Data Engineering & Management**

∙Build and maintain data pipelines that bring information together from business systems,

databases and APIs.

∙Design and maintain data models with clear definitions, relationships, history and business

rules. Ensure data is accurate, consistent and reliable through validation, automated checks

and reconciliation with source systems.

∙Handle data updates, duplicates, missing information and changes in source systems without

disrupting downstream reporting and applications.

 
∙Maintain data definitions, documentation and traceability so that teams can understand

where information comes from and how it is used.

∙Monitor and improve pipeline reliability, data processing performance and warehouse costs.

**3. AI & Automation**

∙Design the technical foundation for AI-enabled applications, intelligent workflows and

business process automation.

∙Enable AI applications to securely access relevant business systems and reliable data sources.

∙Work with AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs) and retrieval-augmented

generation (RAG), to support relevant business use cases.

∙Ensure AI solutions have appropriate controls for data access, accuracy, reliability and

sensitive information.

∙Identify opportunities to build reusable integrations and AI capabilities that can support

multiple business functions.

**4. Security, Reliability & Technical Leadership**

∙Ensure systems and integrations follow appropriate security, access control and data

protection practices.

∙Establish monitoring, error handling and recovery processes to identify and resolve issues

promptly. Guide technical decisions, review proposed solutions and work closely with

engineers to ensure effective implementation.

∙Remain hands-on in technical design, troubleshooting and implementation where required.

Document systems, integrations and technical decisions, and establish clear ownership for

ongoing maintenance and support.

∙Identify technical improvements and prioritise them based on business impact, complexity

and long-term requirements.

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

∙Minimum 10 years of experience as a Solution Architect.

∙Significant experience in data engineering, systems architecture, solution architecture or

software engineering, with ownership of production systems and complex technical

solutions.

∙Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, data validation and query optimisation.

∙Practical Python experience for data processing, automation, integrations and

troubleshooting.

∙Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift.

∙Strong understanding of data modelling, including data relationships, historical records,

business rules and dimensional modelling.

∙Experience with data transformation tools such as dbt or equivalent, and pipeline

orchestration, monitoring and recovery.

∙Experience integrating business applications and operational systems through APIs,

connectors or other integration methods.

∙Strong understanding of application architecture, databases, system dependencies and data

flows.

∙Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP

∙Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, access controls, documentation and data

security.

∙Practical understanding of AI/LLM applications and how they integrate with business systems

and data, including familiarity with RAG and related approaches.

∙Experience using Git, code reviews and automated checks to manage technical changes

safely.

**Preferred Skills:**

∙Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science,

Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

∙Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, explain technical trade-

offs and work directly with business and technical teams.

∙A hands-on approach, with the ability to move between architecture design, implementation

and troubleshooting.

**Application Method**

Apply on LinkedIn or email your resume to: careers@speedmart.co.in

62d80929.title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect
62d80929.description:
**Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect - Presales**
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-level executives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Design & Architecture:

+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor-made mainframe solutions, including on-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections & views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales & Client Engagement:

+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C-level executives, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs-of-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization & Innovation:

+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re-hosting, refactoring, re-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership & Mentorship:

+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing & Risk Management:

+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:

+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA-7/ESP/Control-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.

IBM Mainframe administration certification

e2a4aac6.title: Senior Presales Engineer
e2a4aac6.description:
**Job Description**

**Culture at CloudifyOps :**  
Working at CloudifyOps is a rewarding experience! Great people, a work environment that thrives on creativity, and the opportunity to take on roles beyond a defined job description are just some of the reasons you should work with us.

**About the role :**  
As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you own the technical side of our pursuits, from first discovery call to signed SoW and handoff to delivery. You will be the Senior Engineer in the pre-sales team, shape CloudifyOps' cloud, DevOps and AI transformation offerings, and act as the trusted advisor to enterprise and startup clients. You sit between Sales, Delivery and Technology, and you are expected to turn customer problems into differentiated, AI-enabled solutions that can be delivered and priced with confidence.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be in front of customers and in the architecture, while also building the assets, benchmarks and standard plays that let the whole team win more consistently.

**What will you do :**

**Solutioning and architecture**

* Design cloud infrastructure, DevOps and platform engineering solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP, and recommend the best-fit approach with clear trade-offs.
* Own end-to-end solutioning for RFIs and RFPs, including architecture, SoWs, effort estimates and cost models.
* Ensure solutions in every SoW follow best practice, match client requirements and are deliverable by our teams.

**AI transformation**

* Shape and position our AI transformation offerings: agentic AI for cloud migration and modernization, AIOps and autonomous operations, AI-assisted DevOps/DevSecOps, and AgentOps governance.
* Run AI readiness and use-case discovery workshops with client CTO, CIO and engineering leaders, and translate them into prioritized roadmaps and PoCs.
* Define where AI delivers measurable value (planning, estimation, IaC generation, code refactoring, incident response) and where it does not, with clear guardrails for data security, governance and cost.
* Work with the CTO office and engineering teams to feed customer needs back into our AI platforms and accelerators.

**Customer engagement and PoCs**

* Plan, build and deliver compelling PoCs and demos that show business value, including AI-powered migration, assessment and operations scenarios.
* Act as subject matter expert for end-to-end DevOps: configuration management, CI/CD, release engineering, provisioning and Day-2 automation.
* Build trust with customers through technical depth, strategic thinking and execution.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing and Alliances to build winning proposals, standard plays, upsell and cross-sell motions, and new service offerings that build pipeline.
* Build and maintain a repository of reusable pre-sales assets, pricing and effort benchmarks, and standard tools and processes.
* Work with Delivery for a smooth handoff and technical oversight after the deal closes.
* Identify trends, risks and issues that need escalation, and operate within defined SOPs.

**Requirements :**

* 7-12 years of overall experience, with at least 5 years in pre-sales, solution architecture or technical consulting for cloud and DevOps. Prior experience leading or mentoring a team.
