e9d098fe.title: Junior Security Architect
e9d098fe.description:
Job Description: Security Architect   
Role overview:   
The Security Architect is responsible for assessing, designing, reviewing, and governing security architectures across   
cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, mobile applications, APIs, third-party SaaS platforms, and AI-enabled   
applications. The role ensures that security requirements are incorporated into solution architecture and design from   
the early stages of the development lifecycle through deployment and operations.   
The architect will identify security risks, recommend risk-based controls, define reusable security patterns and   
reference architectures, and work with engineering and operations teams to ensure that solutions align with   
enterprise security policies, standards, and regulatory obligations.   
1. Key Responsibilities   
A. Security Architecture Reviews and Solution Design   
- Conduct security architecture and design reviews for new applications, existing applications, technology   
transformations, cloud migrations, and major architectural changes.   
- Assess architectures for web applications, mobile applications (Android and iOS), APIs, microservices,   
event-driven systems, serverless applications, containerized applications, and distributed systems.   
- Review solution architecture diagrams, data-flow diagrams, trust boundaries, network flows, authentication   
mechanisms, authorization models, and technology dependencies.   
- Identify security gaps, architectural weaknesses, attack surfaces, misconfigurations, and design-level risks.   
- Define security requirements and recommend appropriate preventive, detective, and corrective controls.   
- Evaluate solutions against enterprise security policies, technical standards, reference architectures, and   
security baselines.   
- Document findings, risk ratings, remediation recommendations, compensating controls, and residual risks.   
- Collaborate with solution architects, application teams, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to   
integrate security into solution design.   
B. Cloud Security Architecture   
- Perform security architecture reviews across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle   
Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and hybrid or on-premises environments.   
- Demonstrate a strong understanding of cloud service models, shared responsibility models, cloud-native   
services, landing zones, subscriptions/accounts, organizational hierarchies, and multi-account or multi  
subscription architectures.   
- Assess the security of IaaS, PaaS, cloud-native services, managed databases, storage services, serverless   
workloads, containers, Kubernetes, and platform services.   
- Design secure cloud architectures incorporating network segmentation, private connectivity, secure   
service-to-service communication, encryption, identity controls, centralized logging, and monitoring.   
- Evaluate cloud configurations for excessive permissions, public exposure, insecure management   
interfaces, insecure service configurations, and unintended trust relationships.   
- Assess the security implications of hybrid-cloud connectivity, cross-account access, cross-subscription   
communication, third-party integrations, and multi-cloud deployments.   
- Define and promote reusable cloud security patterns, approved architectural designs, and secure   
deployment blueprints.   
C. Application, API and Mobile Application Security   
- Conduct security reviews for web applications, mobile applications, APIs, microservices, backend services,   
and enterprise application integrations.   
- Understand common application security vulnerabilities, including injection, broken access control,   
authentication weaknesses, insecure session management, insecure data handling, and security   
misconfiguration.   
- Review application authentication and authorization flows, token handling, session lifecycle, API exposure,   
and service-to-service communication.   
- Assess mobile application security risks, including insecure local storage, sensitive data leakage, certificate   
validation weaknesses, reverse engineering, insecure backend APIs, and compromised-device scenarios.   
- Evaluate API gateway architectures, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, input validation, API   
authentication, authorization, and abuse prevention.   
- Review security implications of application frameworks, third-party libraries, open-source components,   
software supply chains, and external integrations.   
- Translate application security findings from penetration testing, SAST, DAST, SCA, and API security testing   
into actionable architecture improvements.   
- Apply secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles and integrate security requirements into   
design, development, testing, and deployment.   
D. AI Application and Emerging Technology Security   
- Conduct security architecture reviews for AI-powered applications, large language model (LLM) solutions,   
retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and enterprise AI integrations.   
- Evaluate AI application architectures involving model providers, AI platforms, embedding services, vector   
databases, data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, and external tools.   
- Assess risks such as prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive   
agency, insecure tool execution, and improper trust in model outputs.   
- Review AI agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architectures, including tool permissions,   
authentication, authorization, input and output validation, and execution boundaries.   
- Assess security controls for model access, AI gateways, API endpoints, model registries, prompts,   
embeddings, vector stores, and AI-related data flows.   
- Evaluate AI integration patterns involving enterprise identity providers, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC),   
API keys, managed identities, and workload identities.   
- Define security requirements for AI application onboarding, approved AI services, third-party AI tools, AI   
governance, and production deployment.   
- Apply relevant AI security frameworks and guidance, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and   
OWASP guidance for LLM applications.   
E. Identity and Access Management (IAM), OAuth and API Security   
- Demonstrate strong knowledge of cloud IAM concepts, identity federation, role-based access control   
(RBAC), attribute-based access control (ABAC), privileged access management (PAM), and workload   
identities.   
- Understand the critical role of IAM in cloud security and its impact on the security of applications,   
infrastructure, APIs, data, and administrative operations.   
- Review authentication and authorization architectures involving enterprise identity providers, SSO, SAML   
2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and modern federation protocols.   
- Understand OAuth flows, including Authorization Code with PKCE, Client Credentials, token issuance,   
access-token validation, refresh tokens, scopes, consent, and token lifecycle management.   
- Assess how applications securely obtain, store, use, rotate, and revoke client credentials, access tokens,   
refresh tokens, certificates, and API keys.   
- Review identity federation and cross-account or cross-tenant access, including trust policies, role   
assumptions, managed identities, and service principals.   
- Identify excessive permissions, overprivileged service accounts, shared identities, insecure trust   
relationships, hard-coded credentials, and inappropriate privilege escalation paths.   
- Design and recommend least-privilege access models, just-in-time access, strong authentication,   
privileged access controls, and periodic access reviews.   
- Evaluate OAuth-based integrations between enterprise applications, cloud-hosted workloads, and third  
party SaaS providers.   
F. Cloud Networking Security   
- Assess cloud network architectures, including virtual networks, VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups,   
network ACLs, firewalls, and network segmentation.   
- Review hub-and-spoke architectures, transit connectivity, hybrid-cloud networking, VPNs, dedicated   
private connections, and inter-cloud connectivity.   
- Evaluate private endpoints, private service access, public IP exposure, ingress and egress paths, DNS   
security, and service-to-service communication.   
- Review WAF, API gateway, reverse proxy, load balancer, CDN, and DDoS protection designs.   
- Understand Zero Trust network architecture and the application of identity-aware access, explicit   
verification, least privilege, and continuous assessment.   
- Identify network attack paths, exposed management interfaces, unrestricted outbound access, insecure   
routing, and unintended paths that could bypass approved security gateways.   
- Recommend network security controls that align with application architecture, business requirements, and   
risk exposure.   
G. Third-Party SaaS Security Architecture and Assessments   
- Conduct security assessments of third-party SaaS applications before onboarding, integration, significant   
architectural changes, and production deployment.   
- Assess SaaS architecture, authentication, SSO, provisioning, authorization, API integrations, data storage,   
encryption, tenant isolation, logging, and administrative access.   
- Evaluate SaaS integration patterns using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, API keys, certificates, webhooks,   
and service accounts.   
- Determine whether required controls are supported natively by the SaaS provider or must be enforced   
through enterprise security services such as the identity provider, CASB/SSPM, SIEM, PAM, or API security   
gateways.   
- Assess external attack surfaces, public endpoints, API exposure, network connectivity, data flows, and   
dependencies on subcontractors or other service providers.   
- Review vendor security documentation, independent assurance reports, penetration-testing evidence,   
vulnerability management practices, incident response capabilities, and contractual security   
commitments.   
- Identify gaps between vendor capabilities and enterprise security requirements; recommend remediation,   
compensating controls, risk acceptance, or rejection where necessary.   
- Document SaaS security assessment results, applicability of controls, ownership, residual risks, and   
approval recommendations.   
H. Threat Modelling and Risk Assessment   
- Conduct threat modelling for cloud infrastructure, application architectures, APIs, mobile applications, AI   
solutions, and third-party integrations.   
- Identify assets, threat actors, entry points, trust boundaries, data flows, attack surfaces, abuse cases, and   
potential attack paths.   
- Apply suitable threat-modelling methodologies such as STRIDE, attack trees, data-flow analysis, and   
scenario-based risk assessment.   
- Analyse threats associated with misconfiguration, insecure identities, privilege escalation, data exfiltration,   
exposed services, compromised credentials, and supply-chain compromise.   
- Evaluate threats associated with cloud control planes, management APIs, container platforms, serverless   
services, AI models, agentic workflows, and external tools.   
- Assess likelihood, business impact, exploitability, exposure, and potential consequences to determine risk   
severity.   
- Recommend risk-based controls and validate whether residual risk is acceptable.   
- Maintain traceability between threats, identified risks, security requirements, remediation actions, and risk   
acceptance decisions.   
I. Zero Trust Architecture and Secure Design Principles   
- Apply Zero Trust principles to cloud infrastructure, enterprise applications, APIs, workloads, and data   
access.   
- Understand and implement secure design principles, including least privilege, defence in depth, secure   
defaults, fail-safe behaviour, separation of duties, complete mediation, and minimizing attack surface.   
- Design identity-centric access models that authenticate and authorize users, devices, workloads, and   
services based on contextual and risk-based requirements.   
- Apply segmentation, isolation, strong authentication, continuous monitoring, and explicit authorization to   
reduce lateral movement.   
- Ensure that security controls are enforced at appropriate layers rather than relying solely on network   
perimeter defenses.   
- Evaluate architectures for single points of failure, excessive trust, insecure dependencies, inadequate   
isolation, and weak security boundaries.   
- Promote security-by-design and privacy-by-design throughout the solution lifecycle.   
J. Cloud Security Governance, Policies and Standards   
- Develop, maintain, and implement enterprise cloud security policies, standards, technical baselines,   
reference architectures, and security patterns.   
- Translate enterprise security policies into actionable technical requirements for cloud platforms,   
applications, data, IAM, networking, and operations.   
- Establish and maintain security architecture review processes, approval criteria, security exceptions, risk   
acceptance workflows, and remediation tracking.   
- Define control ownership and accountability across Security Architecture, Cloud Engineering, Application   
Engineering, IAM, DevOps, SOC, and business teams.   
- Establish cloud security governance requirements for new services, cloud adoption, account or   
subscription onboarding, application deployment, and technology changes.   
- Assess cloud security posture against defined baselines and applicable regulatory, contractual, and   
organizational requirements.   
- Establish mechanisms for monitoring control implementation, measuring compliance, reporting risk, and   
tracking remediation.   
- Promote security automation and policy-as-code to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and   
prevent noncompliant deployments.   
K. Cloud Platform and Infrastructure Security   
- Review security controls for virtual machines, operating systems, containers, Kubernetes clusters,   
serverless functions, managed databases, storage, and cloud platform services.   
- Assess infrastructure provisioning practices and recommend controlled deployment through Infrastructure   
as Code (IaC), approved templates, and governed CI/CD pipelines.   
- Review Terraform, CloudFormation, and other infrastructure automation for insecure configurations,   
excessive permissions, exposed resources, and policy violations.   
- Assess secrets management, certificate management, encryption, configuration hardening, patch   
management, vulnerability remediation, and workload isolation.   
- Evaluate container image security, cluster access controls, workload identities, admission controls,   
runtime security, and Kubernetes network policies.   
- Review cloud security posture management (CSPM), cloud-native application protection platforms   
(CNAPP), cloud detection and response (CDR), and workload protection capabilities.   
- Identify opportunities to embed security controls into cloud engineering workflows and automated   
deployment pipelines.   
L. Cloud Security Operations and Monitoring   
- Understand how architectural decisions affect security monitoring, incident detection, investigation,   
containment, and recovery.   
  
- Define logging, auditability, telemetry, and ing requirements for cloud control planes, applications,   
identities, APIs, and workloads.   
- Ensure security-relevant logs are integrated with enterprise SIEM and monitoring platforms and are retained   
according to organizational requirements.   
- Review cloud detection and response use cases, threat detection coverage, escalation processes, and   
incident response requirements.   
- Work with SOC and Cloud Security Operations teams to address visibility gaps, detection limitations, false   
positives, and recurring security incidents.   
- Assess whether critical workloads, identities, data stores, and exposed services have appropriate   
monitoring and response coverage.   
- Recommend preventive and detective controls that reduce risk while supporting operational resilience and   
business continuity.   
- Support security incident investigations by analyzing architectural weaknesses, attack paths, and   
opportunities for control improvements.   
M. Cloud Data Security and Privacy   
- Assess data classification, ownership, storage, processing, transfer, sharing, retention, and deletion   
requirements.   
- Review encryption at rest and in transit, key management, secrets management, tokenization, masking, and   
access controls.   
- Evaluate security of cloud storage, databases, data lakes, analytics platforms, backups, snapshots, and   
disaster recovery environments.   
- Assess data exposure risks arising from public access, cross-account sharing, excessive permissions,   
insecure APIs, and third-party integrations.   
- Define controls for sensitive data discovery, access monitoring, exfiltration prevention, and secure data   
lifecycle management.   
- Review data residency, privacy, retention, and cross-border transfer requirements where applicable.   
- For AI solutions, assess risks involving training data, prompts, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval   
pipelines, model outputs, and sensitive information leakage.   
N. Security Controls Planning and Implementation   
- Convert architecture review findings and threat assessments into clearly defined, prioritized, and   
measurable security controls.   
- Develop control implementation plans covering control objectives, technical requirements, ownership,   
dependencies, implementation timelines, and validation criteria.   
- Work with engineering teams to select and implement appropriate controls using native cloud capabilities   
and enterprise security tooling.   
- Define preventive, detective, corrective, and compensating controls based on business risk and technical   
feasibility.   
- Validate control effectiveness through design reviews, configuration assessments, evidence collection,   
testing, and operational feedback.   
6   
- Track remediation actions, exceptions, residual risks, and overdue security findings.   
- Ensure that controls are operationally sustainable and integrated into established engineering and security   
operations processes.   
O. Reference Architectures and Security Patterns   
- Develop and maintain reusable security reference architectures for cloud platforms, enterprise   
applications, APIs, mobile applications, AI applications, and SaaS integrations.   
- Create architecture patterns for IAM, OAuth-based integrations, Zero Trust, network segmentation, secure   
data access, secrets management, logging, and threat detection.   
- Define approved architectural patterns for RAG applications, AI gateways, AI agents, MCP servers, and   
model integrations where applicable.   
- Establish architecture decision records, security design guidance, reusable diagrams, control mappings,   
and implementation examples.   
- Ensure reference architectures remain aligned with evolving threats, cloud-native capabilities, enterprise   
standards, and business requirements.   
- Enable engineering teams to adopt secure-by-default designs and accelerate security reviews through   
standardized patterns.   
2. Required Technical Knowledge and Skills   
The candidate should demonstrate practical understanding and the ability to apply the following concepts during   
architecture reviews.   
Technical domain   
Required knowledge   
Cloud platforms   
AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, IaaS, PaaS, cloud-native services, shared responsibility   
Application security   
Web, microservices, APIs, authentication, authorization, secure SDLC   
Identity and access   
IAM, RBAC, ABAC, federation, SSO, PAM, workload identities   
OAuth and API   
security   
OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, PKCE, scopes, token validation, API gateways   
Cloud networking   
VPC/VNet, segmentation, private endpoints, firewalls, WAF, DNS, hybrid connectivity   
Threat modelling   
STRIDE, attack trees, trust boundaries, data-flow diagrams, risk assessment   
Zero Trust   
Identity-centric access, explicit verification, least privilege, continuous assessment   
Cloud infrastructure   
IaC, Terraform, CloudFormation, containers, Kubernetes, serverless   
SaaS security   
Vendor assessments, SSO, SCIM, OAuth integrations, tenant isolation, external attack   
surface   
Cloud data security   
Security operations   
Encryption, KMS, secrets, classification, access control, data protection   
SIEM, CSPM, CNAPP, CDR, vulnerability management, incident response   
AI security   
LLMs, RAG, AI agents, MCP, prompt injection, model and data security   
Security governance   
Policies, standards, baselines, reference architectures, risk exceptions, control   
assurance   
  
3. Frameworks and Industry Standards   
The candidate should have familiarity with relevant industry frameworks and security standards, including:   
- NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).   
- NIST SP 800-53 and NIST SP 800-207 (Zero Trust Architecture).   
- Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix (CSA CCM).   
- CIS Benchmarks and cloud provider security best practices.   
- OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP MASVS/MSTG for mobile applications.   
- OWASP SAMM and secure software development practices.   
- NIST AI Risk Management Framework and OWASP guidance for LLM application security.   
- ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27017, where applicable.   
- MITRE ATT&CK and relevant cloud threat-modeling resources.   
- OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications.   
The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every framework. They should be able to select appropriate   
requirements, map security controls, and apply the relevant guidance to actual architecture decisions.   
4. Required Experience and Qualifications   
- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related   
discipline.   
- Typically, 8-12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with substantial experience in security architecture,   
cloud security, application security, or infrastructure security.   
- Demonstrated experience conducting security architecture reviews for enterprise-scale applications and   
cloud solutions.   
- Hands-on experience assessing cloud security configurations, IAM, networking, application integrations,   
and security controls.   
- Experience working with engineering teams to remediate architectural risks and implement security   
controls.   
- Experience preparing architecture review reports, threat models, security recommendations, reference   
architectures, and governance documentation.   
- Ability to communicate complex technical risks to both engineering teams and senior stakeholders.   
- Experience with multi-cloud environments, enterprise SaaS security, and AI application security is highly   
desirable.   
Preferred certifications:   
- CISSP/ CCSP/ISSAP/ SABSA/ equivalent enterprise/security architecture certification   
- AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent cloud security certification   
- Relevant AI security certifications   
  
5. Key Competencies   
The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:   
1. Architecture assessment: Ability to understand a proposed solution and identify security risks across its   
components and trust boundaries.   
2. Security design: Ability to recommend appropriate architectures and controls, rather than simply identify   
vulnerabilities.   
3. Risk-based decision-making: Ability to prioritize findings based on likelihood, impact, exposure, and   
business context.   
4. Technical depth: Ability to explain authentication flows, cloud networking, IAM policies, token lifecycles,   
data flows, and control implementation.   
5. Cross-functional collaboration: Ability to work with architects, developers, cloud engineers, operations   
teams, IAM, SOC, and third-party vendors.   
6. Governance and documentation: Ability to develop actionable standards, review reports, reusable patterns,   
and remediation plans.   
7. Communication: Ability to explain technical risks and present practical recommendations to technical   
teams and management.   
6. Expected Deliverables   
The Security Architect is expected to produce and maintain:   
- Security Architecture Review reports and recommendations.   
- Threat models, data-flow diagrams, and attack-surface assessments.   
- Cloud, application, mobile, API, AI, and SaaS security assessment reports.   
- Security requirements and control implementation plans.   
- Security reference architectures, reusable patterns, and secure design guidelines.   
- Architecture risk registers, remediation trackers, and risk exception documentation.   
- Security architecture standards, technical baselines, and control mappings.   
- Security design validation and control effectiveness evidence.

  
**Required Skills**

b27060ad.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent

* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. * Advanced analytical thinking, with a focus on integrating data-driven insights and predictive models into financial planning processes.
* Experience in diagnosing and solving technical and process challenges efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex concepts to diverse audiences.
* Strong relationship-building skills to foster trust and credibility with clients and internal teams.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies, including Oracle Cloud updates and AI-driven solutions.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, learning, and innovation in enterprise performance management.
* Must possess a valid passport and be willing to travel for client site work (domestic and international)

**Education**
:
  
  

* Graduate from a reputed educational institution; MBA or equivalent preferred.
* Oracle Cloud (SaaS + OCI), TOGAF, PMP, Agile certifications preferred

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

e693f42c.title: Project Manager / Program Manager
e693f42c.description:
Responsibilities:

MaxLinear's Analog & Mixed Signal (AMS) Business Unit is seeking an experienced Project Manager / Program Manager to lead strategic semiconductor product development programs from concept through production release. This role requires a strong blend of program leadership, technical depth, business acumen, and stakeholder management to successfully execute complex analog and mixed-signal silicon development programs.

The ideal candidate will have 8-10 years of experience in semiconductor product development and program management, with a solid understanding of the end-to-end IC development lifecycle. The role demands close collaboration with IC design, engineering, systems, operations, marketing, quality, manufacturing, and applications teams across global locations to ensure successful delivery of products that meet technical, schedule, quality, and business objectives.

  

* programs from product conception to volume production.
* Define project scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Establish program governance mechanisms and lead phase-gate reviews throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive execution excellence across multiple concurrent projects while balancing technical, schedule, and business priorities.
* Lead collaboration across systems, architecture, design, verification, validation, product engineering, quality, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, packaging, and marketing teams across global locations.
* Ensure alignment of cross-functional stakeholders toward program objectives and key deliverables.
* Facilitate technical and management reviews, decision-making forums, and escalation processes.
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules and critical path tracking.
* Identify technical, operational, and business risks proactively and drive mitigation plans.
* Monitor program health through key performance indicators, milestone tracking, and status reviews.
* Resolve cross-functional issues and remove execution roadblocks to maintain project momentum.
* Serve as a primary program interface for internal customers, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Communicate program status, risks, mitigation plans, and key decisions to key stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations while ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution plans.
* Support customer reviews, project updates, and major program milestones.
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to drive successful silicon bring-up, qualification, and manufacturing readiness.
* Support transition from development through validation, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining phases.
* Ensure readiness across supply chain, test, quality, and manufacturing functions for product launches.
* Collaborate with Business Unit leadership and Product Management teams on strategic planning and execution.
* Track program budgets, resource utilization, and operational metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program execution, predictability, and organizational efficiency.

Qualifications:

* 8-10 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, or Technical Program Management within the semiconductor industry.
* Proven track record leading complex semiconductor product development programs from concept to production.
* Experience working with Analog, Mixed-Signal, Power Management, Connectivity, ASIC, or SoC-based products.
* Strong understanding of the semiconductor product development lifecycle, including:
* Ability to engage effectively with engineering teams and understand technical trade-offs, risks, and development challenges.
* Strong proficiency in project planning, scheduling, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.
* Expertise in program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Excel & MS Office
* Experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones – India, Asia Pacific and US.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and lead cross-functional teams toward common objectives.
* Excellent executive-level presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering or VLSI or related equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in Analog/Mixed-Signal IC design, Product Engineering, Validation, or Applications Engineering.
* Experience managing customer-specific or custom silicon development programs.
* Familiarity with AMS products such as power management ICs, Bridge ICs, serial transceiver ICs, SoC, data converters, interface products, or connectivity solutions.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing, qualification, reliability, and supply chain processes.
* PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certifications.

Company Overview:

MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system-on-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi-market applications.

We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner.

MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end-to-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs.

Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside-the-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

**Description**
Grocery Catalog and Supplier org is looking for a passionate and innovative Sr Technical Program Manager to join our Catalog team. This team will be deployed against some of our most complex and challenging projects and will deliver innovative technical solutions. We have an opportunity to revolutionize on-line shopping and set new standards for accessing the highest quality organic and natural groceries on-online.
  
  
As the Sr TPM, you will be a key member of tech leadership and will need to drive forward the technology across catalog system to create a best in class online grocery shopping experience.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr Technical Program Manager (TPM) with business and technical skills, great communication abilities, and a passion to use cutting edge science and technologies to help WFM.
  
  
Our team is seeking Sr Technical Program Managers to manage large, cross functional programs and projects that support catalog business. In this role you will be responsible for delivering large projects end-to-end that span multiple technology and operational teams. These projects will include initiatives such as rolling out new technology to new geographies as we expand, creating new technology to support new businesses and use cases, and otherwise building great technology platforms that can scale. In this role, you will lead large-scale re-architecture of our technology stack across multiple systems and teams. You will lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts, coordinating across multiple teams to develop optimal solutions. You will be expected to make appropriate tradeoffs to optimize time-to-market, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional and remote project teams.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is inherently cross-functional—this leader will work closely with engineering, project management, design, operations, finance, legal, business development, customer service, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, team oriented, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. The leader will have a proven track record in taking on end-to-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment. As a Sr TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 8+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

48c5c280.title: Delivery Manager - Java/.NET
48c5c280.description:
We are seeking an exceptional, business-savvy, and technically accomplished **IT Delivery Manager** with 10 to 14 years of IT industry experience to lead our enterprise software delivery portfolios.

In this role, you will own the strategic delivery roadmap, operational execution, and engineering excellence for multiple cross-functional teams building and modernizing large-scale systems on Java/Spring and/or .NET/C# stacks. You will act as a strategic bridge between executive business leaders, product management, and engineering teams, driving robust Agile delivery frameworks while maintaining high standards of code quality, architecture scalability, and cloud governance.

The ideal candidate has transitioned from a solid technical background (originally as a Software Developer, Tech Lead, or Architect in Java/.NET) into a seasoned delivery leader capable of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios, driving engineering transformations, and mentoring next-generation tech leaders.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and govern the end-to-end delivery of a multi-million-dollar portfolio of enterprise applications built on modern Java and .NET stacks
* Champion and scale Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple distributed product engineering teams, optimizing velocity, cycle time, and release predictability
* Manage and optimize the portfolio budget, forecasting resource needs, controlling operational expenses (OpEx/CapEx), and ensuring high ROI
* Establish robust delivery governance, identify systemic delivery risks early, and implement proactive mitigation plans to protect critical business timelines and SLAs
* Orchestrate end-to-end software delivery for complex, enterprise-level Java/.NET applications using Agile (Scrum or Kanban) methodologies
* Adapt traditional Agile metrics (team velocity, sprint burn-down, cycle time) to analyze and optimize productivity gains achieved through GenAI tools
* Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, ensuring development workflows seamlessly integrate AI code generation, automated unit testing, and code review
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects to guide development teams migrating legacy monolithic codebases into modern cloud-native (AWS, Azure, or GCP) microservices
* Provide high-level technical oversight for teams delivering in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate) or .NET (.NET Core, .NET 8+, C#, ASP.NET Web API)
* Champion continuous improvement in delivery pipelines, driving automated testing, robust CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and cloud infrastructure optimization
* Partner with VP/C-level executives, Product Owners, and Business Units to translate long-term business strategy into actionable technical delivery roadmaps, while overseeing offshore/nearshore partners, SOWs, and vendor contracts
* Direct, mentor, and inspire a high-performing organization of Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Tech Leads, and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous upskilling (including AI-assisted engineering tools like Copilot)

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a business-related discipline
* 10-14 years of overall IT industry experience, including at least 1-2 years in an IT Delivery Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager role managing multiple concurrent software development teams
* Proven track record of successfully managing enterprise portfolios with budgets exceeding $5M+ and teams of 50+ engineers
* Background in software engineering with hands-on experience in Java (Spring frameworks, Spring Boot, J2EE legacy) and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core)
* Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), cloud-native design patterns, and serverless architectures
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker
* Knowledge of distributed database environments (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, NoSQL)
* Expertise in modern integration technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, API Gateways)
* Proficiency in scaling Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across distributed engineering teams
* Competency in CI/CD maturity, DevSecOps adoption, and automated testing practices
* Capability to manage project scopes, timelines, resource allocation, and multi-million dollar budgets
* Skills in stakeholder management, vendor negotiation, and executive-level communication
* English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
  
  
English proficiency at Advanced level.
  
  
Good presentation and demonstration skills

Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
  
  
Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
  
  
Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
  
  
Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
  
  
Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

833e363e.title: Technical Architect
833e363e.description:
**Role: Technical Architect**  
**Experience: 9- 15 Years**  
**Job Type: Full-Time (Hybrid)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced **Technical Architect** to drive the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical evolution of ThrivePass's core platforms. This is a senior individual contributor role that combines strategic architectural leadership with hands-on engineering responsibility.

As the technical owner of critical business systems, you will define long-term architectural direction, lead complex technical initiatives, solve high-impact engineering challenges, and ensure the platform remains scalable, resilient, and maintainable as the business grows.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions while mentoring engineers and elevating overall engineering excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Architecture & System Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end technical health of core applications, including scalability, performance, reliability, security, and availability.
* Define, document, and continuously evolve system architecture aligned with business growth and engineering best practices.
* Lead architecture reviews, modernization initiatives, platform improvements, and technical decision-making.
* Identify technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and system risks, and drive remediation strategies.
* Establish long-term architecture roadmaps that support product and business objectives.

**Engineering Excellence & Delivery**

* Design and build scalable, enterprise-grade applications and services.
* Lead the implementation of high-impact technical initiatives, platform enhancements, and system integrations.
* Take ownership of complex technical challenges and critical components across the technology stack.
* Drive engineering quality through architecture reviews, code reviews, coding standards, and best practices.
* Ensure solutions are maintainable, testable, and built for long-term sustainability.

**Scalability, Reliability & Operations**

* Architect systems that support fault tolerance, resiliency, graceful degradation, retry mechanisms, and idempotent operations.
* Improve system observability through robust logging, monitoring, metrics, and alerting frameworks.
* Lead root-cause analysis of production incidents and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Continuously optimize performance, operational efficiency, and platform reliability.

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for system-level architecture and design decisions.
* Mentor and guide engineers through design discussions, code reviews, architectural reviews, and hands-on problem solving.
* Provide technical leadership during planning, estimation, and execution phases.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Backend & Cloud Technologies**

* Strong expertise in **C#, .NET Core/.NET 8+,** **ASP.NET** **Core, Web APIs, and Distributed Systems**.
* Strong experience with **Microsoft Azure**, including cloud-native application design and deployment.
* Deep understanding of database design, performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and data consistency concepts.
* Experience with service-oriented architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, and complex integrations.
* Strong knowledge of concurrency, asynchronous programming, caching strategies, and system performance optimization.

**Frontend & Cross-Functional Expertise**

* Solid understanding of **Angular, TypeScript, and modern web application architecture**.
* Ability to review frontend designs, troubleshoot cross-stack issues, and define scalable API contracts.
* Understanding of application performance, state management, security, and user experience considerations.

**Engineering & DevOps Practices**

* Expertise in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release management, and deployment strategies.
* Strong experience with application monitoring, logging, tracing, and production diagnostics.
* Deep understanding of software design patterns, clean architecture principles, and engineering best practices.

**Experience Required**

* 10-15 years of software engineering experience with significant exposure to large-scale production systems.
* Proven experience designing, architecting, and scaling enterprise applications.
* Track record of owning mission-critical systems and delivering high-quality technical solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives across teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Architecture is scalable, well-documented, and aligned with long-term business goals.
* Systems demonstrate high reliability, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Production incidents decrease through proactive design improvements and engineering practices.
* Teams consistently deliver high-quality features with reduced technical risk.
* Engineers rely on you as a trusted technical leader for architecture, design, and system-level decision making.

0da180b0.description:
**Company Description**
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are hiring a hands-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical-first: you will own the end-to-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical-path features), while partnering with a global, cross-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI-powered development practices—including spec-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Hands-On)**

* Architecture + Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication & Authorization: Implement end-to-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service-to-service identity (e.g., managed identities).

9f38a6b7.title: ServiceNow Architect -SOMT-Manger

**EY-ServiceNow Technical Architect - Telecom Sales & Order Management (SOMT) & Integrations**
As part of EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will be solving client problems using the ServiceNow platform. You will get the opportunity to work with a high-performing team and drive innovative solutions that address complex client needs.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a hands-on ServiceNow Technical Architect with deep expertise in Telecom Sales & Order Management (SOMT), enterprise integrations, and ServiceNow platform development. The ideal candidate will lead architecture and delivery while actively contributing to coding, configuration, troubleshooting, and mentoring teams. Experience with telecom OSS/BSS ecosystems, Performance Analytics, and AI capabilities is essential.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and deliver ServiceNow Sales & Order Management (SOM/SOMT) solutions for telecommunications clients.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and stakeholder reviews.
* Design and implement integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Scripted APIs, and MID Servers with external OSS/BSS, CRM, ERP, billing, and inventory systems.
* Remain hands-on by configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, Catalog Items, UI Actions, and custom applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and production issues through root cause analysis and technical leadership.
* Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance.
* Mentor and train junior developers, providing technical guidance and capability development across the team.
* Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
* Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead-to-Cash processes.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with tools like JIRA, ServiceNow Agile, or equivalent for backlog management
* Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
* Experience in stakeholder management and client-facing roles
* Knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest features and roadmap

**What We Look For**

* A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You’ll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. You will help customers achieve measurable value from their Confluent investments by improving technical health, accelerating adoption, guiding best-practice decisions, and proactively managing risks across their streaming environments.

* Coordinate with Support and other Confluent and IBM teams on escalations, ensuring the customer has a clear path forward and that remediation actions are tracked to completion.
* Help customers prepare for critical events such as upgrades, major launches, architecture changes, and production growth.
* Educate customer teams on Confluent capabilities, recommended practices, and relevant product developments.
* Bring customer feedback and product insights back to Confluent, helping improve the customer experience and inform product direction.
* Contribute to the CSTA practice by sharing technical knowledge, reusable guidance, playbooks, and lessons learned.

Bachelor's Degree

4bc6de7d.description:
**Technical Consultant – API Management Platform Resiliency**
With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company in the world. Our offices have earned #GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
  
  
**No AI Without API. Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
Join us at DHL Group Digital Platforms department, where innovation thrives and technology evolves. With a presence across three countries and two continents, we are building a One Stop Shop for all DHL Group APIs and AI-enabled services. Our startup spirit within a stable enterprise environment enables us to deliver secure, scalable, and modern platforms powered by Agile and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
**About The Role**
Join the API Management Platform (AMP) Resiliency team and strengthen the availability, recoverability, scalability and operational resilience of enterprise API services. The role assesses platform risks, defines resilience standards and recovery requirements, and drives improvement initiatives across cloud and on-premises environments.
  
  
The position requires knowledge of both Apigee X, Apigee Hybrid or another enterprise API gateway to support the resilience of our API management platforms. You will work across DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to improve disaster recovery, business continuity, service readiness and operational controls.
  
  
**#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #digitalplatforms #APIPlatform #Resiliency #Cloud**
**Grow together**
**Your role as Technical Consultant - AMP Resiliency:**

* Coordinate platform resilience assessments, technical risk reviews and improvement roadmaps.
* Assess platform architecture for single points of failure, capacity constraints, service-dependency risks and recovery limitations.
* Define platform resilience, disaster recovery, business continuity and operational-readiness requirements.
* Identify critical service dependencies and support the definition and validation of recovery objectives.
* Plan, coordinate and govern disaster recovery, failover and recovery-readiness exercises; validate evidence, document outcomes, identify gaps and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Define and maintain resilience standards, runbooks, support procedures and service-readiness documentation.
* Establish minimum resilience and operational-readiness criteria for platform services.
* Work with DevOps, network, cloud, security and infrastructure teams to address availability, capacity, connectivity and recovery risks.
* Define and review monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboarding, observability and service-health reporting requirements.
* Assess the resilience and operational impact of vulnerabilities, BitSight findings, security findings and control gaps; coordinate remediation plans and monitor actions through closure.
* Support incident reviews and root-cause analysis, converting lessons learned into preventive improvements.
* Review platform changes, upgrades and architecture decisions for their impact on availability, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Report material risks, unresolved gaps, dependencies and remediation progress to relevant stakeholders.
* Promote consistent resilience practices across API gateway technologies and hosting models.
* Participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required, providing resilience, recovery and cross-team coordination expertise.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here's what we are looking for:**

* Demonstrated experience in platform operations, infrastructure consulting, service reliability, SRE, disaster recovery or enterprise API platform support.
* Practical knowledge of both Apigee X and Apigee Hybrid.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
* Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, failover, capacity management and operational risk.
* Experience assessing technical architectures for resilience, recoverability and operational-readiness risks.
* Experience planning or governing disaster recovery and recovery-readiness exercises.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, observability and service-health reporting.
* Understanding of networking, connectivity, certificates, security controls and platform dependencies.
* Experience with incident management, problem management and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to define technical standards, produce clear assessments and drive cross-team remediation activities.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder-management and technical-consulting skills.
* Willingness and ability to participate in major-incident escalation and the on-call support rotation when required.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with SRE practices, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation or cloud platforms.
* Experience supporting security and compliance remediation in an enterprise environment.
* Knowledge of GCP and API platform network-connectivity patterns.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, Kubernetes and automation concepts.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre-existing disease.

96de7e2e.title: Senior Program Manager, ServiceNow Platform
96de7e2e.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Program Manager**
to lead complex, cross-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the
**ServiceNow platform**
capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving strategic program planning, execution governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives within the ServiceNow capability.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine strong program leadership, business acumen, technical understanding, and executive communication skills to ensure programs deliver measurable value, remain aligned with organizational priorities, and meet quality, compliance, security, and operational expectations.
  
  
**Experience Range:**
16+ years
  
  
**Role Level:**
Senior Program Manager
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Program Strategy & Delivery
  
  

* Lead end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale technology programs from initiation through delivery and operational transition.
* Define program scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple projects, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and enterprise standards.

Governance, Risk & Controls
  
  

* Establish and manage program governance forums, decision frameworks, escalation paths, and executive reporting rhythms.
* Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, information security, change management, and operational readiness requirements.
* Maintain high-quality program documentation, status reporting, and evidence required for governance and control processes.

Stakeholder & Executive Communication
  
  

* Partner with senior business leaders, product owners, architects, engineering leaders, operations teams, finance partners, and external vendors.
* Prepare and deliver executive-ready updates covering program health, key decisions, risks, dependencies, financials, and business outcomes.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and ensure clear ownership of decisions and actions.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, planning workshops, and cross-functional working sessions.

Agile & Delivery Management
  
  

* Drive Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery practices across teams and programs.
* Monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, milestones, burn-up/burn-down trends, impediments, and release readiness.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and facilitate timely resolution of delivery blockers.
* Promote continuous improvement in planning, estimation, delivery predictability, and team operating practices.

Financial, Vendor & Resource Management
  
  

* Manage program budgets, forecasts, cost tracking, resource plans, and financial reporting in partnership with finance and leadership teams.
* Oversee vendor delivery performance, contract dependencies, and third-party commitments where applicable.
* Support capacity planning, prioritization, and trade-off decisions across program workstreams.
* Track program value realization, benefits, and measurable business outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in program management, project management, technology delivery, or related roles.
* Proven experience leading complex technology programs across multiple teams, geographies, or business functions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release management, change management, and technology operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, dependencies, risks, executive communications, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for executive audiences.
* Knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, GRC, Security Operations and similar processes and procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certification.
* Experience in enterprise applications, digital transformation, financial services technology, regulatory programs, or platform modernization.
* Experience managing vendor partners, statements of work, managed services, or third-party delivery models.
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, production support, observability, and operational resilience practices.
* Experience preparing executive dashboards, steering committee materials, and board-level or senior leadership updates.

**Technical Skills**

* Agile / Scrum / Kanban / SAFe delivery practices
* Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Clarity, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint
* SDLC, Release Management, Change Management, DevOps, CI/CD
* Program governance, portfolio reporting, and executive dashboards
* Risk, issue, dependency, and decision management
* Budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, and resource management
* Vendor management, SOW tracking, and third-party delivery oversight
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Ecosystem will be a significant plus.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
* Leadership, influence, and cross-functional collaboration
* Executive communication and presentation skills
* Financial and commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management and expectation setting
* Decision making and problem solving
* Conflict resolution and negotiation
* Delivery discipline, ownership, and accountability
* Coaching, mentoring, and continuous improvement orientation

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
