9384d102.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
9384d102.description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru (Work from Office)
  
  
**Experience:**
8–10 years
  
  
**Reports to:**
Head of Customer Success
  
  
**About Mojro**
At Mojro, we don’t just optimize logistics – we reimagine it. We are a deep-tech logistics optimization company helping some of the world’s largest FMCG, Paints, CEP and Retail enterprises simplify complex logistics challenges. Our platforms – PlanWyse (route and load optimization) and ExecuteWyse (real-time execution monitoring) – reduce transportation costs, raise service levels and power smarter, faster decisions for customers such as Unilever, Asian Paints, Berger and Godrej.
  
  
**The role**
You will own the technical success of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, from first kickoff to steady-state operations. You design and deliver the implementation, own the integrations, take customers live, and remain their primary technical authority after go-live. You are also the person who can explain
*why*
the optimization engine produced a given plan – and what to change when the plan isn’t right.
  
  
This role suits someone who has implemented a complex, decision-heavy SaaS product – a TMS or routing platform, or a supply chain planning, inventory or scheduling tool – and wants end-to-end ownership rather than a single slice of the lifecycle. You will also lead Mojro’s Customer Success Engineering (CSE) team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you remain the team’s strongest troubleshooter, not only its manager.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Implementation and solution design
* Lead implementations end to end: discovery, scoping, solution design, configuration, integration, testing and go-live.
* Author and own SOWs, Functional and Technical Design Documents (FDD/TDD), workflow diagrams and architecture specifications.
* Translate customer business rules – fleet, time windows, capacities, service levels, costs – into a working solution configuration.
* Integrations and technical delivery
* Own integrations with customer ERP, WMS, OMS and other systems via API, webhook and FTP/SFTP.
* Perform data mapping, environment setup and interface validation.
* Debug issues hands-on using SQL, Postman, logs and browser developer tools.
* UAT and go-live
* Plan and run User Acceptance Testing with customers; drive defect triage with Product and Engineering to closure.
* Prepare go-live plans, risk assessments, cutover checklists and hypercare.
* Technical account ownership after go-live
* Act as the primary technical contact for live accounts, alongside the Customer Success Manager.
* Run proactive technical health checks, usage reviews and periodic technical reviews with customer teams.
* Resolve complex product and integration issues, involving L3 Engineering only when needed.
* Identify technical expansion opportunities and support CS on renewals, upsells and cross-sells.
* Optimization and plan quality
* Diagnose plan-quality issues: unassigned orders, capacity or time-window violations, cost or utilization outliers.
* Tune constraints and parameters with customers, and explain trade-offs in business terms.
* Feed patterns back to Product to improve the engine and its defaults.
* Product feedback
* Surface product gaps, missing APIs and enhancement needs from implementations and live accounts.
* Work with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support prioritization.
* Leadership and team enablement
* Lead and manage the CSE team: hiring, goals, performance reviews and development.
* Act as the team’s technical escalation point, stepping in personally on the hardest integration and production issues.
* Review solution designs and integration approaches before every go-live.
* Prioritize technical issues across concurrent implementations and allocate the team accordingly.
* Mentor engineers on integration debugging, troubleshooting, documentation and customer communication.
* Own the team’s implementation standards, deployment templates, playbooks and knowledge-base content.
* Support Sales and Pre-Sales with technical scoping and feasibility for complex deals.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 8–10 years in B2B SaaS implementation, technical account management, customer success engineering or solutions consulting for a complex enterprise product.
* Background in either: (a) logistics, TMS, routing or visibility platforms; or (b) optimization or planning software – supply chain planning, inventory, demand, scheduling or similar.
* Experience leading a team of engineers or consultants while staying hands-on yourself.
* Hands-on SQL, REST APIs, Postman and log interpretation; you still debug integrations yourself.
* Proven experience writing SOWs, FDDs/TDDs and workflow or architecture documentation.
* Experience owning customer accounts after go-live, not only through implementation.
* Ability to run several enterprise projects at once with strong project discipline.
* Clear communication with both customer IT and operations or business stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to optimization concepts: constraints, objective functions, heuristics or solvers.
* Familiarity with Jira, HubSpot and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Knowledge of authentication flows (SSO, OAuth, MFA) and cloud deployment basics.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, IT or a related field; equivalent depth of SaaS implementation experience will be considered.

**What Success Looks Like In Your First Year**

* You have taken at least two enterprise accounts live as the technical owner.
* Your live accounts run with stable integrations and few repeat escalations.
* Customers trust you to explain and improve plan quality without needing Engineering in the room.
* Your CSE team resolves most escalations without you, and works to standards and playbooks you set.

**Meet the Team**
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA.
* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.

* Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

**Job Description**
As the Principal System Architect, you will be at the forefront of our R&D efforts, contributing to the analysis and specification of key features for our WaveSuite product. Working closely with a team of domain experts and over 400 SW developers, you will own the system architecture, lead cross-functional technical initiatives, and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality solutions. Your customer-centric mindset and ability to engage with key partners will be instrumental in driving the success of our products.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Seeking highly skilled R&D architect and systems engineer to contribute to analysis and specifications of features and components of our Network Management and Control Systems (WaveSuite).
* Working in a team of Optical and Telecommunications domain experts supporting a team of >400 SW developers and testers
* Working in an agile Scrum setup for SW development
* Customer focused mindset, adaptable and ability to drive engagement and collaboration with key Services Practices and Business partners
* Deriving product and R&D requirements from feature requests discussed with Sales and PLM teams as well as with customers and communicate them to the R&D teams
* The role includes

+ System architecture ownership
+ End-to-end solution design
+ Requirements analysis and decomposition
+ Feature specification and SRD creation
+ Cross-functional technical leadership
+ Customer requirement analysis
+ Technical decision making and trade-off analysis
+ Interface definition across NMS/EMS/network elements
+ Review and approval of designs and specifications
+ Technical leadership across multiple Scrum teams
+ Mentoring engineers and architects

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications/Electrical engineering or Computer Science with >10y or Experience in the TelCo domain
* Requirements Engineering: You can define and refine both functional and non-functional requirements to ensure clear product goals.
* Translate complex technical insights into clear, actionable business requirements for internal teams and stakeholders
* Experience in SW and System Architecture and Systems Engineering
* Experience with AI DLC, agentic AI harnesses as well as automation projects
* Optical Networking: You have deep knowledge on L0/L1/L2 networks and and ideally some experience on how to operate and manage transport networks
* Guide and engage with cross-functional teams, ensuring high-quality and timely solution delivery
* Restful API definition: knowledge on OpenAPI, gRPC and general API best practices (like TAPI, OpenConfig)
* Systems Thinking & Detail Orientation: You can see the big picture and pay attention to the details, ensuring complex systems are built with precision and reliability.
* Communication & Leadership: You are an excellent communicator, able to deliver presentations and detailed specifications. You are fluent in English and have a collaborative approach
* Standardization: You should be able to follow up with and contribute to standardization (ONF, MEF, TMF, IETF)
* Kubernetes/Containerization: You deeply understand container technology and Kubernetes, including building API extensions to manage complex applications.
* Distributed Systems: You have 10+ years of experience architecting and scaling resilient, high-performance distributed systems, ideally in observability or data-driven products.
* Cloud-Native & DevOps: You have a foundation in cloud-native and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, system reliability, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
* Cloud Engineering: You have cloud engineering skills with experience deploying in both on-prem and public cloud environments.

This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

4a8afd59.title: AS400 Architect
4a8afd59.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries

de075dd9.title: SPM Delivery Lead
de075dd9.description:
**Job Family Group**

**Job Description**
Job description:
  
  
**About Bp**
bp is a global integrated oil and gas company with over a century of expertise and a proud and enduring heritage. Around the world we work hard to help countries and millions of customers every day with their energy needs. We produce oil and gas, trade energy, and make, ship and sell energy products. We also invest selectively and on a smaller scale in EV charging, biofuels and biogas, offshore wind and solar. Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
As a Supplier Performance Management Delivery Lead, you will lead day-to-day SPM delivery across a portfolio of bp markets, acting as the primary operational interface between in-market teams and the BTC SPM organisation. You will also act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across your supported market portfolio, ensuring consistent application of SPM standards and protocols.
  
  
You will manage demand and capacity, ensure the quality of SPM outputs, resolve operational issues and develop the SPM Analyst team. Direct supplier interaction may occur to support performance reviews, data validation, governance activities and issue resolution. Ownership of supplier relationships and supplier decisions remains with the relevant Market or functional owner.
  
  
This is a fast-paced, decision making role requiring strong supplier-performance expertise, people leadership and the ability to balance competing priorities across markets.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Act as the primary day-to-day interface and first partner concern point for supported markets, ensuring market context, priorities and requirements are understood by the BTC team and resolving issues before partner concern to the SPM Lead.
  
  

* Act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across supported markets, providing guidance on supplier governance, performance management, escalation management and operational guidelines.
* Manage demand and capacity across the market portfolio, prioritising requirements and flexing analyst capacity across markets and workstreams to respond to cyclical peaks, changing priorities and quieter periods.
* Own delivery quality and outcomes, reviewing material analyst outputs before they reach market partners and ensuring work is accurate, timely and fit for purpose.
* Act as the primary day-to-day interface and first escalation point for supported markets, ensuring market context, priorities and requirements are understood by the BTC team and resolving issues before partner concern to the SPM Lead.
* Act as the primary functional SME for Supplier Performance Management activities across supported markets, providing guidance on supplier governance, performance management, issue management and operational protocols.
* Manage demand and capacity across the market portfolio, prioritising requirements and flexing analyst capacity across markets and workstreams to respond to cyclical peaks, changing priorities and quieter periods.
* Own delivery quality and outcomes, reviewing material analyst outputs before they reach market customers and ensuring work is accurate, timely and fit for purpose.
* Lead day-to-day service performance, monitoring workload, delivery commitments and service levels, removing blockers and making timely decisions on operational issues and exceptions.
* Provide functional direction on SPM activities, supporting Analysts in resolving complex performance, data, workflow and partner concern issues while maintaining consistent SPM standards.
* Lead the SPM Analyst team from a people and capability perspective, managing performance expectations, workload balance, coaching, career development and functional standards without directing individual tasks' day to day.
* Provide functional oversight of supplier onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring Analysts implement workflows consistently, onboarding issues are resolved promptly collaborators dependencies are managed and onboarding activities are completed in line with agreed service expectations
* Maintain visibility of service performance and emerging risks, ensuring markets and the SPM Lead have clear information on demand, capacity, quality, exceptions and material delivery concerns.
* Support onboarding of new markets, supplier portfolios and services into the BTC SPM operating model, ensuring consistent adoption of processes, controls, governance standards and service expectations.
* Ensure supplier performance is actively monitored across supported markets, reviewing Key performance indicator, SLA and governance outcomes, challenging performance exceptions, driving corrective-action follow-up and intensifying material supplier-performance concerns where market intervention is required
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimisation, standardisation, automation and AI-enabled ways of working that improve quality, productivity and team member experience.

**What You Will Need To Be Successful**

* 6-8+ years of relevant experience across Supplier Performance Management, Supplier/Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Management or a related operational rigor.
* 2-3+ years of people or service leadership experience, including team performance, coaching and capability development.
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Business, Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing demand, priorities and capacity across multiple markets, participants or workstreams.
* Strong understanding of supplier Key performance indicator /SLAs, scorecards, performance reporting, issue management and corrective actions.
* Strong analytical and operational judgement, with the ability to assess competing priorities, resolve issues and make timely decisions.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience acting as the interface between business collaborators and delivery teams.
* Experience in a shared-services, pooled-resource or multi-market environment is strongly preferred.

**You Will Work With**
You will lead a team of BTC SPM Analysts and work closely with the BTC SPM Lead and in-market supplier-management partners, acting as the primary operational connection between market demand and BTC delivery.
  
  
You will also work with Procurement, category teams, Finance, other relevant functions and external suppliers where required, particularly to support performance reviews, resolve operational issues and manage defined exceptions. Supplier relationship ownership and final supplier-facing decisions remain with the appropriate in-market or functional owner.
  
  
**Why join bp**
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
  
  
There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role
  
  
**Relocation Assistance:**
This role is eligible for relocation within country
  
  
**Remote Type**
This position is a hybrid of office/remote working
  
  
**Skills**
Authentic Leadership, Authentic Leadership, Building services and standards, Building sustainability, Collaboration, Commercial Acumen, Communication, Construction, Continuous Improvement, Contract Management, Crisis and emergency response management, Customer centric thinking, Customer experience, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, Incident investigation and learning, incident investigation and response, Incident Management, Influencing, Management of Change, Negotiating, Operations Management, Project execution planning {+ 10 more}
  
  
**Legal Disclaimer**
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. If you would like to request an adjustment/accommodation related to the recruitment process, please contact us.

d00309b7.title: Delivery Management Leader – AI productivity solutions
d00309b7.description:
We are seeking a **Delivery Management Leader** for AI productivity solutions to drive the successful delivery of high-impact AI programs across diverse industries.

This role requires a strong background in application development (Java/.Net), expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), and the ability to lead large cross-functional teams in delivering scalable, efficient AI solutions that accelerate time-to-market and business value.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for client engagements, including strategic planning, implementation, governance and post-implementation support
* Ensure delivery metrics such as scope, schedule adherence, quality, budget compliance and operational KPIs are consistently met across all engagements
* Manage multi-project portfolios and large cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration across engineering, quality assurance, business analysis, architecture and DevOps
* Own the program governance model, engaging stakeholders at all delivery levels and maintaining alignment on key deliverables, risks and financial health
* Take full accountability for client portfolio financials, including revenue recognition, profitability, margin improvement, budget forecasting and corrective action planning
* Identify and drive cost optimization and OPEX reduction through automation, resource optimization and enhanced delivery models
* Monitor resource utilization, productivity metrics and workforce optimization strategies to align resources with program outcomes
* Serve as the primary client liaison for senior-level relationships, translating business challenges into actionable delivery strategies and maintaining alignment with client objectives
* Conduct Steering Committee sessions and executive-level communications to provide delivery updates, propose innovations and manage escalations
* Build, lead and mentor large distributed teams, cultivating high performance and driving talent development through mentoring and coaching
* Mediate resource conflicts, resolve escalations and ensure delivery deadlines are met, planning for contingencies with robust mitigation actions
* Identify, assess and mitigate program risks to ensure delivery schedules and client KPIs are not impacted, ensuring continuity of services during high-pressure situations
* Identify up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, develop strategies for expanding the organization’s footprint and partner with sales and pre-sales teams on RFPs, SOWs and business proposals
* Drive continuous innovation for client projects through automation, process enhancements and adoption of emerging technologies, promoting best practices in cloud-native applications, data platforms, AI/ML and DevOps pipelines
* Lead end-to-end AI program delivery, including execution of Agentic AI and AI productivity solutions, management of delivery roadmaps, implementation of AI accelerators, and establishment of KPIs to track and improve delivery efficiency

**Requirements**

* 13 to 15 years of IT experience, with 8+ years in delivery leadership roles and 3+ years in AI/ML projects
* Proven track record of delivering enterprise AI programs, including LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI and automation use cases
* Deep understanding of cloud-native AI services on AWS or Azure
* Expertise in large-scale enterprise programs across industries such as BFSI, Telecom, Healthcare, Retail or Life Sciences
* Strong ability to influence and manage senior-level client stakeholders, including Directors, VPs and CXOs, while building trusted relationships
* Pragmatic leadership approach to resolve escalations, handle conflicts within delivery teams and overcome program challenges effectively
* Familiarity with modern engineering technologies and delivery methods, including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices and DevOps, data analytics platforms (Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery) and automation frameworks like RPA (UiPath, Blue Prism)
* Understanding of ITIL/ITSM frameworks and SLA-driven managed services delivery
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies (Scrum, SAFe) and traditional Waterfall-based delivery
* Exceptional leadership, negotiation and decision-making skills for managing high-pressure situations and improving delivery performance
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and deliver results under challenging timelines
* Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal abilities for fostering team and client collaboration

Full-time

Mid-Senior (2–5 Years)

Work Model & Location Requirement

This is a
**Remote-First**
role offering strong day-to-day work-from-home flexibility. However, because high-stakes enterprise pitches, client briefings, and core engineering syncs require in-person collaboration,
**candidates must reside within a ~2-hour drive/commute radius of our Bengaluru Headquarters**
to join on-site sessions
**4 to 8 times per month**

TRALEXHO is an AI-powered Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform built to bring end-to-end transparency and sustainability to the global food supply chain. By connecting every stage of the supply chain—from first-mile producers to end consumers—we help food businesses streamline operations, build consumer trust, and comply with strict global standards like USFDA FSMA 204 and EUDR.

As a
**Solutions Engineer**
, you will serve as the technical anchor for our revenue team. You’ll bridge the gap between complex supply chain technology and business value, guiding enterprise food and agriculture clients through discovery, live platform demos, and technical validation.

If you thrive on translating intricate compliance and AI capabilities into compelling solution architectures, this role is built for you.

* **Communication & Presence:**
  Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills, with a strong track record of commanding the room during executive client meetings (virtual and on-site).
* **Proximity & Availability:**
  Based within a 2-hour commute radius of our Bengaluru HQ and available for in-person collaboration
  **4 to 8 times per month**
  .

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary with revenue performance incentives.
* Remote-first working model with structured in-person team collaboration.
* Opportunity to solve real-world global food safety and traceability challenges using cutting-edge AI.
* Collaborative, high-autonomy culture

* AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike

8dfd670c.title: Business Solutions Engineer
8dfd670c.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Business Solutions Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Business Solutions Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

  

**The Business Solutions Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already

written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Solutions Engineer is the single owner of a solutions entire lifecycle. You start by understanding what the business team is struggling with, and you finish only when the team is using the solution and getting value from it.

  

**In practice you will:**

* Spend time with business teams to find and define real problems, not just take requests.
* Research the product options and gather requirements from the right stakeholders.
* Build the solution end to end using Claude Code, either as an enhancement to an existing system or a new build from scratch.
* Test it yourself, end to end, before anyone else sees it.
* Train the business team, launch the solution and stay on as its owner.
* Track adoption, and when usage is low, find out why and fix it.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work runs in seven stages. You own every one of them.

**1. Discover and understand business challenges**

* Work closely with business teams to learn how they operate day to day and where time, money or accuracy is being lost.
* Identify and prioritise the problems worth solving, using impact, effort and urgency.
* Define each problem clearly, with a measurable outcome, before any solution is proposed.

**2. Research and define the solution**

* Research the product space: how similar problems are solved elsewhere, and whether to enhance an existing system or build something new.
* Gather and document requirements from the relevant stakeholders (business users, managers, data owners, engineering).
* Propose a solution with scope, trade-offs and success criteria, and get alignment before building.

**3. Build end to end with Claude Code**

* Design and develop the solution using Claude Code, either as an enhancement within TruKKer’s existing systems or as a new build from scratch.
* Handle the full stack of the solution: data, logic, integrations, interface and deployment.
* Make sound decisions on architecture, security, access control and maintainability, and review AI-generated code with care.
* Keep documentation current so others can understand and support what you have built.

**4. Test it yourself**

* Own end-to-end testing: functional, integration, edge cases, data accuracy and user-flow checks.
* Validate with realistic business data and scenarios, and fix issues before release.

**5. Train and implement**

* Set up and run training and walkthrough sessions with the business team.
* Prepare simple guides or demos so users can adopt the solution without hand-holding.
* Manage the rollout and go-live, including the first weeks of hypercare.

**6. Support and enhance**

* Be the point of contact for business queries, issues and enhancement requests on your solutions.
* Triage and resolve issues quickly, and scope, build and ship enhancements as needs evolve.

**7. Drive adoption**

* Monitor whether each solution is actually being used, by whom and how often.
* If usage is low, sit down with the business to find the real reason (workflow fit, trust, training, missing features, process change).
* Provide and deliver the fix, whether that is a product change, more training or a process adjustment, until the solution is part of how the team works.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

We care more about what you can build and own than about the title on your last job.

* 3 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, product engineering or a similar hands-on role.
* Strong full-stack ability: you can read and write backend logic, work with databases and APIs, and build a usable front end.
* Hands-on experience building with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, and the judgement to review, test and correct AI-generated code.
* Proven ability to take a vague business problem, break it down, and turn it into clear requirements and a working solution.
* Comfortable working inside existing systems: reading unfamiliar code, integrating with current tools and making safe changes.
* Disciplined self-testing habits, covering functional checks, edge cases and data validation.
* Excellent communication: you can talk to a non-technical operations team and a senior engineer in the same day, and run a good training session.
* High ownership and follow-through, with a bias for action and for finishing what you start.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in logistics, supply chain, freight, marketplaces or other operations-heavy businesses.
* Familiarity with ERP, TMS, CRM or similar enterprise systems and their integrations.
* Experience with BI and analytics tools for building dashboards and usage tracking.
* Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering or internal tools role.
* Product management exposure, such as writing PRDs, prioritising backlogs and running user research.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work daily with business teams such as operations, sales, customer success and finance, and with the product, engineering and data colleagues who own the systems you build on. The business reaches out to you directly, so you must be comfortable being the face of the solution.

  

**How Success Is Measured**

The Business Solutions Engineer is judged on outcomes the business can feel, not on lines of code shipped. Targets are set with the hiring manager once the role is filled.

* Problem-solution fit — Solutions shipped that address a validated business problem, with a stated outcome
* Delivery speed — Time from problem identified to solution live
* Quality — Defects found after go-live, and rework needed after release
* Adoption — Share of intended users actively using the solution, and how that trends after launch
* Business impact — Time saved, errors reduced, or revenue or cost effect, versus the baseline
* Responsiveness — Time to respond to and resolve business queries and enhancement requests
* Stakeholder satisfaction — Feedback from business teams on trust, clarity and support

3f40c524.title: CTC Functional Solution Architect
3f40c524.description:
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Role:**
**The Solution Architect — Functional, Credit to Cash is the functional design authority for the end-to-end Credit to Cash value chain.**
The outcome is a Credit to Cash process that is predictable, automated and controlled: faster and better credit decisions, higher straight-through cash application, risk-based and largely automated collections, fewer exceptions and disputes, lower DSO and overdue, and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope is the Credit to Cash value chain end to end, not a single module or platform — customer onboarding and credit risk assessment, credit limits, scoring, reviews and order hold or release; billing and invoice presentment as they feed receivables; customer statements and self-service portals; collections strategy, worklists and dunning; payment capture, bank statement and lockbox processing, remittance capture and cash application; unapplied and on-account cash; deductions, short-pays, claims and disputes; AR accounting, reconciliation, write-offs and bad-debt provisioning; and the period-end close, controls, reporting and KPIs that sit on top. The role designs across this scope as one integrated solution rather than as separate credit, collections and cash solutions.
  
  
A central part of the remit is bringing HighRadius into Diageo. The postholder leads the functional architecture and design for the HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management modules — and the adjacent capabilities that touch them, such as deductions and integrates them with S/4HANA / ECC FI-AR and FSCM, banks, ClaimOne (under Control Tower) and the wider Customer Operations landscape. HighRadius is an enabler of the target design, not the design itself; the role decides what the process should be first, and then how the platform best delivers it.
  
  
The role combines four capabilities in one person. As a functional solution architect, they own the end-to-end Credit to Cash solution blueprint, the fit-gap against the global standard and the design decisions that hold it together. As a platform expert, they turn the blueprint into working configuration and integration design on HighRadius and SAP FSCM — matching rules, AI models, collection strategies, credit scoring and workflows. As a consultant, they diagnose where cash, credit and collection issues are really created and build the case for the fix. As a design authority, they set standards, review and assure the work of Specialists, system integrators and vendors, and keep the solution coherent as it scales across markets.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is architecting the value chain, not the module.**
A well-configured cash application engine is a smaller prize than a remittance that arrives clean; a sophisticated collections strategy is a smaller prize than a credit decision and invoice that never become overdue. The postholder is expected to design the hand-offs — order and credit, invoice and remittance, payment and dispute, AR and the ledger — as carefully as the modules themselves, and to push the fix upstream into O2I, Commercial, master data or the customer setup where that is where the problem starts.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
Credit to Cash outcomes are shaped by pricing, promotions, customer agreements, invoicing, banking practice, local regulation and the retained, GBO and BPO operating model. The postholder is expected to know how these differ across LAC, NAM, Europe, Africa and APAC, to define what must be global standard and what genuinely requires localisation, and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and architecture role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not run credit, collections or cash application; that stays with market, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done and ensures the solution handed to run is controlled, measurable and sustainable.
  
  
The role works independently within the frame set by the workstream lead, forms its own view and brings recommendations and design decisions rather than questions. It partners closely with D&T Enterprise and Solution Architecture, which own the technical architecture, and provides functional design direction to Specialists working on Credit to Cash fragments. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities (3-5)**
**Own the end-to-end Credit to Cash functional architecture and target design — 25%.**
Define and maintain the Credit to Cash target process and solution architecture across credit, billing hand-off, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close, aligned to the global standard and the target operating model. Lead current-state assessment and fit-gap across markets, platforms and controls, using exception, aging, matching, collection-effectiveness and dispute data to baseline the problem and size the opportunity. Own the solution blueprint, key design decisions and design principles; define what is global standard versus market localisation; and make sure the Credit to Cash design is joined up with O2I, Claims, Commercial and Customer Service.
  
  
**Lead the HighRadius functional solution design and deployment — 25%.**
Act as functional lead for bringing HighRadius into Diageo across Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management. Design remittance capture and cash-application rules toward straight-through posting — bank, lockbox, EDI 820, email and portal remittances, matching logic, auto-match and AI-led recommendations, unapplied-cash and exception handling. Design risk-based collection strategies, segmentation, prioritised worklists, automated dunning and correspondence, promise-to-pay and dispute routing. Design credit applications, scoring models, credit-limit setting and review cycles, blocked-order release and credit workflows. Lead fit-gap, configuration design, functional specifications and sign-off with HighRadius, system integrators and D&T, and shape the multi-market deployment approach and template.
  
  
**Design integration, data and controls across the Credit to Cash landscape — 20%.**
Own the functional design of data flows and integration between HighRadius, SAP S/4HANA / ECC FSCM, banks and payment providers, ClaimOne, customer portals and the reporting layer — customer master, open items, payments, postings, disputes, credit exposure and limits. Define master-data and reference-data requirements, reason-code frameworks and posting logic. Embed financial controls, segregation of duties, audit trail and SOX / internal-control requirements in the design, and define the KPIs and reporting — DSO, CEI, overdue, auto-match rate, unapplied cash, credit-decision cycle time, exception and resolution time — that let the business manage the process in BAU.
  
  
**Deliver the outcome and assure design quality through the value drops — 20%.**
Break the architecture into fragments that can be delivered on the two to four week value drop cadence, and act as design authority on each: review requirements, specifications, configuration and test coverage produced by Specialists, integrators and vendors. Define end-to-end test scenarios, lead integrated SIT and UAT across the value chain, and own resolution of design-level defects. Support cutover, data migration, deployment, hypercare and handover into run. Monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline and drive continuous improvement in automation rates, exception volume and resolution time. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Shape the roadmap and lead across the programme — 10%.**
Own the Credit to Cash functional roadmap: sequencing of modules and markets, adoption of new HighRadius and SAP capability, AI and automation opportunities, and retirement of legacy tools and manual workarounds. Act as trusted adviser to the workstream lead, market Finance, Credit and Collections leaders, GBO, D&T and vendors. Coach and guide Specialists on Credit to Cash design, and surface cross-boundary impact with Order-to-Invoice, Claims, Customer Service and Record-to-Report before it becomes a deployment defect.
  
  
**Key Competencies (3)**

* End-to-end Credit to Cash mastery and functional architecture. Expert, end-to-end knowledge of the Credit to Cash value chain — credit risk and credit management, collections and dunning, payments and cash application, deductions, claims and disputes, AR accounting, reconciliation and close — and of how each step drives the next. Able to design an integrated target process and solution architecture, run a fit-gap, make and document design decisions, and balance global standard against local need. Built on a broad understanding of Customer Operations end to end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, deduction-laden remittances, multi-currency receipts and diverse banking practice. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* HighRadius and SAP platform depth, integration and data. Hands-on functional depth in HighRadius Cash Application, Collections and Credit Management — configuration, matching and AI models, strategies, worklists, workflows and scoring — and in SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections and Dispute Management), including how the two integrate. Understands the data model, interfaces, bank formats, posting logic and controls beneath the process, and can work credibly with technical architects and integrators on integration patterns. Comfortable interrogating data directly to baseline problems and prove outcomes. Strong on solution design documentation, end-to-end testing, cutover and hypercare. Keeps up with the C2C technology market and can judge objectively where a platform fits and where it does not.
* Design authority, influence and leadership. Holds the design line with confidence and evidence — challenges solutions that would not work in the markets and is not satisfied with automating a workaround when the issue could be designed out. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, up to senior Finance and Customer Operations leaders, and with vendors and system integrators. Consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned decisions. Clear communicator able to explain complex design simply, manage conflict to a resolution and guide less experienced colleagues. Comfortable with ambiguity and with being redeployed across markets and workstreams. Resilient, collaborative and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT or a related discipline; a professional accounting or MBA qualification is an advantage.
* HighRadius certification (Cash Application, Collections or Credit) and / or SAP S/4HANA FI-AR or FSCM certification is preferred. Solution-architecture, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 12+ years in Credit to Cash / Order to Cash transformation, solution design and consultancy, including at least 5 years in a functional solution architect, solution lead or design authority role on large-scale, multi-market programmes.
* HighRadius. Functional lead or architect on at least two full-lifecycle HighRadius implementations covering Cash Application, Collections and / or Credit Management — from fit-gap and design through configuration, testing, deployment and stabilisation — ideally integrated with SAP.
* End-to-end Credit to Cash. Deep functional understanding of the whole value chain — credit, collections, cash application, deductions and disputes, AR and close — and evidence of designing across it as one solution, not only within a single module. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* SAP and integration. Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI-AR and FSCM (Credit, Collections, Dispute Management) in S/4HANA or ECC, and experience defining functional integration with banks, lockbox / bank statement formats, EDI and third-party C2C platforms.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation across the full lifecycle, including current-state assessment, future-state operating model design, global template definition and multi-market rollout. Evidence of improving auto-match rates, DSO, overdue, exception volume or manual effort against a defensible baseline.
* Consultative and leadership. A track record as a trusted adviser to senior Finance and Operations stakeholders, leading design decisions across global and local teams, directing system integrators and vendors, and guiding analysts and specialists.
* Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.

**Experience — Desirable**

* Exposure to the wider HighRadius suite (Deductions, EIPP / invoice presentment, Cash Forecasting, Treasury) or to comparable C2C platforms
* Experience applying AI and machine learning in Credit to Cash — remittance capture, matching, collection prioritisation, payment prediction or credit scoring — and designing the controls around it.
* Experience designing for a retained / GBO / BPO operating model, or of a shared services transition or operating model consolidation.
* Experience with credit insurance, credit bureau and rating-agency integrations, e-invoicing and statutory requirements across multiple regions.
* Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.

**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

As an AI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect (SSA), you will be the trusted technical ML & AI expert to both Databricks customers and the Field Engineering organization. * Architect production-level ML & AI workloads for customers using our unified platform, including agents, end-to-end ML pipelines, training/inference optimization, integration with cloud-native services, MLOps, etc.

* Provide advanced technical support to Solution Architects during the technical sale, ranging from feature engineering, training, tracking, serving, to model monitoring, all within a single platform, as well as participating in the larger ML SME community in Databricks
* Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to represent the voice of the customer, define priorities, and influence the product roadmap, helping with the adoption of Databricks’ AI offerings

What we look for
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on industry ML experience in at least one of the following:
* ML Engineer: Build and maintain production-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
* AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML & AI
* [Preferred] 2+ years customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
* Can meet expectations for technical training and role-specific outcomes within 3 months of hire
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. 208573d2.title: Senior Cloud SRE - SRE, IaC, AKS, Cloud platform
208573d2.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

The Senior Cloud Site Reliability Engineer (Senior Cloud SRE) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, availability, performance, security, and operational excellence for cloud platforms and critical product infrastructure.

This role combines software engineering, cloud engineering, automation, observability, and operational governance practices to build highly resilient and self-healing platforms across hybrid and cloud-native environments. The ideal candidate will drive SRE best practices, improve service reliability through automation, establish observability standards, and partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, DBA, and DevEx teams to improve operational maturity across the organization.

The role requires deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, DevOps/SRE principles, telemetry, incident management, monitoring, and automation, along with strong collaboration and communication skills.

***Site Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence***

* Drive and implement Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices across cloud platforms and services.
* Define, maintain, and improve:

+ Service Level Indicators (SLIs)
+ Service Level Objectives (SLOs)
+ Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
+ Error Budgets

* Improve service reliability, resiliency, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Establish operational standards, reliability governance, and production readiness practices.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), postmortems, and reliability improvement initiatives.
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and major incident resolution activities.
* Continuously improving operational processes to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)

***Observability, Monitoring & Telemetry***

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise observability and telemetry platforms.
* Build operational dashboards, reliability scorecards, and service health monitoring solutions.
* Configure proactive alerting, anomaly detection, and incident correlation mechanisms.
* Implement centralized monitoring and telemetry using:

+ Grafana
+ Prometheus
+ Azure Monitor
+ Log Analytics
+ ELK Stack / ElasticSearch
+ Power BI dashboards

* Develop actionable operational metrics and telemetry reporting for engineering and leadership teams.
* Enhance visibility into infrastructure, application, Kubernetes, and platform health.

***Automation & Auto-Healing Engineering***

* Drive automation-first operational practices across infrastructure and platform services.
* Develop Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using:

+ Terraform
+ ARM/Bicep
+ Ansible

* Build operational automation scripts using:

+ Python
+ Bash
+ PowerShell

* Develop self-healing and auto-remediation capabilities for recurring operational incidents.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, scaling, backup, recovery, and deployment workflows.
* Reduce manual operational effort and improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation.

***Collaboration & Engineering Partnership***

* Collaborate closely with:

+ Cloud Engineering teams
+ Product Engineering teams
+ DevEx teams
+ Security teams
+ DBA teams
+ Operations teams

* Support engineering teams in improving production readiness and operational maturity.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, reliability reviews, and operational excellence programs.

**Experience**

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience/certification).
* Knowledge of Python, scripting, or Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, ARM/Bicep).
* Experience managing cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AKS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes and containerization concepts.
* Experience with application packaging, deployment automation, and release management.
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (MS-SQL) and exposure to NoSQL technologies (e.g., Redis, ElasticSearch, MongoDB).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, ELK stack, Prometheus, PowerBI, etc.).
* Proficiency with Git and modern branching/merging workflows.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

175734ef.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
175734ef.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka
  
  
Job ID: A10477252

8f95fe16.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .
  
  
****Role Description****
The IT Order to Cash Service Architect is responsible for enabling superior customer experience and business strategy through g technology solutions and advancing the maturity, adoption, and value of Eastman’s global Order to Cash capabilities.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad, this role will provide architecture leadership for Eastman’s upcoming SAP S/4HANA transformation. The role will focus on the end-to-end O2C process, including order entry, credit processing, pricing, material fulfillment, transportation planning, goods issue, delivery documentation, invoicing, and related Finance integration. An additional key priority will be improving the Customer experience. The Service Architect will help create a more integrated and efficient experience with improved visibility, fewer manual handoffs, and better exception management
  
  
The role requires strong SAP S/4HANA expertise, knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud and key enabling competencies and behaviors including but not limited to business acumen, strategic thinking, executive communication, political savvy, and courageous leadership. Exposure to emerging Agentic & Generative AI is also desired.

Own design and governance of the end-to-end solutions covering order entry, pricing, credit, availability, fulfillment, transportation planning, delivery processing, planned and actual goods issue, delivery note creation, invoicing, and Accounts Receivable integration

Identify technical debt, process inefficiencies, data quality issues, and capability gaps, and develop practical remediation plans
  
  
Evaluate emerging technologies, vendor solutions, automation, analytics, and AI opportunities that can improve O2C performance, Customer Service, and CSR productivity (experience in Joule and/or AgentForce is a plus)
  
  
Ensure solutions address security, data governance, resilience, performance, observability, supportability, and applicable Eastman standards

* Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to document and share knowledge with colleagues.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion modules, interface tables, and data mapping logic.
* Proven troubleshooting ability and a methodical approach to report optimization and validation.
* Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub), CI/CD processes, and technical design documentation.

* Excelling in database management and optimization techniques
* Leading teams in data modernization and product innovation initiatives
