9a358219.title: Pre-Sales Consultant - SAP Testing
9a358219.description:
**Job Title**

Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing

  

**Employer Description**

A fast-growing AI-led enterprise test automation platform company serving global digital transformation clients.

  

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking a high-impact Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing with strong SAP techno-functional expertise, customer-facing solutioning capability, and a deep understanding of SAP business processes, automation strategy, and AI-led testing innovation.

This role is positioned at the intersection of SAP transformation advisory, test strategy design, solution engineering, demo storytelling, and enterprise deal progression. The selected professional will work closely with sales, product, engineering, customer success, and enterprise client stakeholders to shape technically credible, commercially compelling SAP testing solutions.

The role requires a professional who can understand complex SAP landscapes, identify testing gaps, design structured testing strategies, present solution demonstrations, support RFP/RFI responses, run proof-of-concept engagements, and influence customer confidence across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, API, integration, and regression testing environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Customer Discovery and SAP Landscape Assessment**

• Assess current SAP landscapes, including ECC, S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, and integrated enterprise systems.

• Understand SAP business processes across modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, and related functional areas.

• Identify current testing challenges across manual testing, automation coverage, regression cycles, integration validation, and release readiness.

• Evaluate pain points related to test maintenance, test data, execution planning, business process coverage, and cross-module dependencies.

• Translate discovery outcomes into structured solution opportunities and customer-facing recommendations.

  

**2. SAP Test Strategy and Solution Architecture**

• Design end-to-end test strategies for S/4HANA migration programs, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition scenarios.

• Build testing approaches for RISE with SAP programs, Fiori modernization, SAP steady-state operations, and ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Create structured test blueprints covering business process mapping, regression suite design, impact-based testing, and risk-based prioritization.

• Define testing scope across functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, API testing, data migration validation, and interface validation.

• Consider cross-module dependencies, release cycles, upgrade readiness, and industry-specific SAP process complexity.

  

**3. Demo Engineering and Technical Presentation**

• Prepare and deliver customer-specific demos for SAP UI5/Fiori workflow testing.

• Demonstrate testing approaches for SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, APIs, IDocs, CPI, and PI/PO integrations.

• Explain how modern SAP testing reduces release risk, improves reliability, shortens testing cycles, and supports quarterly upgrade readiness.

• Present automation concepts clearly for SAP functional teams, QA leaders, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders.

• Use storytelling, structured narratives, and proof points to communicate solution value during pre-sales engagements.

  

**4. Proposal, RFP, and Solution Documentation**

• Prepare technical proposals, RFP responses, RFI responses, and customer-facing solution documents.

• Support security and compliance questionnaires with technically accurate, role-relevant input.

• Create high-level architecture diagrams, solution outlines, testing strategy documents, and estimation models.

• Develop test effort and complexity estimates based on SAP scope, modules, interfaces, transformation stage, and regression requirements.

• Tailor SAP testing strategies for industry contexts such as manufacturing, BFSI, retail, and other enterprise environments.

  

**5. Customer Engagement and Deal Progression**

• Work with Sales Directors to build compelling SAP testing narratives and customer-specific value propositions.

• Lead validation workshops with SAP functional consultants, QA teams, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and transformation stakeholders.

• Address customer objections around methodology, automation strategy, integration reliability, migration readiness, and testing governance.

• Define success criteria for proof-of-concept engagements and validation workshops.

• Run PoCs aligned to real customer business processes, SAP modules, integration flows, and technical environments.

• Support deal progression through technical credibility, structured solutioning, and stakeholder confidence-building.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• 810 years of experience in SAP functional consulting, ABAP development leadership, SAP project delivery, SAP solutioning, or SAP techno-functional consulting.

• Strong exposure to SAP projects in consulting, project management, technical delivery, implementation, migration, or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA migration approaches, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition.

• Working knowledge of RISE with SAP architecture and enterprise SAP transformation models.

• Experience with SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or similar business process areas.

• Participation in at least one S/4HANA or RISE transformation project in a primary functional, technical, or consulting role.

• Strong communication skills, executive presence, demo capability, and solution storytelling ability.

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

• Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, SAP advisory, SAP QA consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.

• Lead contributor experience in SAP implementation programs, especially in FI, SD, or MM domains.

• Exposure to SAP test automation, SAP QA, regression testing, impact-based testing, or structured testing frameworks.

• Background modernizing SAP testing from manual or recorder-driven approaches to structured automation frameworks.

• Experience supporting proposals, RFPs, technical presentations, solution workshops, PoCs, or enterprise deal cycles.

  

**Required Technical and Functional Expertise**

• SAP S/4HANA transformation and migration testing.

• RISE with SAP architecture and testing implications.

• SAP functional process knowledge across SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or related modules.

• SAP UI5 and Fiori testing.

• SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, IDocs, and interface flows.

• CPI and PI/PO integration environments.

• Functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and data migration validation.

• Test case design, test data services, execution lists, regression suite planning, and risk-based testing practices.

• Business process coverage mapping and cross-module dependency analysis.

• Customer-facing solution architecture and technical storytelling.

  

**Required Professional Competencies**

• Ability to lead structured customer discovery discussions.

• Strong analytical ability to assess SAP testing gaps and transformation risks.

• Capability to design practical, enterprise-ready SAP testing strategies.

• Clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.

• Strong presentation, demo, objection-handling, and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to partner effectively with sales, product, engineering, and client-facing teams.

• Strong documentation discipline for proposals, RFPs, architecture diagrams, and solution notes.

• High ownership orientation and ability to drive technical deal progression.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an SAP techno-functional professional with strong consulting maturity, enterprise communication skills, and the ability to translate SAP transformation challenges into structured testing solutions. The person should be comfortable discussing SAP business processes with functional teams, integration complexity with technical stakeholders, testing strategy with QA leaders, and business outcomes with senior decision-makers.

A strong fit would be someone who has contributed meaningfully to SAP implementation, migration, or transformation programs and now seeks a customer-facing pre-sales role combining SAP expertise, testing strategy, automation advisory, AI-led innovation, and enterprise solution consulting.

43906851.title: Java Full Stack Architect
43906851.description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 23 sequential quarters of growth with $422.5M in Q3 FY26 revenue, up 4.0% Q-o-Q and 17.3% Y-o-Y growth. Our 26,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We won the 2025 ISG Star of Excellence? Award for AI and Data Excellence and were named a Leader in the Everest Group Talent Readiness for Next-generation Data, Analytics and AI Services PE?? Assessment 2025.
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
Years of Experience: 8 to 12 Years
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Architect to lead our application design and architecture initiatives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in hands-on development and a strong background in application design and solution architecture. You will play a critical role in shaping our technology landscape and driving the development of scalable, cloud-native applications.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead application design and architecture discussions, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on development support to the engineering team.
* Design and implement scalable event-driven solutions using Kafka and Axon Framework.
* Support critical production issues and ensure architecture governance across projects.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement CI/CD and DevOps best practices.
* Mentor junior developers and promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Solution Architecture
* Hands-on development experience in React JS and Node / Java
* Micro Services
* Kafka Messaging Bus
* Event driven archiecture
* Cloud Native Function
* Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Continuous Exploration Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, ELK Stack)
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

Expertise You'll Bring
  
  
The successful candidate will bring a wealth of experience in application design and architecture, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions. You will have a deep understanding of modern development practices and a passion for technology innovation. Your ability to lead technical discussions and mentor team members will be key to your success in this role.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role: Enterprise Architect – Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST)**
**Experience: 15+ Years**
**Description**
A senior enterprise architecture leadership role responsible for defining technology strategy, driving enterprise-wide modernization and transformation initiatives, and shaping future-state architectures across large, complex organizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong blend of
**enterprise architecture, deep technical architecture credibility, consulting mindset, and stakeholder leadership**
. The Enterprise Architect is expected to engage senior business and technology leaders while providing architectural direction for large-scale, cloud-native and distributed systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead enterprise architecture workstreams for transformation, modernization, and assessment initiatives.
* Design and lead the development of large-scale cloud and custom-built solutions, leveraging modern architecture patterns such as microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and modernization roadmaps, including application portfolio rationalization.
* Engage with business stakeholders, architects, delivery teams, and executive governance forums to guide end-to-end solution delivery, architecture decisions, and thought leadership.
* Support presales activities including solution shaping, estimation, proposals, client workshops, and executive presentations.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields.

**Enterprise Architecture Expertise**

* 15+ years of IT experience with at least 6+ years in Enterprise Architecture or equivalent senior architecture leadership roles.
* Proven experience defining enterprise target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and architecture governance models.
* Strong experience conducting enterprise assessments and application portfolio rationalization initiatives.
* Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman, or equivalent.

**Technical Depth**

* Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to architect and guide delivery of large-scale, complex enterprise systems.
* Cloud Native and Microservices based solutions

+ Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, API-led integration, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures.
+ Experience designing systems for scalability, resilience, security, high availability, and performance.
+ Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data platforms, containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, and observability.
+ Experience working across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid/multi-cloud environments.
+ Provide full stack architecture leadership, designing solutions across front end, back end, integration, data, and cloud layers, including modern web-based front end technologies such as React or Angular.

* Architecture experience with AI based solutions

+ Architecture-level understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
+ Ability to define high-level GenAI solution architectures involving enterprise knowledge bases, document search, summarization, workflow automation, and conversational interfaces.
+ Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, guardrails, human oversight, and regulatory considerations.

**Leadership & Consulting Skills**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead architecture teams, and steer complex transformation programs.
* Strong communication, consulting, and presentation skills, including experience delivering thought leadership.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Architecture and cloud certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP certifications or similar.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.

* A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.
* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.

0adeef54.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ordering
0adeef54.description:
**Description**
It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. The role requires a deep understanding of customer needs and thinking big about how we can make the purchase experience across online retail seamless and delightful. The ideal candidate is excited by technology, passionate about learning, must think big, translate complex technical concepts into actionable solutions, lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact prototypes, and maintain regular stakeholder communications through structured reporting and updates.
  
  
You will need to be entrepreneurial, and work in a highly collaborative environment. 2390e7ea.title: Staff Technical Program Manager — Multi-Entity Account Scale & Access Lifecycle
2390e7ea.description:
**Overview**
Intuit's Identity organization is seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager to focus on how our platform scales for large and complex customers. Our Identity Platform is the primary gateway for millions of customers across TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp — a durable strategic lever that ensures personalized experiences are delivered with world-class security and compliance.
  
  
This role sits at the center of one of Intuit's largest growth bets: serving customers whose organizations look nothing like a single-owner small business. Accounting firms managing hundreds of clients. Multi-entity businesses running dozens of legal entities across currencies and locations. Mid-market companies with real hierarchies, real headcount, and real governance requirements. The users you build for are the people your customers employ — the staff, contractors, and accountants they invite into their own Intuit account — and the platform they administer today was designed for a much smaller shape of customer.
  
  
You will own two initiatives end to end.
**Scale**
is the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands, delivering bulk and group-level administration, and standing up an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time.
**Access automation**
is the work of making the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it — collapsing onboarding that takes weeks and eliminating access that outlives the person who held it.
  
  
We need an AI Native, results-oriented and empathetic technical leader who can navigate complex system architectures, establish order in ambiguity, and drive technical excellence in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. This role is based in Bengaluru India and partners daily with the engineering and product teams driving both initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive Technical Excellence: Own and drive two critical identity programs — multi-entity account scale and automated access lifecycle — from scope definition through launch and adoption. Navigate complex microservice architectures, multi-tenant account and permission models, and intricate system dependencies to deliver capabilities that are secure, performant, and reliable at scale.
* Own the Scale Initiative: Drive the work of taking our account model from hundreds of entities to thousands — hierarchies, groups, bulk administration, and an API-first surface so customers and partners can manage identity programmatically rather than one user at a time. Dive deep into the technical subject matter and re-emerge with an end-to-end blueprint the delivery teams can execute against.
* Own the Access Automation Initiative: Drive the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle to automatic — permissions applied correctly the moment someone is added, revoked the moment they leave, with the audit trail to prove it. Partner with engineering on the provisioning architecture and with product on the administrative experience that sits on top of it.
* Connect Strategy to Execution: Synthesize business strategy, customer signals, and delivery realities to prioritize across both initiatives and keep teams focused on the highest-impact outcomes. Lead the tradeoff discussions, recommend the execution path, and ensure follow-through with stakeholders.
* Execute with Rigor: Partner across teams to define program outcomes, build the end-to-end delivery plan, and establish the governance model for both initiatives. Develop and drive the operating rhythm — planning, reviews, cutline sessions, and decision forums — that sets direction and instills accountability.
* Own Risks and Dependencies: Both initiatives carry committed dependencies from product teams across Intuit. Uncover risks and dependencies before they materialize, proactively escalate blockers, determine the optimal path to green, and hold partner teams to dated commitments.
* Identity Architecture Partnership: Work with Identity Architects and engineering leaders to ensure account hierarchy, provisioning, and access patterns scale consistently across the Intuit ecosystem, and that both initiatives compose cleanly with the authorization and governance work running alongside them.
* Lead Change Through Migration and Adoption: Own the path from the current account model to the new one — not just the capability, but how existing customers get there without disruption. Identify the impact of key changes, develop the change plan, and exhibit extreme ownership driving from plan to sustained adoption, tracking that customers actually move rather than that the feature shipped.
* Enable Scale and Velocity: Build the frameworks, tooling, and instrumentation that make identity program delivery repeatable — and apply AI agent tools to accelerate program analysis, delivery, and stakeholder communication, evaluating AI-generated program artifacts with the same rigor applied to human-generated output.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 8+ years in technical program management within platform organizations or high-scale software development environments, including demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.
* Education: BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent technical degree.
* Identity Platform Depth: Direct experience delivering customer identity and access management (CIAM) capabilities — authentication, authorization, account and organization modeling, or user provisioning and administration — in a product-facing platform serving external customers at scale.
* Access Model Fluency: Working knowledge of role- and attribute-based access control (RBAC/ABAC/PBAC), permission and entitlement models, delegated administration, and the failure modes that come with them — over-permissioning, role sprawl, and orphaned access.
* Multi-Tenant Hierarchy Modeling: Experience with systems that represent a customer's own organizational structure — parent/child entities, groups, delegated admins, cross-organization access — and the design tradeoffs between flexibility and comprehensibility at scale.
* Technical Domain Expertise: Strong grasp of SDLC methodologies, microservices architecture, and platform design, with the systems thinking to form an end-to-end blueprint in an unfamiliar problem area and the credibility to be treated as a thought partner by technical stakeholders. Fluency with API-first delivery, including developer-facing surfaces and programmatic administration.
* Scale Judgment: Demonstrated experience taking a platform capability from a small-customer design point to a large-customer design point, including the migration path for customers already on the old model.
* AI-Native Delivery: Demonstrated use of AI agents and tools in your own program work to accelerate analysis, structure delivery, and sharpen stakeholder communication — with firsthand judgment about where AI accelerates delivery and where it introduces risk.
* Leadership Style: Proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority, at a scope where you define the program rather than inherit it. Credibility as a boundaryless change leader who drives from plan to sustained adoption. You are a self-starter who values "Leadership as a Coach" and supports the growth of those around you.
* Communication: Excellent articulate and warm communication skills, with strong written fluency. You can compress a complex program into a page an executive can act on, and simplify technical problems into actionable insight for engineers and leaders alike.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to establish order in ambiguous situations and use rapid experimentation to learn fast and pivot when necessary.
* Analytical Skills: Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to track and report on program health, delivery velocity, and customer impact metrics.
* Preferred: Experience with identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, ReBAC/ABAC engines such as OPA); B2B or B2B2C SaaS serving mid-market or larger customers; experience delivering through partner, reseller, or professional-services channels.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

5e105780.title: Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency
5e105780.description:
**About Glean**
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
  
  
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
  
  
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
  
  
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
  
  
**About The Role**
Glean is looking for a Technical Program Manager, AI & Cloud Efficiency to provide end-to-end oversight of these initiatives: maintain the portfolio, set priorities, drive the operating cadence, unblock owners, and ensure savings land. Glean delivers AI at enterprise scale across a deliberately open, provider-neutral stack. This breadth necessitates numerous efficiency initiatives running in parallel across engineering — token yield, compute right-sizing, LLM Gateway quotas, provider commitments to name a few.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive Cloud and AI/LLM efficiency
* Own a single, prioritised source of truth for all cost initiatives and drive them to measurable efficiency and margin gains.
* Pressure-test savings claims: verify realised vs. projected savings post-launch, and prevent silent cost regressions from eroding prior wins
* Build cost-attribution discipline: per-service, per-team, per-customer, per-feature tagging and allocation so every dollar has an owner
* Oversee LLM spend across providers: procurement and commitment sizing
* Govern internal AI tooling spend with per-user visibility, quotas, and value assessment
* Build the observability & automation layer
* Treat cost like production telemetry: real-time cost attribution, anomaly detection, alerting, and automated triage
* Automate the toil: cost-triage agents, regression detection, and self-serve attribution so the program scales

**About You**

* Deep, hands-on understanding of cloud infrastructure and AI/LLM economics
* Proficient in driving efficiency, capacity, or FinOps-adjacent programs
* Eng operations instincts: you think in SLOs, error budgets, telemetry, and postmortems, and you apply that discipline to spend
* Strong SQL and data skills; you can query BigQuery, build a Sigma workbook, and model a scenario

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office)

**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
  
  
**AI-First Mindset At Glean**
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
**As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.**
Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.
  
  
**Global Data Privacy Notice For Job Candidates And Applicants**
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our
**Privacy Policy**
. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our
**Applicant Arbitration Agreement**
.
  
  
By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the
**Applicant Arbitration Agreement**
, and I agree to the terms.

* 7 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
* 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
* 5 years of experience with coding in one or more general purpose languages.
* 1 year of experience leading teams in a technical capacity or leading technical risk analysis in an enterprise environment.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with physical access control, intrusion detection, case management, video management, Physical Security Information Management (PSIM), IT networking, construction/architecture, and no-code development platforms.
* Experience in technology delivery, design and execution within Physical/Cyber Security industries with PSP, CPP, CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+ or Cisco CCNA certification.
* Experience aligning teams across various disciplines, including operational, engineering, product, and UX.
* Ability to successfully navigate through competing priorities, present complex ideas with clarity, and build strong partnerships with stakeholders.
* Ability to lead projects by navigating priorities, measurable objectives, dependencies, planning, resourcing, scheduling, budgeting, implementation and subsequent monitoring, through informal authority.

**About The Job**
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.
  
  
Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
  
  
In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop exceptional programs that drive sustainable effectiveness. You will be responsible for completing initiatives that improve Google’s ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act on security risks globally. You will drive delivery of physical security technology solutions in scope of the Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) organization. You will partner internally to prototype and develop solutions on accelerated timelines against stakeholder requirements, owning the full end to end delivery and support of those solutions throughout their lifecycle. Your delivery will enable GSRS operations to keep Google and Google employees safe and secure across the global office locations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze operational processes and business requirements to ensure alignment with the overall goal and delivery of the technology roadmap, new or existing products, with a focus on accessibility, scalable growth, automation, and business outcomes that mitigate key risks.
* Deliver technology solutions against strategic plans through tactical activities such as gathering requirements, developing user stories, lab testing and creating project, rollout and communications plans. Support evaluation, integration, and implementation of third party solutions.
* Provide mentoring and guidance for junior colleagues, peers and stakeholders as a subject matter expert in physical security towards shared business goals and objectives.
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of deployed solutions, gathering feedback and iterating to improve user experience and outcomes.
* Manage highly confidential information and safeguard company intellectual property.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. **Description**
Join our Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations team as a Program Manager I where you'll drive operational excellence for our quick commerce business in North America. In this high-impact role, you'll serve as the operational performance owner for the North America geographical region, identifying and eliminating defects that impact customer experience while collaborating with multiple stakeholders to optimize processes. You'll have the freedom to develop innovative solutions that reduce operational costs, eliminate quality issues, and enhance overall performance metrics.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of operations and strategic business improvements. You'll develop expertise in quick commerce business nuances specific to the North American market while exercising a high degree of ownership in identifying more efficient ways of working. Your analytical abilities will be crucial as you deep dive into operational data, identify root causes of performance issues, and implement effective solutions that directly impact customer satisfaction across North America.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own operational performance metrics for the North America region, conducting regular deep dives into data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement Identify and eliminate operational defects leading to negative customer experiences through root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures Partner with North American operations teams to understand daily performance challenges, diagnose bottlenecks, and develop strategies to reduce quality issues and business waste Represent Central Operations in business stakeholder meetings focused on North America performance, effectively communicating operational status, challenges, and proposed solutions Transform raw data into clear documentation, requirements, and actionable insights that drive process improvements across the North American organization
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
A day in the life Your day begins with an in-depth analysis of the previous day's operational defects in North America, using data to identify patterns and root causes. You'll collaborate with North American operations teams to understand the current day's performance status and potential challenges. Throughout the day, you'll brainstorm strategies to reduce operational costs and business waste specific to the NA market, represent Central Operations in business calls with North American stakeholders, and coordinate with the central CO team to provide necessary support where needed. You'll balance analytical work with cross-functional collaboration, all focused on improving customer experience in North America.
  
  
**About The Team**
About the team Global Specialty Fulfillment Central Operations (GSF CO) functions as the Command-and-Control Center for Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) operations in North America. We partner strategically with North American Operations, business teams, ACES, and S&OP teams, providing expertise in capacity management, defect reduction, holiday planning, contingency management, and automation of redundant workflows.
  
  
Our team operates with a progressive mental model: Centralize processes, Standardize across the North America geography, Automate to reduce manual effort, and ultimately Eliminate unnecessary processes through hands-off-the-wheel automation. This creates an innovative environment where you'll have significant impact on improving customer experiences across North America.

87335b00.title: Associate Customer Program Manager (EG)
87335b00.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  

* Work Hours: 9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)\*\*

**F**
**ictiv exists to help product innovators create**
Fictiv is a global manufacturing company that simplifies sourcing for custom manufacturing, from prototype to low-volume production. Through its highly-vetted manufacturing network, AI-powered technology platform, and global operations centers across the USA, Mexico, India, and China, Fictiv delivers fast, high-quality custom manufacturing services from quote to delivery. Fictiv’s capabilities span the full mechanical bill of materials, including Injection Molding, Compression Molding, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Die Casting, and Sheet Metal. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 30 million commercial and prototype parts for early-stage companies and large enterprises alike, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.
  
  
**Impact in this Role**
Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and finding creative solutions? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, non-traditional environment, we want YOU on our team!
  
  
In your role as
**Associate Customer Program Manager**
, you will be working directly with our US-based customers, and you’ll be using your agility, problem-solving skills, and customer service advocacy to help our customers increase the velocity and quality of products delivered. You will collaborate with the cross-functional teams to resolve customer pain points, address customer needs, and help manage customer projects end to end. You will support multiple customers across a variety of manufacturing orders to be fulfilled in different regions around the world.
  
  
**Work Hours:**
9
**:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)**
This role follow a hybrid work schedule - 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Customer Management: You will be our customers’ best ally at Fictiv. Work closely with our customers to ensure a seamless and high-quality experience. Nurture relationships and resolve issues to help drive customer loyalty.
* Case management: Concurrently manage a variety of manufacturing orders with multiple customers and the internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve top user requests to address their product development needs and meet customer expectations for timing and quality.
* Communication: Gather, interpret, and communicate engineering, design, manufacturing, and logistics requirements to ensure the orders will be delivered on time and in full
* Collaboration: Collaborate with sales and the manufacturing operations teams to ensure successful delivery to the customer and advocate on their behalf - through the project lifecycle, including post-delivery exceptions.
* Program Management: Manage projects with top-down oversight throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify improvement areas and collaborate with the cross-functional team to prioritize and define solutions to increase our efficiency.

**Desired Traits**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA required.
* 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, supply chain or customer-facing operations roles.
* Experience supporting NPI, low-volume production, or rapid prototyping programs.
* PMP/project management certification and understanding of project management/operations knowledge preferred.
* The work is fast-paced - you will be working in an operations environment with tight deadlines and high standards. You will need to be organized with good time management, prioritization skills and great attention to detail.
* We obsess over our customers - you will need to be personable and have outstanding communications skills (both written and verbal) and be able to adapt your communication style effectively. Must be fluent in written and spoken English. Proven experience working directly with US-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred
* This role requires a self-starter mentality. We want you to be excited by a hands-on, high-performing, results-oriented role and driven to exceed expectations for our clients. Accountability is everything; you say what you do and do what you say.
* Aligned with our culture centered around continuous learning - bring passion to learn about the manufacturing ecosystem and the New Product Development process.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
